`src/main/target.ts`:

```ts
import { closeSync, existsSync, openSync, readSync, statSync } from "node:fs"
import { basename, extname, isAbsolute, join } from "node:path"
import type { TargetInfo, TargetKind } from "@shared/types"

/*
  What a project's target is (specs/projects R1.4), told from its extension and its first bytes, and what the
  specialist works on it with (adr:0018-make-rea-native-to-the-specialist). Detection is a hint for the user and the
  orchestrator: the specialist routes the target itself.
*/

const LABELS: Record<TargetKind, string> = {
  android: "Android package",
  elf: "ELF binary",
  pe: "Windows PE binary",
  macho: "Mach-O binary",
  dotnet: ".NET assembly",
  electron: "Electron application",
  javascript: "JavaScript application",
  archive: "Archive",
  firmware: "Firmware or raw image",
  folder: "Folder",
  file: "File",
}

const ENGINES: Record<TargetKind, string[]> = {
  android: ["REA Android tools", "JADX", "Apktool", "Ghidra for native libraries"],
  elf: ["REA native tools", "Ghidra"],
  pe: ["REA native tools", "Ghidra"],
  macho: ["REA native tools", "Ghidra"],
  dotnet: ["REA managed .NET tools"],
  electron: ["REA JavaScript and Electron tools"],
  javascript: ["REA JavaScript tools"],
  archive: ["REA artifact inventory"],
  firmware: ["REA firmware tools", "Ghidra"],
  folder: ["REA routes each file it finds"],
  file: ["REA routes the file by its content"],
}

const ANDROID = new Set([".apk", ".xapk", ".apks", ".aab", ".apkm"])
const ARCHIVE = new Set([".zip", ".jar", ".ipa", ".tar", ".gz", ".tgz", ".xz", ".7z", ".rar", ".zst"])
const FIRMWARE = new Set([".bin", ".img", ".fw", ".hex", ".dfu", ".rom", ".elf32"])
const JAVASCRIPT = new Set([".js", ".mjs", ".cjs"])

/** The first bytes of a file, at most `n`. */
function head(path: string, n = 4096): Buffer {
  const fd = openSync(path, "r")
  try {
    const buf = Buffer.alloc(n)
    return buf.subarray(0, readSync(fd, buf, 0, n, 0))
  } finally {
    closeSync(fd)
  }
}

/** Whether a PE image declares a CLR runtime header: data directory 14 of its optional header is set. */
export function isDotNet(b: Buffer): boolean {
  if (b.length < 0x40 || b.toString("latin1", 0, 2) !== "MZ") return false
  const pe = b.readUInt32LE(0x3c)
  if (pe + 24 > b.length || b.toString("latin1", pe, pe + 4) !== "PE\0\0") return false
  const opt = pe + 24
  const magic = b.readUInt16LE(opt)
  const dirs = opt + (magic === 0x20b ? 112 : magic === 0x10b ? 96 : NaN)
  const clr = dirs + 14 * 8
  if (!Number.isFinite(clr) || clr + 8 > b.length) return false
  return b.readUInt32LE(clr) !== 0 && b.readUInt32LE(clr + 4) !== 0
}

/** A target's kind from its first bytes and its extension. */
export function kindOf(name: string, b: Buffer): TargetKind {
  const ext = extname(name).toLowerCase()
  const magic = b.subarray(0, 4).toString("hex")
  if (ANDROID.has(ext)) return "android"
  if (ext === ".asar") return "electron"
  if (b.toString("latin1", 0, 4) === "\x7fELF") return "elf"
  if (b.toString("latin1", 0, 2) === "MZ") return isDotNet(b) ? "dotnet" : "pe"
  if (["feedface", "feedfacf", "cefaedfe", "cffaedfe"].includes(magic) || (magic === "cafebabe" && ext !== ".class")) return "macho"
  if (JAVASCRIPT.has(ext)) return "javascript"
  if (ARCHIVE.has(ext) || magic === "504b0304" || magic.startsWith("1f8b") || magic === "fd377a58" || magic === "377abcaf" || magic === "52617221")
    return "archive"
  if (FIRMWARE.has(ext)) return "firmware"
  return "file"
}

/** A folder holding an Electron or JavaScript application, told by its package files. */
function folderKind(dir: string): TargetKind {
  if (existsSync(join(dir, "resources", "app.asar")) || existsSync(join(dir, "app.asar"))) return "electron"
  if (existsSync(join(dir, "package.json"))) return "javascript"
  return "folder"
}

/** What the target at `path` is; throws when it cannot be read (specs/projects R1.7). */
/**
  A path the renderer sent, checked before it is touched: absolute, and on this machine. A network share would be
  reached by the stat itself, a device path is not a target, and a relative one resolves against wherever the app runs.
*/
export function localPath(path: string): string {
  if (!isAbsolute(path)) throw new Error(`${path} is not an absolute path.`)
  if (/^[\\/]{2}/.test(path)) throw new Error(`${path} is a network or device path; choose a local one.`)
  return path
}

export function detectTarget(path: string): TargetInfo {
  const st = statSync(localPath(path))
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    const kind = folderKind(path)
    return { path, kind, isFile: false, size: 0, label: LABELS[kind], engines: ENGINES[kind] }
  }
  if (!st.isFile()) throw new Error(`${basename(path)} is neither a file nor a folder.`)
  const kind = kindOf(path, head(path))
  return { path, kind, isFile: true, size: st.size, label: LABELS[kind], engines: ENGINES[kind] }
}
```

`src/main/unknowns.ts`:

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto"
import type { Contract } from "@shared/contract"
import type { UnknownRow } from "@shared/types"
import { getDb } from "./db"
import { redact } from "./events/redact"

/*
  A project's unknowns ledger (specs/analysis-contract R2): each question an analysis left open, tied
  to the analysis that raised it and, once settled, to the one that closed it with its resolution.
  Fed only from a contract that validated.
*/

type Row = Record<string, unknown>

function unknownRow(r: Row): UnknownRow {
  return {
    id: String(r.id),
    projectId: String(r.project_id),
    question: String(r.question),
    severity: String(r.severity) as UnknownRow["severity"],
    probes: JSON.parse(String(r.probes)) as string[],
    settle: String(r.settle),
    raisedBy: String(r.raised_by),
    closedBy: r.closed_by === null ? null : String(r.closed_by),
    resolution: String(r.resolution),
    createdAt: Number(r.created_at),
    updatedAt: Number(r.updated_at),
  }
}

/** What a contract did to the ledger: the ids it opened and closed, and the closes it could not apply (R2.3). */
export interface LedgerChange {
  opened: string[]
  closed: string[]
  ignored: { id: string; why: string }[]
}

export class UnknownsLedger {
  constructor(private readonly now: () => number = Date.now) {}

  /** Every unknown of the project, open ones first, each group oldest first (R2.5). */
  list(projectId: string): UnknownRow[] {
    return (getDb().prepare("SELECT * FROM unknowns WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY closed_by IS NOT NULL, created_at, rowid").all(projectId) as Row[]).map(
      unknownRow,
    )
  }

  /** The project's open unknowns, for the next delegation (R2.4). */
  open(projectId: string): UnknownRow[] {
    return (getDb().prepare("SELECT * FROM unknowns WHERE project_id = ? AND closed_by IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, rowid").all(projectId) as Row[]).map(
      unknownRow,
    )
  }

  /** Apply a validated contract from analysis `stepId`: close what it settles, then add what it opens (R2.1–R2.3). */
  record(projectId: string, stepId: string, contract: Contract): LedgerChange {
    const db = getDb()
    const at = this.now()
    const change: LedgerChange = { opened: [], closed: [], ignored: [] }
    for (const c of contract.closes) {
      const row = db.prepare("SELECT closed_by FROM unknowns WHERE id = ? AND project_id = ?").get(c.id, projectId) as Row | undefined
      if (!row) change.ignored.push({ id: c.id, why: "no such unknown in this project" })
      else if (row.closed_by !== null) change.ignored.push({ id: c.id, why: "already closed" })
      else {
        const resolution = redact(c.source ? `${c.resolution} (${c.source})` : c.resolution)
        db.prepare("UPDATE unknowns SET closed_by = ?, resolution = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(stepId, resolution, at, c.id)
        change.closed.push(c.id)
      }
    }
    // The same question already open is not added again, so a repeated contract cannot grow the ledger.
    const norm = (q: string) => q.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase()
    const open = new Set(this.open(projectId).map((u) => norm(u.question)))
    for (const u of contract.unknowns) {
      if (open.has(norm(redact(u.question)))) continue
      open.add(norm(redact(u.question)))
      const id = `unk-${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 12)}`
      db.prepare(
        "INSERT INTO unknowns (id, project_id, question, severity, probes, settle, raised_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
      ).run(id, projectId, redact(u.question), u.severity, JSON.stringify(u.probes.map(redact)), redact(u.settle ?? ""), stepId, at, at)
      change.opened.push(id)
    }
    return change
  }
}
```

`src/main/watch.ts`:

```ts
import type { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite"
import type { EventRow, PatchView, ProjectRow, Push, StepRow, TaskRow } from "@shared/types"
import { getDb } from "./db"

/*
  How an app sees what another process changed (specs/shared-data-folder R5.3,
  adr:0024-share-the-data-folder-between-processes): SQLite's `data_version` changes only when another connection
  commits, so polling it twice a second is free while nothing happens. On a change, what moved since the last look —
  events by id, tasks, steps and projects by `updated_at`, patches by state, deletions by absence — is pushed to the
  view as if this process had written it. A change of which app holds a project, which lives in a lock file, is
  checked on the same tick.
*/

type Row = Record<string, unknown>

export interface WatchSources {
  push(p: Push): void
  task(id: string): TaskRow
  step(row: Row): StepRow
  event(row: Row): EventRow
  patch(row: Row): PatchView
  /** a project as the view sees it, with the app holding it */
  project(id: string): ProjectRow
  /** which project each live app other than this one holds, as a comparable signature */
  holders(): string
  /** called when another app saved or removed a provider key */
  keysChanged(): void
}

/** How far back a row's `updated_at` is looked at again: rows another process committed late, with an older stamp. */
const SLACK_MS = 5000

export class ChangeWatcher {
  private version = -1
  private maxEvent = 0
  private cursor = 0
  private readonly tasks = new Map<string, number>()
  private readonly steps = new Map<string, number>()
  private readonly projects = new Map<string, number>()
  private readonly patches = new Map<string, string>()
  private keysRev = ""
  private holders = ""
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null

  constructor(
    private readonly src: WatchSources,
    private readonly intervalMs = 500,
  ) {}

  private db(): DatabaseSync {
    return getDb()
  }

  private dataVersion(): number {
    return Number((this.db().prepare("PRAGMA data_version").get() as { data_version: number }).data_version)
  }

  private rev(): string {
    const r = this.db().prepare("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'keys.rev'").get() as { value: string } | undefined
    return r?.value ?? ""
  }

  /** Take the database as it is now as seen, and start polling. */
  start(): void {
    const d = this.db()
    this.version = this.dataVersion()
    this.maxEvent = Number((d.prepare("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) AS m FROM events").get() as Row).m)
    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT id, updated_at FROM tasks").all() as Row[]) this.tasks.set(String(r.id), Number(r.updated_at))
    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT id, updated_at FROM projects").all() as Row[]) this.projects.set(String(r.id), Number(r.updated_at))
    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT id, state FROM patches").all() as Row[]) this.patches.set(String(r.id), String(r.state))
    this.cursor = Math.max(0, ...this.tasks.values(), ...this.projects.values())
    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT id, updated_at FROM steps WHERE updated_at >= ?").all(this.cursor - SLACK_MS) as Row[])
      this.steps.set(String(r.id), Number(r.updated_at))
    this.keysRev = this.rev()
    this.holders = this.src.holders()
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), this.intervalMs)
    this.timer.unref?.()
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer)
    this.timer = null
  }

  /** What this process pushed itself, so it is not pushed again. */
  saw(p: Push): void {
    if (p.type === "event") this.maxEvent = Math.max(this.maxEvent, p.event.id)
    else if (p.type === "task") this.tasks.set(p.task.id, p.task.updatedAt)
    else if (p.type === "step") this.steps.set(p.step.id, p.step.updatedAt)
    else if (p.type === "project") this.projects.set(p.project.id, p.project.updatedAt)
    else if (p.type === "patch") this.patches.set(p.patch.id, p.patch.state)
    else if (p.type === "taskDeleted") this.tasks.delete(p.id)
    else if (p.type === "projectDeleted") this.projects.delete(p.id)
  }

  /** One look: the lock files, then the database when another connection committed. Returns how much it pushed. */
  tick(): number {
    let pushed = 0
    try {
      const holders = this.src.holders()
      if (holders !== this.holders) {
        this.holders = holders
        for (const id of this.projects.keys()) pushed += this.emit({ type: "project", project: this.src.project(id) })
      }
      const v = this.dataVersion()
      if (v === this.version) return pushed
      // Taken as seen only once the diff went through: one that failed part-way is read again at the next tick.
      pushed += this.diff()
      this.version = v
      return pushed
    } catch {
      // The database closed under the timer at shutdown, or a row went between two reads: the next tick looks again.
      return pushed
    }
  }

  private emit(p: Push): number {
    this.saw(p)
    this.src.push(p)
    return 1
  }

  private diff(): number {
    const d = this.db()
    let n = 0
    const since = this.cursor - SLACK_MS
    const touched = new Set<string>()

    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE updated_at >= ?").all(since) as Row[]) {
      const id = String(r.id)
      this.cursor = Math.max(this.cursor, Number(r.updated_at))
      if (this.projects.get(id) !== Number(r.updated_at)) n += this.emit({ type: "project", project: this.src.project(id) })
    }
    const projectIds = new Set((d.prepare("SELECT id FROM projects").all() as Row[]).map((r) => String(r.id)))
    for (const id of [...this.projects.keys()]) if (!projectIds.has(id)) n += this.emit({ type: "projectDeleted", id })

    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT id, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE updated_at >= ?").all(since) as Row[]) {
      const id = String(r.id)
      this.cursor = Math.max(this.cursor, Number(r.updated_at))
      if (this.tasks.get(id) !== Number(r.updated_at)) {
        touched.add(id)
        n += this.emit({ type: "task", task: this.src.task(id) })
      }
    }
    const taskIds = new Set((d.prepare("SELECT id FROM tasks").all() as Row[]).map((r) => String(r.id)))
    for (const id of [...this.tasks.keys()]) if (!taskIds.has(id)) n += this.emit({ type: "taskDeleted", id })

    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT * FROM steps WHERE updated_at >= ?").all(since) as Row[]) {
      if (this.steps.get(String(r.id)) === Number(r.updated_at)) continue
      touched.add(String(r.task_id))
      n += this.emit({ type: "step", step: this.src.step(r) })
    }

    for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT * FROM events WHERE id > ? ORDER BY id").all(this.maxEvent) as Row[]) {
      touched.add(String(r.task_id))
      n += this.emit({ type: "event", event: this.src.event(r) })
    }

    for (const taskId of touched)
      for (const r of d.prepare("SELECT * FROM patches WHERE task_id = ?").all(taskId) as Row[])
        if (this.patches.get(String(r.id)) !== String(r.state)) n += this.emit({ type: "patch", patch: this.src.patch(r) })

    const rev = this.rev()
    if (rev !== this.keysRev) {
      this.keysRev = rev
      this.src.keysChanged()
    }
    return n
  }
}
```

`src/main/window.ts`:

```ts
import { isAppPage } from "./ipc"

/* The window's hardening: what the renderer may do and where it may go. Its CSP is in csp.ts. */

/** The part of `webContents` the lock needs, so a test can pass a fake. */
export interface Contents {
  on(event: "will-navigate", listener: (e: { preventDefault(): void }, url: string) => void): void
  setWindowOpenHandler(handler: (details: { url: string }) => { action: "deny" }): void
}

/** The renderer reaches neither Node nor the machine. */
export function webPreferences(preload: string) {
  return {
    preload,
    contextIsolation: true,
    sandbox: true,
    nodeIntegration: false,
    nodeIntegrationInWorker: false,
    webSecurity: true,
    webviewTag: false,
    spellcheck: false,
  } as const
}

/** The window never navigates away from the app's page and never opens another window. */
export function lockNavigation(contents: Contents, page: string): void {
  contents.on("will-navigate", (e, url) => {
    if (!isAppPage(url, page)) e.preventDefault()
  })
  contents.setWindowOpenHandler(() => ({ action: "deny" }))
}
```

`src/preload/index.ts`:

```ts
import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from "electron"
import { API_METHODS, type Api, type Bridge } from "@shared/api"
import type { Push } from "@shared/types"

const api = Object.fromEntries(API_METHODS.map((m) => [m, (...args: unknown[]) => ipcRenderer.invoke("api", m, ...args)])) as unknown as Api

const bridge: Bridge = {
  api,
  onPush(fn) {
    const listener = (_: unknown, p: Push) => fn(p)
    ipcRenderer.on("push", listener)
    return () => {
      ipcRenderer.removeListener("push", listener)
    }
  },
}

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("hfr", bridge)
```

`src/renderer/src/App.tsx`:

```tsx
import { AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, FolderKanban, Lock, Plus, Settings as SettingsIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
import type { ProjectRow, Readiness, TaskRow } from "@shared/types"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"
import { tone } from "@/lib/format"
import { foldProjects, heldLabel, tasksOf } from "@/lib/projects"
import { foldTasks } from "@/lib/store"
import { NewProject } from "@/views/NewProject"
import { ProjectView } from "@/views/ProjectView"
import { SettingsView } from "@/views/Settings"
import { SetupView } from "@/views/Setup"
import { TaskView } from "@/views/TaskView"

/*
  The shell: the first-run setup until it is completed (specs/onboarding R1.1); then the projects on the left, each with
  its tasks (specs/projects R4.1), the selected view on the right, and a banner naming a setup step that stopped being
  ready (specs/onboarding R2.1).
*/

type View = { kind: "new" } | { kind: "settings" } | { kind: "setup" } | { kind: "project"; id: string } | { kind: "task"; id: string }

export function App() {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>({ kind: "new" })
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<TaskRow[]>([])
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectRow[]>([])
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({})
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
  const [readiness, setReadiness] = useState<Readiness | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getSettings().then((s) => setCompleted(s.setupCompleted))
    void api.listTasks({ limit: 200 }).then(setTasks)
    void api.listProjects().then((list) => {
      setProjects(list)
      if (list[0]) setView((v) => (v.kind === "new" ? { kind: "project", id: list[0].id } : v))
    })
    return window.hfr.onPush((p) => {
      setTasks((list) => foldTasks(list, p))
      setProjects((list) => foldProjects(list, p))
    })
  }, [api])

  // Once the setup is completed, its steps are checked again whenever the sandbox or the sign-in moves.
  const check = useCallback(() => void api.readiness().then(setReadiness, () => undefined), [api])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!completed) return
    check()
    return window.hfr.onPush((p) => (p.type === "sandbox" || p.type === "login") && check())
  }, [completed, check])

  const openTask = (id: string) => setView({ kind: "task", id })
  const openProject = (id: string) => {
    setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [id]: true }))
    setView({ kind: "project", id })
  }

  if (completed === null) return null
  if (!completed)
    return (
      <main className="h-full overflow-y-auto">
        <SetupView
          onDone={() => {
            setCompleted(true)
            setView({ kind: "new" })
          }}
        />
      </main>
    )

  const blocked = readiness && !readiness.ready ? [readiness.sandbox, readiness.claude, readiness.model].find((s) => !s.ready) : undefined
  const current = view.kind === "task" ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === view.id)?.projectId : view.kind === "project" ? view.id : null
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full">
      <aside className="flex w-72 shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-border bg-card">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 pt-4 pb-3">
          <img src="./icon.png" alt="" className="size-8 rounded-lg" />
          <div>
            <div className="text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight">Harness for REA</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">orchestrator · sandboxed specialist</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 px-2">
          <NavButton active={view.kind === "new"} onClick={() => setView({ kind: "new" })} icon={<Plus size={15} />} label="New project" />
        </nav>
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 pb-2 text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">
          <FolderKanban size={13} /> Projects
        </div>
        <ul className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-3">
          {projects.length === 0 && <li className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">No project yet. What you create shows up here.</li>}
          {projects.map((p) => {
            const expanded = open[p.id] ?? p.id === current
            const own = tasksOf(tasks, p.id)
            return (
              <li key={p.id} className="mb-0.5">
                <div className={cn("flex items-center rounded-md hover:bg-accent", view.kind === "project" && view.id === p.id && "bg-muted")}>
                  <button
                    aria-label={expanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
                    onClick={() => setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [p.id]: !expanded }))}
                    className="p-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                  >
                    {expanded ? <ChevronDown size={14} /> : <ChevronRight size={14} />}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => openProject(p.id)} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 py-1.5 pr-2 text-left text-[13px]">
                    <span className="truncate font-medium">{p.name}</span>
                    {heldLabel(p) && (
                      <span title={heldLabel(p)!} aria-label={heldLabel(p)!} className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">
                        <Lock size={11} />
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{own.length}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                {expanded && (
                  <ul className="ml-5 border-l border-border pl-1.5">
                    {own.length === 0 && <li className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">No task yet.</li>}
                    {own.map((t) => (
                      <li key={t.id}>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openTask(t.id)}
                          className={cn(
                            "flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left hover:bg-accent",
                            view.kind === "task" && view.id === t.id && "bg-muted",
                          )}
                        >
                          <span className="line-clamp-1 flex-1 text-[12px]">{t.request}</span>
                          <Badge variant={tone(t.state)} className="shrink-0 px-1.5 text-[10px]">
                            {t.state}
                          </Badge>
                        </button>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="border-t border-border p-2">
          <NavButton active={view.kind === "settings"} onClick={() => setView({ kind: "settings" })} icon={<SettingsIcon size={15} />} label="Settings" />
        </div>
      </aside>
      <main className="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        {blocked && view.kind !== "setup" && (
          <div role="alert" className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 px-6 py-2.5 text-sm text-warning">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0" />
            <span className="flex-1">{blocked.reason} No task starts until it is fixed.</span>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setView({ kind: "setup" })}>
              Fix it
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
        {view.kind === "setup" && (
          <SetupView
            again
            onDone={() => {
              check()
              setView({ kind: "new" })
            }}
          />
        )}
        {view.kind === "new" && <NewProject onCreated={(p) => openProject(p.id)} />}
        {view.kind === "project" && <ProjectView key={view.id} id={view.id} onOpenTask={openTask} onDeleted={() => setView({ kind: "new" })} />}
        {view.kind === "settings" && <SettingsView onSetup={() => setView({ kind: "setup" })} />}
        {view.kind === "task" && (
          <TaskView key={view.id} id={view.id} onOpen={openTask} onDeleted={() => setView(current ? { kind: "project", id: current } : { kind: "new" })} />
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

function NavButton({ active, onClick, icon, label }: { active: boolean; onClick(): void; icon: React.ReactNode; label: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn("flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-accent", active && "bg-muted text-primary")}
    >
      {icon}
      {label}
    </button>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/DelegationCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Brain, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, MessageSquareText, Wrench } from "lucide-react"
import { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import type { ContextPackage, Evidence } from "@shared/context"
import type { EventRow, PatchView, StepRow } from "@shared/types"
import Markdown from "@/components/Markdown"
import Prose from "@/components/Prose"
import { Mono } from "@/components/common"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible"
import type { SpecialistEntry } from "@/lib/timeline"
import { tone } from "@/lib/format"
import { filesOfStep } from "@/lib/store"

/*
  One delegation: its context package, the specialist's own run nested under it (specs/chat-timeline R1.1),
  its report and evidence, and the files it touched (specs/desktop-ui R2.3).
*/

export function DelegationCard({ step, events, patches, run = [] }: { step: StepRow; events: EventRow[]; patches: PatchView[]; run?: SpecialistEntry[] }) {
  // Open from the start, with the run and reasoning under it (specs/chat-timeline R1.2).
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true)
  const files = useMemo(() => filesOfStep(events, step.id), [events, step.id])
  const pkg = step.data.context as ContextPackage | undefined
  const report = typeof step.data.report === "string" ? step.data.report : ""
  const evidence = (step.data.evidence as Evidence[] | undefined) ?? []
  const error = typeof step.data.error === "string" ? step.data.error : ""
  const patch = patches.find((p) => p.stepId === step.id)

  return (
    <Card>
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-left">
        {open ? <ChevronDown size={15} /> : <ChevronRight size={15} />}
        <Badge variant="info">specialist</Badge>
        <Badge variant={tone(step.state)}>{step.state}</Badge>
        {pkg && <Badge>{pkg.mode}</Badge>}
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-medium">{step.title}</span>
        {patch && <Badge variant={patch.state === "applied" ? "ok" : patch.state === "proposed" ? "warn" : "neutral"}>patch {patch.state}</Badge>}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-t border-border p-4">
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          {pkg && (
            <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Context package</h4>
              {pkg.brief && <Prose text={pkg.brief} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-background p-3 text-muted-foreground" />}
              <Prose text={pkg.objective} />
              <List title="Questions" items={pkg.questions} />
              <List title="Constraints" items={pkg.constraints} />
              <List title="Environment" items={pkg.environment} />
              <List title="Excerpts" items={pkg.excerpts.map((e) => `${e.path}:${e.startLine}-${e.endLine}${e.note ? ` — ${e.note}` : ""}`)} mono />
            </section>
          )}
          {run.length > 0 && (
            <section className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Specialist's run ({run.length})</h4>
              {run.map((e) => (
                <RunEntry key={e.id} entry={e} />
              ))}
            </section>
          )}
          <section className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <Files title="Copied in" items={files.copy} />
            <Files title="Read" items={files.read} />
            <Files title="Written" items={files.write} />
            <Files title="Applied" items={files.apply} />
          </section>
          {report && (
            <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Report</h4>
              <Markdown text={report} className="max-h-[480px] overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-background p-3" />
            </section>
          )}
          {evidence.length > 0 && (
            <section className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">Evidence</h4>
              {evidence.map((e, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                  <Badge variant={e.kind === "rea" ? "info" : e.checked ? "ok" : "bad"} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0">
                    {e.kind === "rea" ? (e.ref?.startsWith("unk_") ? "REA unknown, cited" : "REA evidence, cited") : e.checked ? "in package" : "unverified"}
                  </Badge>
                  <Mono className="shrink-0 text-primary" title={e.ref}>
                    {evidenceLabel(e)}
                  </Mono>
                  <span>{e.claim}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

const ICONS = { text: MessageSquareText, thinking: Brain, tool: Wrench, result: MessageSquareText, note: ChevronRight }

/** One entry of the specialist's run — its text, reasoning or tool call — shown open (specs/chat-timeline R1.2). */
function RunEntry({ entry }: { entry: SpecialistEntry }) {
  const Icon = ICONS[entry.kind]
  const running = entry.kind === "tool" && entry.output === undefined
  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen className="rounded border bg-background/60">
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="group flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground [&_svg]:shrink-0">
        <Icon size={12} />
        {entry.subagent && <Badge>{entry.subagent}</Badge>}
        <span className={entry.failed ? "truncate text-destructive" : "truncate text-foreground"}>{entry.title}</span>
        {running && <Badge variant="info">running{entry.elapsedSeconds ? ` · ${entry.elapsedSeconds}s` : ""}</Badge>}
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="border-t px-2.5 py-2">
        <pre className="max-h-64 overflow-auto font-mono text-[11.5px] leading-5 break-all whitespace-pre-wrap">{entry.body || "—"}</pre>
        {entry.output !== undefined && (
          <pre className="mt-2 max-h-64 overflow-auto border-t pt-2 font-mono text-[11.5px] leading-5 break-all whitespace-pre-wrap">{entry.output || "—"}</pre>
        )}
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  )
}

function List({ title, items, mono }: { title: string; items: string[]; mono?: boolean }) {
  if (!items.length) return null
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{title}</div>
      <ul className="ml-4 list-disc text-sm">
        {items.map((x, i) => (
          <li key={i}>{mono ? <Mono>{x}</Mono> : x}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

function Files({ title, items }: { title: string; items: string[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-border bg-background p-2.5">
      <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {title} <span className="font-mono">{items.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        {items.map((f) => (
          <li key={f} className="truncate font-mono text-[11px]" title={f}>
            {f}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Where a piece of evidence points: a line range, an address in a file, or an REA id shortened for the eye (specs/rea-native R3). */
function evidenceLabel(e: Evidence): string {
  if (e.kind === "rea") return `${e.ref?.slice(0, 16)}…`
  if (e.kind === "address") return `${e.path}@${e.ref}`
  return `${e.path}:${e.startLine}-${e.endLine}`
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/EventLog.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { EventRow, StepRow } from "@shared/types"
import { Mono, PanelHeader } from "@/components/common"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"
import { clock, tone } from "@/lib/format"

/* Every event of the task as it arrives, filterable by agent, each expandable to its payload (specs/desktop-ui R2.2). */

const AGENTS = ["all", "orchestrator", "specialist", "sandbox", "app"] as const

export function EventLogPanel({ events, steps }: { events: EventRow[]; steps: StepRow[] }) {
  const [agent, setAgent] = useState<(typeof AGENTS)[number]>("all")
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(true)
  const end = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const shown = useMemo(() => (agent === "all" ? events : events.filter((e) => e.agent === agent)), [events, agent])
  const titles = useMemo(() => new Map(steps.map((s) => [s.id, s.title])), [steps])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (follow && shown.length) end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })
  }, [shown.length, follow])

  return (
    <Card>
      <PanelHeader
        title={`Event log (${events.length})`}
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {AGENTS.map((a) => (
              <button
                key={a}
                onClick={() => setAgent(a)}
                className={cn("rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs", agent === a ? "bg-muted text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")}
              >
                {a}
              </button>
            ))}
            <Label className="ml-2 gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <Checkbox checked={follow} onCheckedChange={(v) => setFollow(v === true)} /> follow
            </Label>
          </div>
        }
      />
      <div className="max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto font-mono text-[12px]">
        {shown.map((e) => (
          <div key={e.id} className="border-b border-border/60">
            <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === e.id ? null : e.id)} className="flex w-full items-start gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-left hover:bg-accent">
              <span className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">{clock(e.at)}</span>
              <span className={cn("w-20 shrink-0", e.agent === "specialist" ? "text-primary" : e.agent === "sandbox" ? "text-warning" : "text-foreground/70")}>
                {e.agent}
              </span>
              <span className="w-40 shrink-0 truncate text-muted-foreground">{e.kind}</span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{e.summary}</span>
              {e.state && <Badge variant={tone(e.state)}>{e.state}</Badge>}
            </button>
            {open === e.id && (
              <div className="bg-background px-3 pb-2">
                {e.stepId && <div className="pt-1 text-muted-foreground">step: {titles.get(e.stepId) ?? e.stepId}</div>}
                {e.truncated && <div className="text-warning">payload truncated</div>}
                <Mono className="block pt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all text-foreground/80">{JSON.stringify(e.payload, null, 2)}</Mono>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        <div ref={end} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/Markdown.tsx`:

```tsx
import ReactMarkdown, { type Components } from "react-markdown"
import remarkGfm from "remark-gfm"
import { highlight, SYNTAX } from "@/lib/highlight"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

/*
  A message of the conversation as markdown (specs/chat R7.6): GitHub-flavoured markdown through react-markdown, raw
  HTML never interpreted, links shown rather than followed and images replaced by their text — the agents' words can
  quote the target, and nothing in them may reach the network or the window. Code blocks are colored by the
  highlighter the TUI draws with too.
*/

/** The text under a hast node. */
type HastNode = { type: string; value?: string; tagName?: string; properties?: Record<string, unknown>; children?: HastNode[] }
const textOf = (n: HastNode): string => (n.type === "text" ? (n.value ?? "") : (n.children ?? []).map(textOf).join(""))

export function CodeBlock({ code, lang }: { code: string; lang?: string | null }) {
  const lines = highlight(code.replace(/\n$/, ""), lang)
  return (
    <pre className="my-2 max-h-[480px] overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-background p-3 font-mono text-[12.5px] leading-5">
      <code>
        {lines.map((line, i) => (
          <span key={i} className="block min-h-5 whitespace-pre">
            {line.map((t, j) => (
              <span key={j} style={t.tag ? { color: SYNTAX[t.tag] } : undefined} className={t.tag === "comment" ? "italic" : undefined}>
                {t.text}
              </span>
            ))}
          </span>
        ))}
      </code>
    </pre>
  )
}

const components: Components = {
  pre: ({ node }) => {
    const code = (node?.children?.[0] ?? null) as HastNode | null
    const classes = (code?.properties?.className as string[] | undefined) ?? []
    const lang = classes.find((c) => c.startsWith("language-"))?.slice("language-".length) ?? null
    return <CodeBlock code={code ? textOf(code) : ""} lang={lang} />
  },
  code: ({ children }) => <code className="rounded bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[12.5px]">{children}</code>,
  a: ({ children, href }) => (
    <span className="text-primary underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-2" title={href}>
      {children}
    </span>
  ),
  img: ({ alt }) => <span className="text-muted-foreground">[image{alt ? `: ${alt}` : ""}]</span>,
  table: ({ children }) => (
    <div className="my-2 overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[13px]">{children}</table>
    </div>
  ),
  th: ({ children }) => <th className="border border-border bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-left font-medium">{children}</th>,
  td: ({ children }) => <td className="border border-border px-2 py-1 align-top">{children}</td>,
}

export default function Markdown({ text, className }: { text: string; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("markdown text-sm leading-relaxed break-words", className)}>
      <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} skipHtml components={components}>
        {text}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react"
import { useState } from "react"
import type { PatchView } from "@shared/types"
import { Mono, PanelHeader } from "@/components/common"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"
import { diffLines } from "@/lib/format"

/* A proposed patch: its files and diff, approved or rejected by the user (specs/desktop-ui R2.4). */

const LINE: Record<string, string> = {
  add: "bg-success/10 text-success",
  del: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
  hunk: "text-primary",
  file: "text-muted-foreground font-semibold",
  ctx: "text-foreground/80",
}

export function PatchReview({ patch, onDecide }: { patch: PatchView; onDecide(d: "approve" | "reject"): Promise<void> }) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const decide = async (d: "approve" | "reject") => {
    setBusy(true)
    await onDecide(d)
    setBusy(false)
  }
  return (
    <Card className="border-warning/50">
      <PanelHeader
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Badge variant="warn">approval needed</Badge> The specialist proposes changes to {patch.files.length} file(s)
          </span>
        }
        actions={
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => decide("reject")}>
              <X size={14} /> Reject
            </Button>
            <Button variant="success" size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => decide("approve")}>
              <Check size={14} /> Approve and apply
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />
      <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 px-4 pt-3 text-sm">
        {patch.files.map((f) => (
          <li key={f.path} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Badge>{f.status}</Badge>
            <Mono>{f.path}</Mono>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-success">+{f.added}</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-destructive">-{f.removed}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <pre className="m-4 max-h-[420px] overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-background py-2 font-mono text-[12px] leading-5">
        {diffLines(patch.diff).map((l, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={cn("px-3 whitespace-pre", LINE[l.kind])}>
            {l.text || " "}
          </div>
        ))}
      </pre>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/chat/ApprovalCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Check, Pencil, ShieldAlert, X } from "lucide-react"
import { useState } from "react"
import type { ToolDecision } from "@shared/chat"
import type { PatchView } from "@shared/types"
import { ErrorText, Mono } from "@/components/common"
import { PatchReview } from "@/components/PatchReview"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import { parseArgs, type ApprovalItem, type GatedCall } from "@/lib/chat"

/*
  Gated tool calls waiting on the user (specs/chat R4.3, R7.3): each shown with its arguments and
  approved, edited or rejected; a patch shows its diff and is approved or rejected as proposed.
*/

type Decide = (callId: string, d: ToolDecision) => Promise<void>

export function ApprovalCard({ item, patches, onDecide }: { item: ApprovalItem; patches: PatchView[]; onDecide: Decide }) {
  return (
    <div className="ml-10 flex flex-col gap-2">
      {item.calls.map((c) => {
        const patch = c.name === "apply_patch" ? patches.find((p) => p.id === c.args.patchId) : undefined
        if (c.decision) return <Decided key={c.callId} call={c} />
        if (patch) return <PatchReview key={c.callId} patch={patch} onDecide={(d) => onDecide(c.callId, { type: d })} />
        return <PendingCall key={c.callId} call={c} onDecide={onDecide} />
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

function Decided({ call }: { call: GatedCall }) {
  const d = call.decision!
  const variant = d.type === "approve" ? "ok" : d.type === "edit" ? "info" : "bad"
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
      <ShieldAlert size={13} />
      <Mono className="text-foreground">{call.name}</Mono>
      <Badge variant={variant}>{d.type === "approve" ? "approved" : d.type === "edit" ? "edited" : "rejected"}</Badge>
      {call.origin && call.origin !== "user" && <span>({call.origin})</span>}
      {d.type === "reject" && d.message && <span className="truncate">“{d.message}”</span>}
    </div>
  )
}

function PendingCall({ call, onDecide }: { call: GatedCall; onDecide: Decide }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"view" | "edit" | "reject">("view")
  const [args, setArgs] = useState(() => JSON.stringify(call.args, null, 2))
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("")
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const decide = async (d: ToolDecision) => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError("")
    try {
      await onDecide(call.callId, d)
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }
  const saveEdit = () => {
    const parsed = parseArgs(args)
    if ("error" in parsed) setError(parsed.error)
    else void decide({ type: "edit", args: parsed.args })
  }

  return (
    <Card className="border-warning/50">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Badge variant="warn">approval needed</Badge>
          <span>
            The orchestrator wants to run <Mono>{call.name}</Mono>
          </span>
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {mode === "edit" ? (
          <Textarea
            aria-label="Arguments"
            rows={Math.min(14, args.split("\n").length + 1)}
            className="font-mono text-xs"
            value={args}
            onChange={(e) => setArgs(e.target.value)}
          />
        ) : (
          <pre className="max-h-64 overflow-auto rounded border bg-background p-2 font-mono text-[11.5px] leading-5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
            {JSON.stringify(call.args, null, 2)}
          </pre>
        )}
        {mode === "reject" && (
          <Input
            autoFocus
            aria-label="Why"
            placeholder="Why not, or what to do instead (optional)"
            value={message}
            onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
          />
        )}
        <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-end">
        {mode === "view" && (
          <>
            <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode("reject")}>
              <X size={14} /> Reject
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode("edit")}>
              <Pencil size={13} /> Edit
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="success" disabled={busy} onClick={() => decide({ type: "approve" })}>
              <Check size={14} /> Approve
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
        {mode !== "view" && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => (setMode("view"), setError(""))}>
            Back
          </Button>
        )}
        {mode === "edit" && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="default" disabled={busy} onClick={saveEdit}>
            <Check size={14} /> Run with these arguments
          </Button>
        )}
        {mode === "reject" && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => decide(message.trim() ? { type: "reject", message: message.trim() } : { type: "reject" })}
          >
            <X size={14} /> Reject
          </Button>
        )}
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/chat/Composer.tsx`:

```tsx
import { CircleStop, Loader2, Play, SendHorizontal } from "lucide-react"
import { useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react"
import type { TaskState } from "@shared/types"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"
import { canContinue, canSend, canStop, turnLabel } from "@/lib/chat"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

/*
  The turn's state and the message box under the conversation (specs/chat R7.2, R7.5): open while a
  turn runs or waits, with stop while one is under way and continue once it is stopped.
*/

export function Composer({
  state,
  waitingOn,
  onSend,
  onStop,
  onContinue,
}: {
  state: TaskState
  waitingOn: number
  onSend(text: string): Promise<boolean>
  onStop(): void
  onContinue(): void
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState("")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const open = canSend(state)

  const send = async () => {
    const t = text.trim()
    if (!t || busy) return
    setBusy(true)
    if (await onSend(t)) setText("")
    setBusy(false)
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
      e.preventDefault()
      void send()
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="border-t bg-card/60 px-6 py-3">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
        {canStop(state) && <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin text-primary" />}
        <span
          className={cn(
            state === "awaiting-user" ? "font-medium text-success" : state === "waiting" || state === "stopped" ? "text-warning" : "text-muted-foreground",
          )}
        >
          {turnLabel(state, waitingOn)}
        </span>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
          {canStop(state) && (
            <Tooltip>
              <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" onClick={onStop}>
                  <CircleStop size={13} /> Stop
                </Button>
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent>Stop the turn. The conversation stays open and the turn can be continued.</TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          {canContinue(state) && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="default" onClick={onContinue}>
              <Play size={13} /> Continue
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
        <Textarea
          aria-label="Message"
          rows={2}
          disabled={!open}
          value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
          className="max-h-48 min-h-[44px] resize-none"
          placeholder={
            !open
              ? "Retry the task to start a new conversation."
              : state === "awaiting-user"
                ? "Reply to the orchestrator…"
                : "Add a message while it works… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)"
          }
        />
        <Button size="icon" variant="default" aria-label="Send" disabled={!open || busy || !text.trim()} onClick={send}>
          <SendHorizontal size={16} />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import type { EventRow, PatchView, StepRow } from "@shared/types"
import { DelegationCard } from "@/components/DelegationCard"
import Markdown from "@/components/Markdown"

/* The plain entries of the conversation: the user's and the agent's messages, a tool call, a notice (specs/chat R7.1). */

/** What a tool call needs to show the delegation it started: the steps, the loaded events, the patches and each run. */
export interface ToolContext {
  steps: StepRow[]
  events: EventRow[]
  patches: PatchView[]
  run(stepId: string): SpecialistEntry[]
}

export function ToolCall({ item, ctx }: { item: ToolItem; ctx: ToolContext }) {
  const step = item.name === "delegate_to_specialist" ? stepOf(item, ctx.steps) : undefined
  if (step) return <DelegationCard step={step} events={ctx.events} patches={ctx.patches} run={ctx.run(step.id)} />
  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen className="rounded-md border bg-card/60">
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="group flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground [&_svg]:shrink-0">
        <ChevronRight size={13} className="transition-transform group-data-[state=open]:rotate-90" />
        <Wrench size={12} />
        <span className="font-mono text-foreground">{item.name}</span>
        {item.output === undefined ? (
          <Badge variant="info">running</Badge>
        ) : item.failed ? (
          <Badge variant="bad">failed</Badge>
        ) : (
          <span className="truncate">{oneLine(item.output)}</span>
        )}
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="border-t px-3 py-2">
        <Payload label="Input" text={item.input} />
        {item.output !== undefined && <Payload label="Result" text={item.output} />}
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  )
}

/** A run of the orchestrator's tool calls, shown open and folded on request (specs/chat-timeline R1.2). */
export function ToolRun({ items, ctx }: { items: ToolItem[]; ctx: ToolContext }) {
  if (items.length === 1)
    return (
      <div className="ml-10">
        <ToolCall item={items[0]} ctx={ctx} />
      </div>
    )
  const last = items.at(-1)!
  const running = last.output === undefined
  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen className="ml-10">
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="group flex w-full items-center gap-2 py-1 text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground [&_svg]:shrink-0">
        <ChevronRight size={13} className="transition-transform group-data-[state=open]:rotate-90" />
        <Wrench size={12} />
        <span>
          {items.length} tool calls{items.some((i) => i.failed) ? `, ${items.filter((i) => i.failed).length} failed` : ""}
        </span>
        <span className="truncate">
          · {running ? "running" : "last"} <span className="font-mono text-foreground">{last.name}</span>
        </span>
        {running && <Badge variant="info">running</Badge>}
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        {items.map((i) => (
          <ToolCall key={i.id} item={i} ctx={ctx} />
        ))}
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  )
}

function oneLine(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 120)
}

export function Payload({ label, text }: { label: string; text: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-2 last:mb-0">
      <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
      <pre className="max-h-64 overflow-auto rounded border bg-background p-2 font-mono text-[11.5px] leading-5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
        {text || "—"}
      </pre>
    </div>
  )
}

const NOTICE_TONE: Record<NoticeItem["tone"], string> = {
  neutral: "text-muted-foreground",
  warn: "text-warning",
  bad: "text-destructive",
}

export function Notice({ item }: { item: NoticeItem }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-3 text-xs", NOTICE_TONE[item.tone])}>
      <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
      {item.text}
      <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/chat/QuestionCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import { MessageCircleQuestion, Send } from "lucide-react"
import { useState } from "react"
import type { Answer } from "@shared/chat"
import { ErrorText } from "@/components/common"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import type { QuestionItem } from "@/lib/chat"

/* A question an agent asked, with the input its kind calls for (specs/chat R5.3, R7.4). */

const show = (a: Answer) => (typeof a === "boolean" ? (a ? "Yes" : "No") : String(a))

export function QuestionCard({ item, onAnswer }: { item: QuestionItem; onAnswer(a: Answer): Promise<void> }) {
  const { question: q } = item
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string>(q.kind === "yesno" ? "" : String(q.default))
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const answer = async (a: Answer) => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError("")
    try {
      await onAnswer(a)
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }
  const submit = () => {
    if (q.kind === "number") {
      const n = Number(value)
      if (value.trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(n)) return setError("Enter a number.")
      return void answer(n)
    }
    void answer(value)
  }

  const who = item.agent === "specialist" ? "The specialist" : "The orchestrator"
  if (item.origin)
    return (
      <div className="ml-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <MessageCircleQuestion size={13} />
        <span className="text-foreground">{q.prompt}</span>
        <Badge variant={item.origin === "user" || item.origin === "orchestrator" ? "ok" : "neutral"}>{show(item.answer!)}</Badge>
        {item.origin === "orchestrator" && <span>(answered by the orchestrator)</span>}
        {item.origin !== "user" && item.origin !== "orchestrator" && <span>(default, {item.origin})</span>}
      </div>
    )

  return (
    <Card className="ml-10 border-primary/40">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <MessageCircleQuestion size={15} className="text-primary" />
          {who} asks
        </CardTitle>
        <Badge variant="info">{item.agent}</Badge>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap">{q.prompt}</p>
          <CardDescription className="mt-1">{q.reason}</CardDescription>
        </div>
        {q.kind === "choice" && (
          <RadioGroup value={value} onValueChange={setValue} aria-label={q.prompt}>
            {(q.choices ?? []).map((c) => (
              <Label key={c} className="font-normal">
                <RadioGroupItem value={c} /> {c}
              </Label>
            ))}
          </RadioGroup>
        )}
        {q.kind === "number" && <Input type="number" aria-label={q.prompt} value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} className="w-48" />}
        {q.kind === "text" && <Textarea aria-label={q.prompt} rows={3} value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} />}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">If you do not answer in time, the agent goes on with: {show(q.default)}</p>
        <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-end">
        {q.kind === "yesno" ? (
          <>
            <Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => answer(false)}>
              No
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="default" disabled={busy} onClick={() => answer(true)}>
              Yes
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Button size="sm" variant="default" disabled={busy} onClick={submit}>
            <Send size={13} /> Answer
          </Button>
        )}
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/chat/VirtualTimeline.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area"
import { addedAbove, atEnd, keepInPlace, offsets, slice } from "@/lib/virtual"

/*
  The timeline rendered through a window (specs/chat-timeline R3.1): only the entries near the
  viewport are mounted, each measured once on screen, the rest held by the space they take. An
  entry above the viewport that grows or shrinks moves the scroll by as much, so what is read stays
  where it is: an older page added above keeps the content in place (R2.3), and while the user is at
  the end the timeline follows it.
*/

const ESTIMATE = 72
const OVERSCAN = 800

export function VirtualTimeline<T extends { id: string }>({
  entries,
  render,
  onNearTop,
  top,
  bottom,
}: {
  entries: T[]
  render(entry: T): ReactNode
  onNearTop?(): void
  /** shown above the entries, e.g. that older ones are loading */
  top?: ReactNode
  /** shown under the entries, outside the window */
  bottom?: ReactNode
}) {
  const viewport = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [heights, setHeights] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, number>>(() => new Map())
  const [view, setView] = useState({ top: 0, height: 800 })
  const ids = useMemo(() => entries.map((e) => e.id), [entries])
  const offs = useMemo(() => offsets(ids, heights, ESTIMATE), [ids, heights])
  const layout = useRef({ ids, offs })
  const nearTop = useRef(onNearTop)
  const stick = useRef(true)
  /** height changes of entries above what is read, not yet applied to the scroll */
  const shift = useRef(0)

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    nearTop.current = onNearTop
  }, [onNearTop])

  /** A row's measured height; an entry above what is read moves the scroll with it once the layout has it. */
  const onSize = useCallback((id: string, height: number) => {
    const { ids: at, offs: by } = layout.current
    const i = at.indexOf(id)
    if (i >= 0 && by[i + 1] <= (viewport.current?.scrollTop ?? 0)) shift.current += height - (by[i + 1] - by[i])
    setHeights((cur) => {
      if (cur.get(id) === height) return cur
      const next = new Map(cur)
      next.set(id, height)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = viewport.current
    if (!el) return
    const update = () => {
      stick.current = atEnd(el.scrollTop, el.clientHeight, el.scrollHeight)
      setView((v) => (v.top === el.scrollTop && v.height === el.clientHeight ? v : { top: el.scrollTop, height: el.clientHeight }))
      if (el.scrollTop < OVERSCAN) nearTop.current?.()
    }
    update()
    el.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true })
    const size = new ResizeObserver(update)
    size.observe(el)
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener("scroll", update)
      size.disconnect()
    }
  }, [])

  // After every layout: entries added above move the scroll by their height; at the end, stay at the end.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const before = layout.current
    layout.current = { ids, offs }
    const el = viewport.current
    if (!el) return
    const added = addedAbove(before.ids, before.offs, ids, offs)
    if (added) el.scrollTop = keepInPlace(el.scrollTop, 0, added)
    else if (stick.current) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight
    else if (shift.current) el.scrollTop += shift.current
    shift.current = 0
    // Still near the top after a page went in: no scroll event will come, so ask for the next one now.
    if (added && el.scrollTop < OVERSCAN) nearTop.current?.()
  }, [ids, offs])

  const s = slice(offs, view.top, view.height, OVERSCAN)
  return (
    <ScrollArea className="min-h-0 flex-1" viewportRef={viewport}>
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl flex-col px-6 py-5">
        {top}
        <div style={{ paddingTop: s.before, paddingBottom: s.after }}>
          {entries.slice(s.start, s.end).map((e) => (
            <Row key={e.id} id={e.id} onSize={onSize}>
              {render(e)}
            </Row>
          ))}
        </div>
        {bottom}
      </div>
    </ScrollArea>
  )
}

function Row({ id, onSize, children }: { id: string; onSize(id: string, height: number): void; children: ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const size = new ResizeObserver(([row]) => onSize(id, row.borderBoxSize?.[0]?.blockSize ?? el.offsetHeight))
    size.observe(el)
    return () => size.disconnect()
  }, [id, onSize])
  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-id={id} className="pb-4">
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import type { HTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react"
import { CardAction, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

/* The app's own small pieces, composed from the shadcn/ui components. */

/** A card's header row: a title and, on the right, its actions. */
export function PanelHeader({ title, actions, className }: { title: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <CardHeader className={className}>
      <CardTitle>{title}</CardTitle>
      {actions && <CardAction>{actions}</CardAction>}
    </CardHeader>
  )
}

export function Field({ label, hint, children }: { label: string; hint?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Label className="flex-col items-stretch gap-1.5 leading-normal">
      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      {children}
      {hint && <span className="text-xs leading-snug text-muted-foreground">{hint}</span>}
    </Label>
  )
}

export function Mono({ className, ...p }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) {
  return <code className={cn("font-mono text-[12px]", className)} {...p} />
}

export function ErrorText({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return children ? <p className="rounded-md border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-destructive">{children}</p> : null
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/setup/IntegrationsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, Plug, RefreshCw, Settings2, XCircle } from "lucide-react"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { IntegrationActionResult, IntegrationSettings, IntegrationStatus, IntegrationView } from "@shared/integrations"
import type { Settings } from "@shared/types"
import { ErrorText, Field, Mono } from "@/components/common"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch"
import { integrationRow, settingsOf, toolRows, withChoice, type Connection } from "@/lib/integrations"
import { message } from "./panels"

/*
  The MCP tab of Settings (specs/mcp-integrations R1, R2): the list of every integration the app carries, each off by
  default, with whether it is on and connected; Configure opens the integration's own page, with its settings, its
  switch, its checks and their fixes, its actions, and its tools with one toggle per agent. There is no way to add
  another.
*/

export function IntegrationsPanel({ settings, onSaved }: { settings: Settings; onSaved(s: Settings): void }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [views, setViews] = useState<IntegrationView[] | null>(null)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null)
  // Each integration's last status, fetched once per visit to the tab and kept while its page is open.
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<string, IntegrationStatus>>({})
  const asked = useRef(new Set<string>())
  const onStatus = useCallback((st: IntegrationStatus) => setStatuses((m) => ({ ...m, [st.id]: st })), [])
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  useEffect(() => {
    void api
      .integrations()
      .then(setViews)
      .catch((e: unknown) => setError(message(e)))
  }, [api])
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const v of views ?? []) {
      if (!settingsOf(v, settings.integrations).enabled || asked.current.has(v.id)) continue
      asked.current.add(v.id)
      void api
        .integrationStatus(v.id)
        .then(onStatus)
        // A status that could not be read shows as not connected, never as checking for ever.
        .catch(() => onStatus({ id: v.id, enabled: true, checks: [], connected: false }))
    }
  }, [api, views, settings.integrations, onStatus])
  if (!views) return <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
  const page = open ? views.find((v) => v.id === open) : undefined
  if (page) return <IntegrationPage view={page} settings={settings} onSaved={onSaved} onStatus={onStatus} onBack={() => setOpen(null)} />
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Engines on this machine the agents can use only through the app. Each is off until you turn it on, and every target they work on is yours to approve.
      </p>
      <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border rounded-md border border-border">
        {views.map((v) => (
          <ListRow key={v.id} view={v} settings={settings} status={statuses[v.id]} onConfigure={() => setOpen(v.id)} />
        ))}
      </ul>
      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
    </div>
  )
}

const CONNECTION: Record<Connection, { label: string; variant: "neutral" | "ok" | "warn" }> = {
  off: { label: "off", variant: "neutral" },
  checking: { label: "checking…", variant: "neutral" },
  connected: { label: "connected", variant: "ok" },
  "not connected": { label: "not connected", variant: "warn" },
}

function ListRow({ view, settings, status, onConfigure }: { view: IntegrationView; settings: Settings; status?: IntegrationStatus; onConfigure(): void }) {
  const row = integrationRow(view, settingsOf(view, settings.integrations), status)
  const c = CONNECTION[row.connection]
  return (
    <li className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plug size={14} />
          <span className="font-medium">{row.title}</span>
          <Badge variant={c.variant}>{c.label}</Badge>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{row.description}</p>
      </div>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="shrink-0" onClick={onConfigure}>
        <Settings2 size={13} /> Configure
      </Button>
    </li>
  )
}

function IntegrationPage({
  view,
  settings,
  onSaved,
  onStatus,
  onBack,
}: {
  view: IntegrationView
  settings: Settings
  onSaved(s: Settings): void
  onStatus(s: IntegrationStatus): void
  onBack(): void
}) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const s = settingsOf(view, settings.integrations)
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<IntegrationStatus | null>(null)
  const [action, setAction] = useState<IntegrationActionResult | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState("")

  const show = useCallback(
    (st: IntegrationStatus) => {
      setStatus(st)
      onStatus(st)
    },
    [onStatus],
  )
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => show(await api.integrationStatus(view.id)), [api, view.id, show])
  useEffect(() => {
    void api
      .integrationStatus(view.id)
      .then(show)
      .catch((e: unknown) => setError(message(e)))
  }, [api, view.id, show])

  const run = async (f: () => Promise<void>) => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError("")
    try {
      await f()
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }
  const save = (next: IntegrationSettings) =>
    run(async () => {
      onSaved(await api.saveSettings({ integrations: { [view.id]: next } }))
      // Turning it on ran its checks: show each, the failed ones with their fix (R1.2, R1.3).
      await refresh()
    })

  const rows = toolRows(view, s)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="w-fit" onClick={onBack}>
        <ArrowLeft size={13} /> MCP integrations
      </Button>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plug size={15} />
            <h2 className="font-medium">{view.title}</h2>
            {s.enabled && status && <Badge variant={status.connected ? "ok" : "warn"}>{status.connected ? "connected" : "not connected"}</Badge>}
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{view.description}</p>
        </div>
        <label className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <Switch checked={s.enabled} disabled={busy} onCheckedChange={(v) => void save({ ...s, enabled: v })} aria-label={`Turn ${view.title} on`} />
          {s.enabled ? "On" : "Off"}
        </label>
      </div>

      {view.fields.map((f) => (
        <Field key={f.key} label={f.label} hint={f.hint}>
          <Input
            defaultValue={String(s.config[f.key] ?? "")}
            disabled={busy}
            onBlur={(e) => e.target.value !== String(s.config[f.key] ?? "") && void save({ ...s, config: { ...s.config, [f.key]: e.target.value } })}
          />
        </Field>
      ))}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {view.actions.map((a) => (
          <Button
            key={a.id}
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={busy}
            title={a.description}
            onClick={() =>
              void run(async () => {
                setAction(await api.runIntegrationAction(view.id, a.id))
                await refresh()
              })
            }
          >
            {a.label}
          </Button>
        ))}
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(refresh)} aria-label="Run the checks">
          <RefreshCw size={13} /> Check
        </Button>
      </div>
      {action && (
        <div className={`rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-sm ${action.ok ? "border-border" : "border-warning/40 bg-warning/10"}`}>
          <p>{action.message}</p>
          {action.paths?.map((p) => (
            <p key={p.label} className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {p.label}: <Mono className="select-all">{p.path}</Mono>
            </p>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {status && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
          {status.checks.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.name} className="flex items-start gap-2">
              {c.ok ? <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-success" /> : <XCircle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-destructive" />}
              <span>
                <span className="font-medium">{c.name}</span> <span className="text-muted-foreground">{c.detail}</span>
                {!c.ok && c.fix && <span className="block text-xs">{c.fix}</span>}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="text-left text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <th className="py-1 font-medium">Tool</th>
            <th className="w-28 py-1 text-center font-medium">Orchestrator</th>
            <th className="w-28 py-1 text-center font-medium">Specialist</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.name} className="border-t border-border align-top">
              <td className="py-2 pr-3">
                <Mono>{r.name}</Mono>
                {r.target && <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">on the approved target</span>}
                <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.description}</span>
                {r.warn && (
                  <span className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1 text-xs text-warning">
                    <AlertTriangle size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                    What it returns goes to the orchestrator&apos;s model and its provider, with anything the target holds.
                  </span>
                )}
              </td>
              {(["orchestrator", "specialist"] as const).map((agent) => (
                <td key={agent} className="py-2 text-center">
                  <Switch
                    checked={r[agent]}
                    disabled={busy}
                    aria-label={`${r.name} for the ${agent}`}
                    onCheckedChange={(v) => void save(withChoice(view, s, r.name, agent, v))}
                  />
                </td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
    </div>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/components/setup/ModelPicker.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react"
import { groupModels, type ProviderId } from "@shared/providers"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"

/*
  The orchestrator's model as a list: the provider's recommended models first — Qwen's flash models by default — then, on
  OpenRouter, the Chinese coding models it lists with tool calling, then the rest; or a model typed by name.
*/

const OTHER = "\u0000other"

export function ModelPicker({ provider, value, listed, onChange }: { provider: ProviderId; value: string; listed: string[]; onChange(model: string): void }) {
  const groups = groupModels(provider, listed)
  const known = groups.some((g) => g.models.includes(value))
  const [typing, setTyping] = useState(!known && value !== "")
  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-64 flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
      <select
        aria-label="Model"
        value={typing ? OTHER : value}
        onChange={(e) => {
          if (e.target.value === OTHER) return setTyping(true)
          setTyping(false)
          onChange(e.target.value)
        }}
        className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 font-mono text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/30"
      >
        {groups.map((g) => (
          <optgroup key={g.label} label={g.label}>
            {g.models.map((m) => (
              <option key={m} value={m}>
                {m}
              </option>
            ))}
          </optgroup>
        ))}
        <option value={OTHER}>Another model, by name…</option>
      </select>
      {typing && (
        <Input
          autoFocus
          defaultValue={known ? "" : value}
          placeholder="vendor/model"
          className="font-mono"
          onBlur={(e) => e.target.value.trim() && e.target.value.trim() !== value && onChange(e.target.value.trim())}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { ExternalLink, Hammer, KeyRound, LogIn, LogOut, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { PROVIDER_IDS, PROVIDERS, resolveBaseUrl, type ProviderId } from "@shared/providers"
```
