```tsx
/*
  The three things every run needs, as panels both the first-run setup and Settings show
  (specs/onboarding R1.3–R1.5): the sandbox images, the Claude Code sign-in, and the orchestrator's provider,
  key and model. Each loads its own state and calls `onChange` after anything that may change readiness.
*/

export const message = (e: unknown) => (e as Error).message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method 'api': (\w*Error: )?/, "")

function useRun(onChange?: () => void) {
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
    setError("")
    try {
      await fn()
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    } finally {
      onChange?.()
    }
  }
  return { error, run }
}

/** Docker and the sandbox images, with the action that prepares them and its log. */
export function SandboxPanel({ onChange, children }: { onChange?(): void; children?: ReactNode }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [sandbox, setSandbox] = useState<SandboxStatus | null>(null)
  const { error, run } = useRun(onChange)
  useEffect(() => {
    void api.sandboxStatus().then(setSandbox)
    return window.hfr.onPush((p) => p.type === "sandbox" && setSandbox(p.status))
  }, [api])
  if (!sandbox) return null
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge variant={sandbox.docker ? "ok" : "bad"}>{sandbox.docker ? "Docker running" : "Docker unavailable"}</Badge>
        <Badge variant={sandbox.images ? "ok" : "warn"}>
          {sandbox.building ? "preparing…" : sandbox.images ? `images ready · Claude Code ${sandbox.claudeVersion}` : "images not prepared"}
        </Badge>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => run(async () => setSandbox(await api.sandboxStatus()))} aria-label="Check again">
          <RefreshCw size={13} />
        </Button>
      </div>
      {!sandbox.docker && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Start Docker Desktop, then check again. The specialist never runs outside its container. ({sandbox.dockerError})
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button className="shrink-0" disabled={!sandbox.docker || sandbox.building} onClick={() => run(async () => setSandbox(await api.buildSandbox()))}>
          <Hammer size={14} /> {sandbox.images ? "Prepare again" : "Prepare the images"}
        </Button>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Pulls the pinned base image with REA, Ghidra and the Android tools, then downloads Claude Code {sandbox.claudeVersion}, checks its signed manifest and

          {sandbox.buildLog}
        </pre>
      )}
      {children}
      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>

/** The specialist's sign-in on the user's own Claude plan, run inside the sandbox image. */
export function ClaudePanel({ onChange, children }: { onChange?(): void; children?: ReactNode }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [login, setLogin] = useState<LoginStatus | null>(null)
  const [images, setImages] = useState(false)
  const [code, setCode] = useState("")
  const { error, run } = useRun(onChange)
  useEffect(() => {
    void api.loginStatus().then(setLogin)
    void api.sandboxStatus().then((s) => setImages(s.images))
    return window.hfr.onPush((p) => {
      if (p.type === "login") setLogin(p.status)
      if (p.type === "sandbox") setImages(p.status.images)
    })
  }, [api])
  if (!login) return null
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge variant={login.loggedIn ? "ok" : "warn"}>{login.loggedIn ? `signed in${login.plan ? ` · ${login.plan}` : ""}` : "signed out"}</Badge>
        {login.email && <Mono className="text-muted-foreground">{login.email}</Mono>}
      </div>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        The specialist uses your own Claude plan and its limits, signed in inside the sandbox. The app never reads the stored credential.
      </p>
      {login.inProgress ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {login.url ? (
            <Button className="self-start" onClick={() => run(() => api.openLoginUrl())}>
              <ExternalLink size={14} /> Open the Anthropic sign-in page
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Starting the sign-in…</span>
          )}
          <Field label="Code from the Anthropic page">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Input value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)} autoComplete="off" />
              <Button
                disabled={code.trim().length < 8}
                onClick={() =>
                  run(async () => {
                    setLogin(await api.sendLoginCode(code))
                    setCode("")
                  })
                }
              >
                Submit
              </Button>
              <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => run(async () => setLogin(await api.cancelLogin()))}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Field>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {!login.loggedIn && (
            <Button disabled={!images} onClick={() => run(async () => setLogin(await api.startLogin()))}>
              <LogIn size={14} /> Sign in to Claude
            </Button>
          )}
          {login.loggedIn && (
            <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => run(async () => setLogin(await api.logout()))}>
              <LogOut size={14} /> Sign out
            </Button>
          )}
          {!images && !login.loggedIn && <span className="self-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Prepare the sandbox images first.</span>}
        </div>
      )}
      {children}
      <ErrorText>{login.error || error}</ErrorText>
    </div>
  )
}

/** The orchestrator's OpenAI-compatible provider — OpenRouter first — its endpoint, its key and its model. */
export function ModelPanel({
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  onChange?(): void
  children?: (settings: Settings, save: (p: Partial<Settings>) => Promise<void>) => ReactNode
}) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings | null>(null)
  const [key, setKey] = useState<KeyStatus | null>(null)
  const [keyInput, setKeyInput] = useState("")
  const [models, setModels] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [modelsNote, setModelsNote] = useState("")
  const { error, run } = useRun(onChange)

  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getSettings().then((st) => {
      setSettings(st)
      return api.keyStatus(st.provider).then(setKey)
    })
  }, [api])

  // The provider's own model list, read again when the provider, its endpoint or whether a key is set changes.
  const activeProvider = settings?.provider
  const activeBaseUrl = settings?.baseUrl
  const keySet = key?.set
  const loadModels = useCallback(
    () =>
      api.listModels().then(
        (list) => {
          setModels(list)
          setModelsNote("")
        },
        (e: unknown) => {
          setModels([])
          // A server with no model list still works: the model named here is checked with a test request (specs/onboarding R1.6).
          setModelsNote(`${message(e)} Name the model below; the setup checks it with a one-token test request.`)
        },
      ),
    [api],
  )
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeProvider || (PROVIDERS[activeProvider].keyRequired && !keySet) || (activeProvider === "custom" && !activeBaseUrl)) return
    void loadModels()
  }, [activeProvider, activeBaseUrl, keySet, loadModels])

  const save = (patch: Partial<Settings>) => run(async () => setSettings(await api.saveSettings(patch)))
  // Switching provider swaps in that provider's own endpoint (main keeps one per provider), model and key; the model
  // name of one is meaningless to another.
  const switchProvider = (id: ProviderId) =>
    // Picking the provider already chosen changes nothing: its endpoint and model stay as they were saved.
    id !== settings?.provider &&
    run(async () => {
      setModels([])
      setSettings(await api.saveSettings({ provider: id, model: PROVIDERS[id].defaultModel || settings?.model }))
      setKey(await api.keyStatus(id))
      setKeyInput("")
    })

  if (!settings) return null
  const provider = PROVIDERS[settings.provider]
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {key && !key.encryption && <ErrorText>The OS keychain is unavailable, so a key cannot be stored. It is never kept in plain text.</ErrorText>}
      <Field label="Provider" hint="OpenRouter, the default gateway, DeepSeek, or any service that speaks the OpenAI chat API. Each keeps its own key.">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {PROVIDER_IDS.map((id) => (
            <Button key={id} variant={settings.provider === id ? "default" : "outline"} onClick={() => switchProvider(id)}>
              {PROVIDERS[id].label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>
      {provider.editableBaseUrl && (
        <Field label="Base URL" hint={`Where requests go, without /chat/completions. Empty uses ${provider.baseUrl || "nothing: set one"}.`}>
          <Input
            defaultValue={settings.baseUrl}
            key={`${settings.provider}:${settings.baseUrl}`}
            placeholder={provider.baseUrl || "https://host/v1"}
            onBlur={(e) => e.target.value.trim() !== settings.baseUrl && save({ provider: settings.provider, baseUrl: e.target.value.trim() })}
          />
          {settings.provider === "custom" && !resolveBaseUrl("custom", settings.baseUrl) && <ErrorText>Set a base URL.</ErrorText>}
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        label="API key"
        hint={
          key?.set
            ? `Saved (${key.hint}), encrypted with the OS keychain. It is never shown again.`
            : "Encrypted with the OS keychain. It is never shown again."
        }
      >
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input type="password" value={keyInput} onChange={(e) => setKeyInput(e.target.value)} placeholder={provider.keyPlaceholder} autoComplete="off" />
          <Button
            disabled={keyInput.trim().length < 8}
            onClick={() =>
              run(async () => {
                setKey(await api.saveKey(keyInput, settings.provider))
                setKeyInput("")
              })
            }
          >
            <KeyRound size={14} /> Save
          </Button>
          {key?.set && (
            <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => run(async () => setKey(await api.clearKey(settings.provider)))}>
              Clear
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </Field>
      <Field
        label="Model"
        hint={
          settings.provider === "openrouter"
            ? "Any OpenRouter model with tool calling. The preset is also sent as the fallback; provider data collection is denied."
            : "Any model of this provider with tool calling. Reasoning-only models (such as deepseek-reasoner) are not supported."
        }
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
          <ModelPicker
            key={`${settings.provider}:${settings.model}`}
            provider={settings.provider}
            value={settings.model}
            listed={models}
            onChange={(m) => save({ model: m })}
          />
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => run(loadModels)} aria-label="Refresh the model list" title="Refresh the model list">
            <RefreshCw size={14} />
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {models.length > 0
            ? `${models.length} models with tool calling from ${provider.label}, recommended first.`
            : modelsNote ||
              (keySet || !provider.keyRequired ? `Reading ${provider.label}'s models…` : "Save a key to list this provider's models; you can still name one.")}
        </p>
      </Field>
      {children?.(settings, save)}
      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
    </div>
  )
}

export function EffortSelect<T extends string>({ value, options, onChange }: { value: T; options: readonly T[]; onChange(v: T): void }) {
  return (
    <select
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value as T)}
      className="h-9 w-48 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/30"
    >
      {options.map((o) => (
        <option key={o} value={o}>
          {o}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"
import type { ComponentProps } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

/* shadcn/ui Button, with a `success` variant for approvals. */

export const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/60 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive: "border border-destructive/60 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10",
        success: "bg-success/90 text-success-foreground hover:bg-success",
        outline: "border bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
        secondary: "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost: "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-3.5",
        sm: "h-7 px-2.5 text-xs",
        lg: "h-10 px-5",
        icon: "size-9",
        "icon-sm": "size-7",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: "outline", size: "default" },
  },
)

export function Button({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: ComponentProps<"button"> & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"
  return <Comp data-slot="button" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), className)} {...props} />
}
```

```tsx
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "radix-ui"
import type { ComponentProps, Ref } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

/*
  shadcn/ui ScrollArea; `viewportRef` reaches the scrolling element, e.g. to follow new messages. Its
  content wrapper is a block, not Radix's table, so long lines wrap instead of widening the page.
*/

export function ScrollArea({
  className,
  children,
  viewportRef,
  ...props
}: ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root> & { viewportRef?: Ref<HTMLDivElement> }) {
  return (
    <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root data-slot="scroll-area" className={cn("relative overflow-hidden", className)} {...props}>
      <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport ref={viewportRef} data-slot="scroll-area-viewport" className="size-full rounded-[inherit] outline-none [&>div]:!block">
        {children}
      </ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport>
      <ScrollBar />
      <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Corner />
    </ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>
  )
}

export function ScrollBar({ className, orientation = "vertical", ...props }: ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar>) {
  return (
    <ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar
      data-slot="scroll-area-scrollbar"
      orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(
        "flex touch-none select-none p-px transition-colors",
        orientation === "vertical" ? "h-full w-2.5 border-l border-l-transparent" : "h-2.5 flex-col border-t border-t-transparent",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaThumb data-slot="scroll-area-thumb" className="relative flex-1 rounded-full bg-border" />
    </ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar>
  )
}
```

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

/*
  shadcn/ui's theme tokens over the app's dark palette (adr:0010-build-the-renderer-on-shadcn-ui-and-radix),
  with `success` and `warning` beside `destructive` for task states.
*/

@theme inline {
  --color-background: var(--background);
  --color-foreground: var(--foreground);
  --color-card: var(--card);
  --color-card-foreground: var(--card-foreground);
  --color-popover: var(--popover);
  --color-popover-foreground: var(--popover-foreground);
  --color-primary: var(--primary);
  --color-primary-foreground: var(--primary-foreground);
  --color-secondary: var(--secondary);
  --color-secondary-foreground: var(--secondary-foreground);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/chat.ts`:

```ts
import type { Answer, Origin, Question, ToolDecision } from "@shared/chat"
import type { EventRow, StepRow, TaskState } from "@shared/types"

/*
  The task as a conversation (specs/chat R7.1), folded from its event log in order: the user's and
  the agent's messages, the orchestrator's tool calls with their results, the gated calls waiting on
  the user, the questions either agent asked, and the turn's stops and ends. A pure function of the
  log, so a reopened task renders exactly as it did live.
*/

export interface UserItem {
  kind: "user"
  id: string
  at: number
  text: string
  /** the orchestrator has read it (specs/chat R2.2); the opening request always has */
  read: boolean
}

export interface AgentItem {
  kind: "agent"
  id: string
  at: number
  text: string
}

export interface ToolItem {
  kind: "tool"
  id: string
  at: number
  name: string
  input: string
  output?: string
  failed: boolean
  /** the call's id, which pairs its result and the delegation it started (specs/chat-timeline R1.1) */
  callId?: string
  /** the delegation this call started, for `delegate_to_specialist`, when it is known from the order of a whole log */
  stepId?: string
}

export interface GatedCall {
  callId: string
  name: string
  args: Record<string, unknown>
  decision?: ToolDecision
  origin?: Origin
}

export interface ApprovalItem {
  kind: "approval"
  id: string
  at: number
  calls: GatedCall[]
}

export interface QuestionItem {
  kind: "question"
  id: string
  at: number
  agent: string
  stepId: string | null
  question: Question
  answer?: Answer
  origin?: Origin
}

export interface NoticeItem {
  kind: "notice"
  id: string
  at: number
  text: string
  tone: "neutral" | "warn" | "bad"
}

export type ChatItem = UserItem | AgentItem | ToolItem | ApprovalItem | QuestionItem | NoticeItem

const NOTICES: Record<string, NoticeItem["tone"]> = {
  "turn.stopped": "warn",
  "task.model": "neutral",
  "turn.continued": "neutral",
  "question.capped": "warn",
  // its own state, settled by the user's choice (specs/specialist-lifecycle R2.1)
  "safeguard.refusal": "warn",
  "task.failed": "bad",
  "task.cancelled": "warn",
  "task.interrupted": "bad",
  "task.done": "neutral",
}

const ENDS = new Set(["task.done", "task.failed", "task.cancelled", "task.interrupted"])

const str = (v: unknown) => (typeof v === "string" ? v : v === undefined ? "" : JSON.stringify(v, null, 2))

/**
  The fold behind `conversation`, kept between calls so new events are folded without the old ones
  (specs/chat-timeline R3.2). `fromStart` says the first event given is the task's first, so the first
  message is the opening request; a page that starts mid-task has none.
*/
export class ChatFold {
  readonly items: ChatItem[] = []
  private readonly open = new Map<string, ToolItem[]>()
  private readonly byCall = new Map<string, ToolItem>()
  private readonly calls = new Map<string, GatedCall>()
  private readonly questions = new Map<string, QuestionItem>()
  private readonly delegations: StepRow[]
  private delegated = 0
  private users: number
  /** the request of a task run before the chat recorded messages, until a message shows it was not one */
  private started: UserItem | null = null
  private sawUser = false

  constructor(steps: StepRow[] = [], fromStart = true) {
    // Steps that recorded no call id are paired with their calls by order, which only a whole log can do.
    this.delegations = steps.filter((s) => s.kind === "delegation" && !s.data.callId).sort((a, b) => a.ord - b.ord)
    this.users = fromStart ? 0 : 1
  }

  add(events: EventRow[]): this {
    for (const e of events) this.one(e)
    return this
  }

  private one(e: EventRow) {
    const { items } = this
    const id = `e${e.id}`
    const p = e.payload
    switch (e.kind) {
      case "message.user":
        if (this.started && !this.sawUser) {
          items.splice(items.indexOf(this.started), 1)
          this.started = null
        }
        this.sawUser = true
        items.push({ kind: "user", id, at: e.at, text: str(p.output), read: this.users++ === 0 })
        break
      case "message.read": {
        const text = str(p.output)
        const waiting = items.find((i): i is UserItem => i.kind === "user" && !i.read && i.text === text)
        if (waiting) waiting.read = true
        break
      }
      case "message.agent":
        items.push({ kind: "agent", id, at: e.at, text: str(p.output) })
        break
      case "tool.call": {
        if (e.agent !== "orchestrator") break
        const name = String(p.tool ?? e.summary)
        const item: ToolItem = { kind: "tool", id, at: e.at, name, input: str(p.input), failed: false }
        if (typeof p.callId === "string" && p.callId) {
          item.callId = p.callId
          this.byCall.set(p.callId, item)
        } else {
          if (name === "delegate_to_specialist") item.stepId = this.delegations[this.delegated++]?.id
          this.open.set(name, [...(this.open.get(name) ?? []), item])
        }
        items.push(item)
        break
      }
      case "tool.result":
      case "tool.error": {
        const callId = typeof p.callId === "string" ? p.callId : ""
        const item = callId ? this.byCall.get(callId) : this.open.get(String(p.tool ?? ""))?.shift()
        if (!item) break
        this.byCall.delete(callId)
        item.output = e.kind === "tool.error" ? str(p.error) : str(p.output)
        item.failed = e.kind === "tool.error" || item.output.startsWith("ERROR:")
        break
      }
      case "approval.requested": {
        const requested = ((p.calls as GatedCall[] | undefined) ?? []).map((c) => ({ callId: c.callId, name: c.name, args: c.args ?? {} }))
        for (const c of requested) this.calls.set(c.callId, c)
        if (requested.length) items.push({ kind: "approval", id, at: e.at, calls: requested })
        break
      }
      case "approval.decided": {
        const call = this.calls.get(String(p.callId ?? ""))
        if (call) Object.assign(call, { decision: p.decision as ToolDecision, origin: p.origin as Origin })
        break
      }
      case "question.asked": {
        const q: QuestionItem = { kind: "question", id: String(p.questionId), at: e.at, agent: e.agent, stepId: e.stepId, question: p.question as Question }
        this.questions.set(q.id, q)
        items.push(q)
        break
      }
      case "question.answered": {
        const q = this.questions.get(String(p.questionId ?? ""))
        if (q) Object.assign(q, { answer: p.answer as Answer, origin: p.origin as Origin })
        break
      }
      case "task.started":
        // Tasks run before the chat recorded no messages: their request and answer stand in for them.
        if (p.input && !this.sawUser) {
          this.started = { kind: "user", id, at: e.at, text: str(p.input), read: true }
          items.push(this.started)
        }
        break
      default:
        // A task that ended settles whatever still waited on the user, so no card stays actionable.
        if (ENDS.has(e.kind)) {
          for (const c of this.calls.values()) if (!c.decision) Object.assign(c, { decision: { type: "reject" }, origin: "stopped" })
          for (const q of this.questions.values()) if (q.origin === undefined) Object.assign(q, { answer: q.question.default, origin: "stopped" })
        }
        if (this.started && !this.sawUser && e.kind === "task.done" && typeof p.output === "string" && p.output)
          items.push({ kind: "agent", id, at: e.at, text: p.output })
        else if (e.kind in NOTICES) items.push({ kind: "notice", id, at: e.at, text: e.summary, tone: NOTICES[e.kind] })
    }
  }
}

/** The task as a conversation: a pure function of the log, so a reopened task renders exactly as it did live. */
export function conversation(events: EventRow[], steps: StepRow[] = []): ChatItem[] {
  return new ChatFold(steps).add(events).items
}

export type ChatBlock = Exclude<ChatItem, ToolItem> | { kind: "tools"; id: string; items: ToolItem[] } | (ToolItem & { delegation: true })

/** Consecutive plain tool calls as one run; a delegation stands on its own, as its card. */
export function blocks(items: ChatItem[]): ChatBlock[] {
  const out: ChatBlock[] = []
  for (const i of items) {
    if (i.kind !== "tool") out.push(i)
    else if (i.stepId || i.name === "delegate_to_specialist") out.push({ ...i, delegation: true })
    else {
      const prev = out.at(-1)
      if (prev?.kind === "tools") prev.items.push(i)
      else out.push({ kind: "tools", id: i.id, items: [i] })
    }
  }
  return out
}

/** The gated calls still waiting for the user's decision. */
export function pendingCalls(items: ChatItem[]): GatedCall[] {
  return items.flatMap((i) => (i.kind === "approval" ? i.calls.filter((c) => !c.decision) : []))
}

/** The questions still waiting for the user's answer. */
export function pendingQuestions(items: ChatItem[]): QuestionItem[] {
  return items.filter((i): i is QuestionItem => i.kind === "question" && i.origin === undefined)
}

/** States a task ended in that it can be continued from, on Continue or a message (specs/task-persistence R2). */
export const ENDED_STATES: TaskState[] = ["cancelled", "failed", "interrupted", "done"]

/**
  Whether the user can write to the task: while a turn runs or waits, on their turn, after a stop (R7.2), and once it
  ended, which reopens it where it stopped (specs/task-persistence R2.2).
*/
export function canSend(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return ["pending", "running", "waiting", "awaiting-user", "stopped", ...ENDED_STATES].includes(state)
}

/** Whether the task can be continued from where it stopped: a stopped turn, or a task that ended (specs/task-persistence R2.1). */
export function canContinue(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return state === "stopped" || ENDED_STATES.includes(state)
}

/** Whether the task can be deleted: anything but a turn under way (specs/task-persistence R4.2). */
export function canDelete(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return !canStop(state)
}

/** Whether a turn is under way and can be stopped (R3.1). */
export function canStop(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return ["pending", "running", "waiting"].includes(state)
}

/** Whether the conversation is open with no turn under way, so it can be closed. */
export function canClose(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return state === "awaiting-user" || state === "stopped"
}

/** A gated call's arguments as the user edits them: JSON text in, an object out, or why not. */
export function parseArgs(text: string): { args: Record<string, unknown> } | { error: string } {
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(text) as unknown
    if (!v || typeof v !== "object" || Array.isArray(v)) return { error: "The arguments must be a JSON object." }
    return { args: v as Record<string, unknown> }
  } catch (e) {
    return { error: `Not valid JSON: ${(e as Error).message}` }
  }
}

/** What the turn is doing, in a few words, for the bar above the message box (R7.2, R7.5). */
export function turnLabel(state: TaskState, waitingOn: number): string {
  switch (state) {
    case "pending":
      return "Starting the task's sandbox…"
    case "running":
      return "Working — your messages reach the orchestrator before its next step."
    case "waiting":
      return waitingOn ? `Waiting for you: ${waitingOn} ${waitingOn === 1 ? "decision" : "decisions"}.` : "Waiting for you."
    case "awaiting-user":
      return "Your turn."
    case "stopped":
      return "Stopped. Continue the turn, or send a message to continue with it."
    default:
      return "Ended. Its history and files are kept: continue it, or send a message to pick up where it stopped."
  }
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/format.ts`:

```ts
import type { TaskState } from "@shared/types"

/* Display helpers: money, tokens, time, state tone and diff lines. */

export function usd(v: number): string {
  if (!v) return "$0.00"
  return v < 0.01 ? `$${v.toFixed(4)}` : `$${v.toFixed(2)}`
}

export function tokens(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1000) return String(n)
  if (n < 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(n < 10_000 ? 1 : 0)}k`
  return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`
}

export function clock(ms: number): string {
  const d = new Date(ms)
  return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" })
}

export function when(ms: number, now = Date.now()): string {
  const s = Math.round((now - ms) / 1000)
  if (s < 60) return "just now"
  if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)} min ago`
  if (s < 86_400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)} h ago`
  return new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString()
}

export type Tone = "neutral" | "info" | "warn" | "ok" | "bad"

export function tone(state: TaskState | ""): Tone {
  switch (state) {
    case "running":
      return "info"
    case "waiting":
    case "stopped":
    case "refused":
      return "warn"
    case "done":
    case "awaiting-user":
      return "ok"
    case "failed":
    case "interrupted":
      return "bad"
    default:
      return "neutral"
  }
}

export type DiffLine = { kind: "add" | "del" | "hunk" | "file" | "ctx"; text: string }

export function diffLines(diff: string): DiffLine[] {
  return diff.split("\n").map((text) => {
    if (text.startsWith("+++") || text.startsWith("---")) return { kind: "file", text }
    if (text.startsWith("@@")) return { kind: "hunk", text }
    if (text.startsWith("+")) return { kind: "add", text }
    if (text.startsWith("-")) return { kind: "del", text }
    return { kind: "ctx", text }
  })
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/highlight.ts`:

```ts
import type { Parser } from "@lezer/common"
import { classHighlighter, highlightCode } from "@lezer/highlight"
import { parser as cpp } from "@lezer/cpp"
import { parser as css } from "@lezer/css"
import { parser as go } from "@lezer/go"
import { parser as html } from "@lezer/html"
import { parser as java } from "@lezer/java"
import { parser as javascript } from "@lezer/javascript"
import { parser as json } from "@lezer/json"
import { parser as python } from "@lezer/python"
import { parser as rust } from "@lezer/rust"
import { parser as xml } from "@lezer/xml"
import { parser as yaml } from "@lezer/yaml"

/*
  Syntax colors for the code in a conversation (specs/chat R7.6), one highlighter both apps draw: CodeMirror's Lezer
  parsers turn a code block into lines of tokens, each tagged with Lezer's stable `tok-*` classes and colored from one
  palette, `SYNTAX`, in both apps. Pure, with no DOM, so the TUI imports it as it is.
*/

export interface Token {
  text: string
  /** Lezer's classes for the token, such as `tok-keyword` or `tok-variableName tok-definition`; empty when plain */
  classes: string
  /** the one that picks its color — `keyword`, `string`, `comment`, `definition` — or empty when plain */
  tag: SyntaxTag | ""
}

/**
  The syntax palette both apps draw with, on the desktop app's dark background; a tag absent here is drawn in the
  text color. Listed in the order a token's classes are matched, most specific first.
*/
export const SYNTAX = {
  comment: "#6b7385",
  string: "#9ece6a",
  number: "#ff9e64",
  bool: "#ff9e64",
  atom: "#ff9e64",
  keyword: "#bb9af7",
  definition: "#7dcfff",
  typeName: "#2ac3de",
  className: "#2ac3de",
  namespace: "#2ac3de",
  macroName: "#e0af68",
  propertyName: "#73daca",
  labelName: "#e0af68",
  operator: "#89ddff",
  regexp: "#b4f9f8",
  meta: "#e0af68",
  heading: "#7aa2f7",
  link: "#7aa2f7",
  inserted: "#6fcf97",
  deleted: "#ef6f6c",
  invalid: "#ef6f6c",
  punctuation: "#a9b1d6",
} as const

export type SyntaxTag = keyof typeof SYNTAX

const ORDER = Object.keys(SYNTAX) as SyntaxTag[]

/** The tag of a token's classes that decides its color, or empty. */
export function tagOf(classes: string): SyntaxTag | "" {
  const names = new Set(classes.split(" ").map((c) => c.replace(/^tok-/, "")))
  return ORDER.find((t) => names.has(t)) ?? ""
}

const PARSERS: Record<string, () => Parser> = {
  javascript: () => javascript,
  jsx: () => javascript.configure({ dialect: "jsx" }),
  typescript: () => javascript.configure({ dialect: "ts" }),
  tsx: () => javascript.configure({ dialect: "ts jsx" }),
  python: () => python,
  json: () => json,
  cpp: () => cpp,
  rust: () => rust,
  java: () => java,
  go: () => go,
  html: () => html,
  css: () => css,
  xml: () => xml,
  yaml: () => yaml,
}

const ALIASES: Record<string, keyof typeof PARSERS> = {
  js: "javascript",
  mjs: "javascript",
  cjs: "javascript",
  node: "javascript",
  ts: "typescript",
  mts: "typescript",
  py: "python",
  python3: "python",
  jsonc: "json",
  json5: "json",
  c: "cpp",
  h: "cpp",
  cc: "cpp",
  cxx: "cpp",
  hpp: "cpp",
  "c++": "cpp",
  objc: "cpp",
  "objective-c": "cpp",
  rs: "rust",
  kotlin: "java",
  kt: "java",
  smali: "java",
  golang: "go",
  htm: "html",
  svg: "xml",
  plist: "xml",
  xaml: "xml",
  yml: "yaml",
}

/** Code longer than this is shown plain: parsing it would hold up the view for a block nobody reads whole. */
export const MAX_HIGHLIGHT = 100_000

/** The parser name for a fence's info string (`ts`, `Python`, `c++ title=x`), or null when Lezer has none for it. */
export function languageOf(info: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const name = (info ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/)[0]?.toLowerCase() ?? ""
  if (!name) return null
  // Own keys only: a fence named `__proto__` or `constructor` is text from the target, not a key of the map.
  if (Object.hasOwn(PARSERS, name)) return name
  return Object.hasOwn(ALIASES, name) ? ALIASES[name] : null
}

const plain = (code: string): Token[][] => code.split("\n").map((text) => (text ? [{ text, classes: "", tag: "" }] : []))

/** A code block as lines of tokens, colored when its language has a parser; plain text otherwise. */
export function highlight(code: string, info?: string | null): Token[][] {
  const lang = languageOf(info)
  if (!lang || code.length > MAX_HIGHLIGHT) return plain(code)
  const lines: Token[][] = [[]]
  try {
    const parser = PARSERS[lang]()
    highlightCode(
      code,
      parser.parse(code),
      classHighlighter,
      (text, classes) => lines[lines.length - 1].push({ text, classes, tag: tagOf(classes) }),
      () => lines.push([]),
    )
  } catch {
    return plain(code)
  }
  return lines
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/integrations.ts`:

```ts
import type { IntegrationAgent, IntegrationSettings, IntegrationStatus, IntegrationView } from "@shared/integrations"

/*
  The MCP tab's data (specs/mcp-integrations R1.1, R1.4, R2.1–R2.3): each integration's row in the list, and on its page
  each tool's row with one toggle per agent, its defaults where the user chose nothing, and the warning on a target
  tool turned on for the orchestrator.
*/

export interface ToolRow {
  name: string
  description: string
  target: boolean
  orchestrator: boolean
  specialist: boolean
  /** what it returns goes to the orchestrator's model and provider (R2.3) */
  warn: boolean
}

/** An integration's settings, or its defaults: off, its config empty, every tool at its default. */
export function settingsOf(view: IntegrationView, stored: Record<string, IntegrationSettings> | undefined): IntegrationSettings {
  return stored?.[view.id] ?? { enabled: false, config: {}, tools: {} }
}

export function toolRows(view: IntegrationView, s: IntegrationSettings): ToolRow[] {
  return view.tools.map((t) => {
    const c = s.tools[t.name] ?? { orchestrator: t.orchestratorDefault, specialist: true }
    return { name: t.name, description: t.description, target: t.target, ...c, warn: t.target && c.orchestrator }
  })
}

/** What the MCP tab's list shows of an integration's connection: only while it is on, and once its status came (R1.4). */
export type Connection = "off" | "checking" | "connected" | "not connected"

/** One integration as the MCP tab lists it (R1.1, R1.4). */
export interface IntegrationRow {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string
  on: boolean
  connection: Connection
}

export function integrationRow(view: IntegrationView, s: IntegrationSettings, status?: IntegrationStatus): IntegrationRow {
  const connection: Connection = !s.enabled ? "off" : !status ? "checking" : status.connected ? "connected" : "not connected"
  return { id: view.id, title: view.title, description: view.description, on: s.enabled, connection }
}

/** The settings with one tool's choice changed for one agent; its other agent keeps what it showed. */
export function withChoice(view: IntegrationView, s: IntegrationSettings, tool: string, agent: IntegrationAgent, value: boolean): IntegrationSettings {
  const row = toolRows(view, s).find((r) => r.name === tool)
  if (!row) return s
  return { ...s, tools: { ...s.tools, [tool]: { orchestrator: row.orchestrator, specialist: row.specialist, [agent]: value } } }
}
```

```ts
  },
  {

    title: "Debug it",

    ideas: ["Find why it crashes on start", "Trace where this error comes from", "Explain why this feature stopped working"],
  },

export function goalCard(goal: Goal): GoalCard {
  return GOAL_CARDS.find((g) => g.goal === goal) ?? GOAL_CARDS[0]
}

/** The project list, newest first, with a pushed project added, replaced or removed. */
export function foldProjects(list: ProjectRow[], p: Push): ProjectRow[] {
  if (p.type === "projectDeleted") return list.filter((x) => x.id !== p.id)
  if (p.type !== "project") return list
  const rest = list.filter((x) => x.id !== p.project.id)
  return [p.project, ...rest].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

/** A project's tasks, newest first, from the task list. */
export function tasksOf(tasks: TaskRow[], projectId: string): TaskRow[] {
  return tasks.filter((t) => t.projectId === projectId).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

/** A project's default name: its target's file or folder name, without an extension. */
export function nameFrom(path: string): string {
  const last =
    path
      .replace(/[\\/]+$/, "")
      .split(/[\\/]/)
      .pop() ?? ""
  return last.replace(/\.[^.]{1,8}$/, "") || last
}

/** A file size for the eye. */
export function bytes(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`
  if (n < 1024 ** 2) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
  if (n < 1024 ** 3) return `${(n / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(1)} MB`
  return `${(n / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(2)} GB`
}

/** Which other app is running a task of the project, or null when it is free here (specs/shared-data-folder R1.3). */
export function heldLabel(p: Pick<ProjectRow, "heldBy">): string | null {
  if (!p.heldBy) return null
  return `In use by ${p.heldBy.app === "tui" ? "a terminal UI" : "the desktop app"} (process ${p.heldBy.pid})`
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/store.ts`:

```ts
import type { AgentUsage, EventRow, PatchView, Push, StepRow, TaskHistory, TaskRow, TaskState } from "@shared/types"

/*
  The renderer's state, folded from pushed messages: the loaded task's history and the task list.
  Live updates and history go through the same reducer, so what renders live is what renders later.
*/

function upsert<T extends { id: string | number }>(list: T[], item: T, order: (a: T, b: T) => number): T[] {
  const i = list.findIndex((x) => x.id === item.id)
  const next = i >= 0 ? list.map((x, k) => (k === i ? item : x)) : [...list, item]
  return next.sort(order)
}

/** One pushed message into the open task's history; messages for other tasks leave it unchanged. */
export function fold(h: TaskHistory | null, p: Push): TaskHistory | null {
  if (!h) return h
  switch (p.type) {
    case "task":
      // The stored state follows every change from here on; the turn read at load no longer speaks for it.
      return p.task.id === h.task.id ? { ...h, task: p.task, turn: undefined } : h
    case "step":
      return p.step.taskId === h.task.id ? { ...h, steps: upsert<StepRow>(h.steps, p.step, (a, b) => a.ord - b.ord) } : h
    case "event": {
      if (p.event.taskId !== h.task.id) return h
      const last = h.events.at(-1)?.id ?? 0
      return p.event.id > last ? { ...h, events: [...h.events, p.event] } : h
    }
    case "patch":
      return p.patch.taskId === h.task.id ? { ...h, patches: upsert<PatchView>(h.patches, p.patch, (a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt) } : h
    default:
      return h
  }
}

/** The task list, newest first, with a pushed task added or replaced. */
export function foldTasks(list: TaskRow[], p: Push): TaskRow[] {
  if (p.type === "taskDeleted") return list.filter((t) => t.id !== p.id)
  if (p.type !== "task") return list
  return upsert(list, p.task, (a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

/** One event's tokens and cost added to the per-agent usage, when it is a model call or a specialist's result. */
export function addUsage(usage: AgentUsage[], e: EventRow): AgentUsage[] {
  if (e.kind !== "model.call" && e.kind !== "specialist.result") return usage
  const cur = usage.find((u) => u.agent === e.agent) ?? { agent: e.agent, calls: 0, tokensIn: 0, tokensOut: 0, costUsd: 0, estimate: false }
  const next: AgentUsage = {
    ...cur,
    calls: cur.calls + 1,
    tokensIn: cur.tokensIn + (e.payload.tokensIn ?? 0) + (e.payload.cacheTokens ?? 0),
    tokensOut: cur.tokensOut + (e.payload.tokensOut ?? 0),
    costUsd: cur.costUsd + (e.payload.costUsd ?? 0),
    estimate: cur.estimate || e.payload.estimate === true,
  }
  return usage.some((u) => u.agent === e.agent) ? usage.map((u) => (u.agent === e.agent ? next : u)) : [...usage, next]
}

/** Tokens and cost per agent, from the orchestrator's model calls and the specialist's results. */
export function usageByAgent(events: EventRow[]): AgentUsage[] {
  return events.reduce(addUsage, [] as AgentUsage[])
}

export interface FilesTouched {
  copy: string[]
  read: string[]
  write: string[]
  apply: string[]
}

/** Every file a delegation copied in, the specialist read or wrote, and a patch applied. */
export function filesOfStep(events: EventRow[], stepId: string): FilesTouched {
  const out: Record<keyof FilesTouched, Set<string>> = { copy: new Set(), read: new Set(), write: new Set(), apply: new Set() }
  for (const e of events) if (e.stepId === stepId) for (const f of e.payload.files ?? []) out[f.op]?.add(f.path)
  return { copy: [...out.copy], read: [...out.read], write: [...out.write], apply: [...out.apply] }
}

export const LIVE_STATES: TaskState[] = ["pending", "running", "waiting"]
export const RETRY_STATES: TaskState[] = ["interrupted", "failed", "cancelled"]

export function isLive(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return LIVE_STATES.includes(state)
}

export function canRetry(state: TaskState): boolean {
  return RETRY_STATES.includes(state)
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/timeline.ts`:

```ts
import type { EventRow, StepRow } from "@shared/types"
import { ChatFold, type ChatItem, type ToolItem } from "./chat"

/*
  The task view's timeline (specs/chat-timeline): the conversation folded from a page of the event log,
  newer events folded onto it as they arrive without refolding the rest (R3.2), and the specialist's
  own work kept under the delegation that ran it (R1.1, R1.3). An older page refolds once, from the
  oldest event loaded.
*/

/** One entry of a specialist's run, shown under its delegation, collapsed until opened (R1.2). */
export interface SpecialistEntry {
  id: string
  at: number
  kind: "text" | "thinking" | "tool" | "result" | "note"
  /** one line */
  title: string
  /** what opening the entry shows: the text, the tool's input, the event's output */
  body: string
  /** a tool's result, once it returned */
  output?: string
  /** how long a tool still running has run, in seconds, from Claude Code's heartbeats (specs/chat-timeline R1.4) */
  elapsedSeconds?: number
  failed: boolean
  /** the subagent of the specialist that made it, when not the specialist itself */
  subagent?: string
}

const text = (v: unknown) => (typeof v === "string" ? v : v === undefined ? "" : JSON.stringify(v, null, 2))
const FAILED = new Set(["delegation.failed", "delegation.timeout", "delegation.auth", "delegation.limit", "sandbox.refused", "patch.conflict"])

export class Timeline {
  /** the events loaded, oldest first */
  readonly events: EventRow[]
  private readonly chat: ChatFold
  private readonly runs = new Map<string, SpecialistEntry[]>()
  private readonly calls = new Map<string, SpecialistEntry>()

  /** `fromStart`: the first event given is the task's first, so nothing older is missing */
  constructor(
    steps: StepRow[],
    events: EventRow[],
    readonly fromStart: boolean,
  ) {
    this.events = []
    this.chat = new ChatFold(steps, fromStart)
    this.append(events)
  }

  get items(): ChatItem[] {
    return this.chat.items
  }

  get lastId(): number {
    return this.events.at(-1)?.id ?? 0
  }

  get firstId(): number {
    return this.events[0]?.id ?? 0
  }

  /** Fold newer events in; an event already folded is skipped (R3.2). Returns whether anything changed. */
  append(events: EventRow[]): boolean {
    const fresh = events.filter((e) => e.id > this.lastId)
    if (!fresh.length) return false
    this.events.push(...fresh)
    this.chat.add(fresh)
    for (const e of fresh) this.specialist(e)
    return true
  }

  /** A timeline that starts at an older page: refolded once, from its first event (R2.3). */
  prepend(older: EventRow[], steps: StepRow[], fromStart: boolean): Timeline {
    return new Timeline(steps, [...older.filter((e) => e.id < this.firstId), ...this.events], fromStart)
  }

  /** The specialist's entries for a delegation step, oldest first. */
  run(stepId: string): SpecialistEntry[] {
    return this.runs.get(stepId) ?? []
  }

  private specialist(e: EventRow) {
    // A question stays in the conversation, where it is answered.
    if (!e.stepId || (e.agent !== "specialist" && e.agent !== "sandbox") || e.kind.startsWith("question.")) return
    const p = e.payload
    const base = { id: `e${e.id}`, at: e.at, failed: false, ...(typeof p.subagent === "string" ? { subagent: p.subagent } : {}) }
    let entry: SpecialistEntry | null = null
    switch (e.kind) {
      case "specialist.text":
      case "specialist.thinking":
        entry = { ...base, kind: e.kind === "specialist.text" ? "text" : "thinking", title: e.summary, body: text(p.output) }
        break
      case "specialist.tool.call":
        entry = { ...base, kind: "tool", title: e.summary, body: text(p.input) }
        if (typeof p.callId === "string") this.calls.set(p.callId, entry)
        break
      case "specialist.tool.progress": {
        // A heartbeat updates the call it belongs to; it is not an entry of its own (R1.4).
        const call = typeof p.callId === "string" ? this.calls.get(p.callId) : undefined
        if (call && call.output === undefined && typeof p.elapsedSeconds === "number") call.elapsedSeconds = p.elapsedSeconds
        return
      }
      case "specialist.tool.result": {
        const call = typeof p.callId === "string" ? this.calls.get(p.callId) : undefined
        if (call) {
          call.output = text(p.output)
          call.failed = p.error !== undefined
          return
        }
        entry = { ...base, kind: "note", title: e.summary, body: text(p.output), failed: p.error !== undefined }
        break
      }
      case "specialist.result":
        entry = { ...base, kind: "result", title: e.summary, body: text(p.output), failed: p.error !== undefined }
        break
      default:
        entry = { ...base, kind: "note", title: e.summary, body: text(p.output ?? p.error ?? ""), failed: FAILED.has(e.kind) || p.error !== undefined }
    }
    const list = this.runs.get(e.stepId)
    if (list) list.push(entry)
    else this.runs.set(e.stepId, [entry])
  }
}

/** The delegation step a `delegate_to_specialist` call started: by the call's id, or by order in a whole log. */
export function stepOf(item: ToolItem, steps: StepRow[]): StepRow | undefined {
  if (item.callId) return steps.find((s) => s.kind === "delegation" && s.data.callId === item.callId)
  return item.stepId ? steps.find((s) => s.id === item.stepId) : undefined
}
```

`src/renderer/src/lib/virtual.ts`:

```ts
/*
  Which timeline entries to render (specs/chat-timeline R3.1): measured heights where an entry has
  been on screen, an estimate where it has not, and the slice of entries that meets the viewport
  widened by an overscan. Pure, so the view only measures and scrolls.
*/

/** Each entry's top offset, and the total height as the last element: `n + 1` numbers. */
export function offsets(ids: string[], measured: ReadonlyMap<string, number>, estimate: number): number[] {
  const out = new Array<number>(ids.length + 1)
  out[0] = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) out[i + 1] = out[i] + (measured.get(ids[i]) ?? estimate)
  return out
}

/** The first index whose entry ends below `y`. */
function firstEndingBelow(offs: number[], y: number): number {
  let lo = 0
  let hi = offs.length - 1
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1
    if (offs[mid + 1] <= y) lo = mid + 1
    else hi = mid
  }
  return lo
}

export interface Slice {
  /** first entry rendered */
  start: number
  /** one past the last entry rendered */
  end: number
  /** space above the first entry rendered */
  before: number
  /** space below the last entry rendered */
  after: number
}

/** The entries meeting `[scrollTop - overscan, scrollTop + viewport + overscan]`. */
export function slice(offs: number[], scrollTop: number, viewport: number, overscan: number): Slice {
  const n = offs.length - 1
  if (n <= 0) return { start: 0, end: 0, before: 0, after: 0 }
  const start = Math.min(firstEndingBelow(offs, Math.max(0, scrollTop - overscan)), n - 1)
  let end = firstEndingBelow(offs, scrollTop + viewport + overscan) + 1
  end = Math.max(start + 1, Math.min(end, n))
  return { start, end, before: offs[start], after: offs[n] - offs[end] }
}

/**
  The scroll position that keeps what was on screen in place after entries were added above it
  (specs/chat-timeline R2.3): moved down by exactly the height that was added.
*/
export function keepInPlace(scrollTop: number, heightBefore: number, heightAfter: number): number {
  return scrollTop + Math.max(0, heightAfter - heightBefore)
}

/**
  How far entries added above moved the old ones down: found from the first old entry still present,
  since the one at the boundary may have merged with what was added (a run of tool calls, say).
  Zero when nothing was added above.
*/
export function addedAbove(oldIds: string[], oldOffs: number[], newIds: string[], newOffs: number[]): number {
  if (!oldIds.length || oldIds[0] === newIds[0]) return 0
  const at = new Map(newIds.map((id, i) => [id, i]))
  for (let j = 0; j < Math.min(oldIds.length, 8); j++) {
    const k = at.get(oldIds[j])
    if (k !== undefined) return Math.max(0, newOffs[k] - oldOffs[j])
  }
  return 0
}

/** Whether the viewport is at the end, so new entries should keep it there. */
export function atEnd(scrollTop: number, viewport: number, total: number, slack = 160): boolean {
  return total - scrollTop - viewport < slack
}
```

```tsx
import { Bug, Check, Code2, FileSearch, FolderOpen, FolderTree, Map as MapIcon, Plug, Rocket, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { PROVIDERS } from "@shared/providers"
import {
  ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS,
  SPECIALIST_EFFORTS,
  type Goal,
  type OrchestratorEffort,
  type ProjectRow,
  type Settings,
  type SpecialistEffort,
  type TargetInfo,
} from "@shared/types"
import { ErrorText, Field } from "@/components/common"
import { ModelPicker } from "@/components/setup/ModelPicker"
import { EffortSelect, message } from "@/components/setup/panels"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"
import { bytes, GOAL_CARDS, nameFrom } from "@/lib/projects"

/*
  The guided setup of a new project (specs/projects R4.2, R1.6): the target with the kind the app detects, the goal as
  cards, then the name, model, efforts and folder, with the defaults filled in. Create is enabled once the target and
  the goal are chosen.
*/

const GOAL_ICONS: Record<Goal, LucideIcon> = { understand: MapIcon, reimplement: Code2, integrate: Plug, debug: Bug }

export function NewProject({ onCreated }: { onCreated(p: ProjectRow): void }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<TargetInfo | null>(null)
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState<Goal | null>(null)
  const [name, setName] = useState("")
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings | null>(null)
  const [model, setModel] = useState("")
  const [orchestratorEffort, setOrchestratorEffort] = useState<OrchestratorEffort>("default")
  const [specialistEffort, setSpecialistEffort] = useState<SpecialistEffort>("default")
  const [parentFolder, setParentFolder] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [models, setModels] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getSettings().then((s) => {
      setSettings(s)
      setModel(s.model)
      setOrchestratorEffort(s.orchestratorEffort)
      setSpecialistEffort(s.specialistEffort)
    })
    void api.listModels().then(setModels, () => undefined)
  }, [api])

  const choose = async (kind: "file" | "folder") => {
    setError("")
    try {
      const path = await api.pickTarget(kind)
      if (!path) return
      const t = await api.detectTarget(path)
      setTarget(t)
      setName((n) => n || nameFrom(path))
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    }
  }

  const create = async () => {
    if (!target || !goal || !settings) return
    setBusy(true)
    setError("")
    try {
      onCreated(
        await api.createProject({
          name: name || nameFrom(target.path),
          goal,
          target: target.path,
          provider: settings.provider,
          model,
          orchestratorEffort,
          specialistEffort,
          parentFolder,
        }),
      )
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl flex-col gap-6 p-8">
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">New project</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          A project is one target. Its tasks share its sandboxes, what they extract and everything the specialist finds, so each task starts from what the last
          ones learned.
        </p>
      </header>

      <Section n={1} title="What do you want to look into?" done={!!target}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <ChoiceCard
            icon={FileSearch}
            title="A file"
            description="An APK, a binary, a DLL, an archive or a firmware image. The project keeps its own copy."
            onClick={() => choose("file")}
          />
          <ChoiceCard
            icon={FolderTree}
            title="A folder"
            description="An installed app, a repository or an unpacked bundle. Read in place, never written."
            onClick={() => choose("folder")}
          />
        </div>
        {target && (
          <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-primary/40 bg-primary/5 p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Badge variant="info">{target.label}</Badge>
              {target.isFile && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{bytes(target.size)}</span>}
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground" title={target.path}>
                {target.path}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              The specialist will work with
              {target.engines.map((e) => (
                <Badge key={e} variant="neutral">
                  {e}
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Card>
        )}
      </Section>

      <Section n={2} title="What do you want to do with it?" done={!!goal}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {GOAL_CARDS.map((g) => (
            <ChoiceCard
              key={g.goal}
              icon={GOAL_ICONS[g.goal]}
              title={g.title}
              description={g.description}
              selected={goal === g.goal}
              onClick={() => setGoal(g.goal)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section n={3} title="Name it and choose how it runs" done={!!target && !!goal}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Field label="Name">
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder={target ? nameFrom(target.path) : "My project"} maxLength={80} />
          </Field>
          <Field label={`Model (${settings ? PROVIDERS[settings.provider].label : ""})`} hint="The orchestrator's model for this project's tasks.">
            {settings && <ModelPicker provider={settings.provider} value={model} listed={models} onChange={setModel} />}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Orchestrator effort">
            <EffortSelect value={orchestratorEffort} options={ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => setOrchestratorEffort(v)} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Specialist effort" hint="Higher thinks longer and uses more of your Claude plan.">
            <EffortSelect value={specialistEffort} options={SPECIALIST_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => setSpecialistEffort(v)} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <FolderOpen size={14} />
          Saved in
          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground">{parentFolder ? `${parentFolder}\\…` : "a new folder in the app's data"}</span>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="link"
            onClick={async () => {
              const f = await api.pickFolder()
              if (f) setParentFolder(f)
            }}
          >
            Choose a folder…
          </Button>
          {parentFolder && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setParentFolder(null)}>
              Use the app's data
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button size="lg" disabled={!target || !goal || !model.trim() || busy} onClick={create}>
          <Rocket size={15} /> Create the project
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Section({ n, title, done, children }: { n: number; title: string; done: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-xs font-semibold",
            done ? "border-success/50 text-success" : "border-border",
          )}
        >
          {done ? <Check size={14} /> : n}
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-semibold">{title}</h2>
      </div>
      {children}
    </Card>
  )
}

function ChoiceCard({
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  description,
  selected,
  onClick,
}: {
  icon: LucideIcon
  title: string
  description: string
  selected?: boolean
  onClick(): void
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={selected}
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-4 text-left transition-colors hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-accent",
        selected && "border-primary bg-primary/10",
      )}
    >
      <Icon size={18} className={cn("mt-0.5 shrink-0", selected ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
          {title}
          {selected && <Check size={14} className="ml-auto text-primary" />}
        </span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{description}</span>
      </span>
    </button>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/views/ProjectView.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Bug, Code2, FileSearch, Lightbulb, Lock, Map as MapIcon, Play, Plug, Trash2, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS, SPECIALIST_EFFORTS, type AnalysisSummary, type Goal, type ProjectRow, type TaskRow, type UnknownRow } from "@shared/types"
import { ModelPicker } from "@/components/setup/ModelPicker"
import { ErrorText, Mono } from "@/components/common"
import { EffortSelect, message } from "@/components/setup/panels"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import { tone, usd, when } from "@/lib/format"
import { goalCard, heldLabel } from "@/lib/projects"

/*
  A project (specs/projects R4.3): its target, kind, goal and model; a request to start a task from, with ideas that fit
  the goal; its tasks; the analyses the specialist left for it, which every new task can read; and the unknowns those
  analyses left open or closed (specs/analysis-contract R2.5).
*/

const GOAL_ICONS: Record<Goal, LucideIcon> = { understand: MapIcon, reimplement: Code2, integrate: Plug, debug: Bug }

export function ProjectView({ id, onOpenTask, onDeleted }: { id: string; onOpenTask(taskId: string): void; onDeleted(): void }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [data, setData] = useState<{ project: ProjectRow; tasks: TaskRow[]; analyses: AnalysisSummary[]; unknowns: UnknownRow[] } | null>(null)
  const [request, setRequest] = useState("")
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const load = useCallback(() => void api.getProject(id).then(setData, (e: unknown) => setError(message(e))), [api, id])
  // The provider's models to pick from, when the project runs on the provider Settings lists (specs/projects R1.8).
  const [models, setModels] = useState<string[]>([])
  const provider = data?.project.provider
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!provider) return
    void api.getSettings().then((s) => (s.provider === provider ? api.listModels().then(setModels, () => setModels([])) : setModels([])))
  }, [api, provider])
  const change = (patch: Parameters<typeof api.updateProject>[1]) =>
    void api.updateProject(id, patch).then(
      () => load(),
      (e: unknown) => setError(message(e)),
    )
  useEffect(() => {
    load()
    // A task of the project that moves, or one that goes, changes what the view lists.
    return window.hfr.onPush((p) => {
      if (
        (p.type === "task" && p.task.projectId === id) ||
        p.type === "taskDeleted" ||
        (p.type === "step" && p.step.kind === "delegation") ||
        (p.type === "project" && p.project.id === id)
      )
        load()
    })
  }, [load, id])

  const start = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError("")
    try {
      const t = await api.startTask({ projectId: id, request })
      setRequest("")
      onOpenTask(t.id)
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  if (!data) return <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
  const { project, tasks, analyses, unknowns } = data
  const card = goalCard(project.goal)
  const GoalIcon = GOAL_ICONS[project.goal]
  // Another app running a task of it holds it: its tasks are read here, and run there (specs/shared-data-folder R1.3).
  const held = heldLabel(project)
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-4xl flex-col gap-5 p-8">
      <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="truncate text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{project.name}</h1>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <Badge variant="info">
              <FileSearch size={12} /> {project.targetKind}
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="neutral">
              <GoalIcon size={12} /> {card.title}
            </Badge>
            <Mono className="text-muted-foreground">{project.provider}</Mono>
            {held && (
              <Badge variant="warn">
                <Lock size={12} /> {held}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          <Mono className="mt-1.5 block truncate text-muted-foreground" title={project.targetPath}>
            {project.targetPath}
          </Mono>
        </div>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="destructive"
          disabled={!!held}
          onClick={() =>
            // Deleting removes the project's tasks, sandboxes and folder for good (specs/projects R3.2).
            window.confirm(`Delete "${project.name}" with its tasks, sandboxes and files? This cannot be undone.`) &&
            void api.deleteProject(id).then(onDeleted, (e: unknown) => setError(message(e)))
          }
        >
          <Trash2 size={14} /> Delete project
        </Button>
      </header>

      <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">Model</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">What the project's tasks run with. A change applies to each task from its next turn.</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3">
          <ModelPicker key={project.model} provider={project.provider} value={project.model} listed={models} onChange={(m) => change({ model: m })} />
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Orchestrator's effort
            <EffortSelect value={project.orchestratorEffort} options={ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => change({ orchestratorEffort: v })} />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Specialist's effort
            <EffortSelect value={project.specialistEffort} options={SPECIALIST_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => change({ specialistEffort: v })} />
          </label>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">New task</h2>
        <Textarea
          rows={4}
          value={request}
          onChange={(e) => setRequest(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Say what you want: what to find, explain or build."
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && request.trim() && !busy) void start()
          }}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Lightbulb size={14} className="text-muted-foreground" />
          {card.ideas.map((idea) => (
            <Button key={idea} size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setRequest(idea)}>
              {idea}
            </Button>
          ))}
          <Button className="ml-auto" disabled={!request.trim() || busy || !!held} title={held ?? undefined} onClick={start}>
            <Play size={14} /> Start
          </Button>
        </div>
        <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <Card className="flex flex-col p-0">
          <h2 className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Tasks</h2>
          {tasks.length === 0 && <p className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">No task yet. Start one above.</p>}
          <ul className="flex flex-col">
            {tasks.map((t) => (
              <li key={t.id}>
                <button onClick={() => onOpenTask(t.id)} className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-accent">
                  <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm">{t.request}</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    <Badge variant={tone(t.state)}>{t.state}</Badge>
                    {when(t.createdAt)}
                    <span className="ml-auto font-mono">{usd(t.costUsd + t.specialistCostUsd)}</span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Card>
        <Card className="flex flex-col p-0">
          <h2 className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 font-semibold">What the specialist found</h2>
          {analyses.length === 0 && (
            <p className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Each delegation's report lands here, and every new task can read it.</p>
          )}
          <ul className="flex flex-col">
            {analyses.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.id}>
                <button onClick={() => onOpenTask(a.taskId)} className="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-accent">
                  <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm">{a.objective}</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    <Badge variant={tone(a.state)}>{a.state}</Badge>
                    {a.evidence} evidence
                    <span className="ml-auto">{when(a.createdAt)}</span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Card>
      </div>
      {unknowns.length > 0 && <Unknowns items={unknowns} />}
    </div>
  )
}

const SEVERITY = { high: "bad", medium: "warn", low: "neutral" } as const

/** The project's unknowns ledger: open ones first, each with what would settle it; closed ones with their resolution. */
function Unknowns({ items }: { items: UnknownRow[] }) {
  const open = items.filter((u) => !u.closedBy).length
  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col p-0">
      <h2 className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 font-semibold">
        Unknowns <span className="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">{open} open</span>
      </h2>
      <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border">
        {items.map((u) => (
          <li key={u.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-2.5">
            <span className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
              <Badge variant={u.closedBy ? "ok" : SEVERITY[u.severity]}>{u.closedBy ? "closed" : u.severity}</Badge>
              <span className={u.closedBy ? "text-muted-foreground line-through" : ""}>{u.question}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              <Mono>{u.id}</Mono>
              {u.closedBy ? ` · ${u.resolution}` : u.settle ? ` · would be settled by: ${u.settle}` : ""}
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

`src/renderer/src/views/Settings.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Wand2 } from "lucide-react"
import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS, SPECIALIST_EFFORTS, type Settings } from "@shared/types"
import { ErrorText, Field, PanelHeader } from "@/components/common"
import { IntegrationsPanel } from "@/components/setup/IntegrationsPanel"
import { ClaudePanel, EffortSelect, message, ModelPanel, SandboxPanel } from "@/components/setup/panels"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs"
import { FIRST_SECTION, SETTINGS_SECTIONS, type SettingsSection } from "@/lib/settings"

/*
  Settings, one tab per section (specs/desktop-ui R1.4): the orchestrator's provider, key, endpoint, model and effort;
  the sandbox images and the delegation timeout; the Claude sign-in and the specialist's effort; the MCP integrations
  (specs/mcp-integrations R1, R2); and the waits on the user (specs/desktop-ui R1). The first-run setup is reachable
  again from here (specs/onboarding R2.2).
*/

export function SettingsView({ onSetup }: { onSetup(): void }) {
  const api = window.hfr.api
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings | null>(null)
  const [section, setSection] = useState<SettingsSection>(FIRST_SECTION)
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getSettings().then(setSettings)
  }, [api])

  const save = async (patch: Partial<Settings>) => {
    setError("")
    try {
      setSettings(await api.saveSettings(patch))
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e))
    }
  }
  const num = (v: string) => (v.trim() === "" ? NaN : Number(v))

  if (!settings) return null
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-5 p-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Settings</h1>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={onSetup}>
          <Wand2 size={14} /> Run the setup again
        </Button>
      </div>
      <ErrorText>{error}</ErrorText>

      <Tabs value={section} onValueChange={(v) => setSection(v as SettingsSection)}>
        <TabsList className="h-9 w-full">
          {SETTINGS_SECTIONS.map((s) => (
            <TabsTrigger key={s.id} value={s.id}>
              {s.label}
            </TabsTrigger>
          ))}
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="model">
          <Card>
            <PanelHeader title="Orchestrator model" />
            <div className="p-4">
              <ModelPanel>
                {(s, saveModel) => (
                  <Field
                    label="Reasoning effort"
                    hint={`Sent as ${s.provider === "openrouter" ? "OpenRouter's reasoning.effort" : "reasoning_effort"}; models without reasoning ignore it. Default sends nothing.`}
                  >
                    <EffortSelect value={s.orchestratorEffort} options={ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => void saveModel({ orchestratorEffort: v })} />
                  </Field>
                )}
              </ModelPanel>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="sandbox">
          <Card>
            <PanelHeader title="Sandbox (Docker)" />
            <div className="p-4">
              <SandboxPanel>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <Field label="Timeout per delegation (minutes)">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={240}
                      defaultValue={settings.timeoutMinutes}
                      onBlur={(e) => Number.isInteger(num(e.target.value)) && save({ timeoutMinutes: num(e.target.value) })}
                    />
                  </Field>
                </div>
              </SandboxPanel>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="specialist">
          <Card>
            <PanelHeader title="Specialist (Claude Code)" />
            <div className="p-4">
              <ClaudePanel>
                <Field
                  label="Effort"
                  hint="Claude Code's --effort for every delegation. Higher effort thinks longer and uses more of your plan. Default passes nothing."
                >
                  <EffortSelect value={settings.specialistEffort} options={SPECIALIST_EFFORTS} onChange={(v) => save({ specialistEffort: v })} />
                </Field>
              </ClaudePanel>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="mcp">
          <Card>
            <div className="p-4">
              <IntegrationsPanel settings={settings} onSaved={setSettings} />
            </div>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="loop">
          <Card>
            <PanelHeader title="You in the loop" />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                How long the agents wait on you. A tool call you chose to approve is rejected when its wait runs out; a question gets the default the agent
                gave.
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <Field label="Approval timeout (minutes)">
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    max={1440}
                    defaultValue={settings.approvalTimeoutMinutes}
                    onBlur={(e) => Number.isInteger(num(e.target.value)) && save({ approvalTimeoutMinutes: num(e.target.value) })}
                  />
                </Field>
                <Field label="Question timeout (minutes)">
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    max={1440}
                    defaultValue={settings.questionTimeoutMinutes}
                    onBlur={(e) => Number.isInteger(num(e.target.value)) && save({ questionTimeoutMinutes: num(e.target.value) })}
                  />
                </Field>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  )
}
```
