`tui/src/components/Prompt.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes, type TextareaRenderable } from "@opentui/core"
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { completions, readCommand, type Command } from "../app/commands"
import { useApp, useKeys, type ScreenSpec } from "../app/context"
import { PromptHistory } from "../lib/history"
import { insertMention, mentionAt, suggestPaths } from "../lib/mentions"
import { safe } from "./ui"

/*
  The prompt (specs/tui-shell R2.2, specs/tui-conversation R4): a multi-line textarea where Enter sends and Shift+Enter
  or Ctrl+J starts a new line, the session's history on Up and Down at its edges, slash commands completed from the
  screen's list, and `@` paths completed from the project's target folder.
*/

/** Enter sends; Shift+Enter, Alt+Enter and Ctrl+J start a new line (R4.1). */
const KEYS = [
  { name: "return", action: "submit" as const },
  { name: "kpenter", action: "submit" as const },
  { name: "return", shift: true, action: "newline" as const },
  { name: "return", meta: true, action: "newline" as const },
  { name: "j", ctrl: true, action: "newline" as const },
  { name: "linefeed", action: "newline" as const },
]

const history = new PromptHistory()

type Popup = { kind: "cmd"; items: Command[] } | { kind: "path"; items: string[]; mention: { start: number; query: string } }

export function Prompt({
  spec,
  commands,
  resolve,
  focused,
  keys = focused,
  onText,
}: {
  spec: ScreenSpec
  commands: Command[]
  /** the command by name as the screen has it now, run in place of the listed one */
  resolve(name: string): Command | undefined
  focused: boolean
  /** its keys stay in the map while the prompt has the focus, an overlay open or not, so the help lists them */
  keys?: boolean
  onText?(text: string): void
}) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { theme } = app
  const ta = useRef<TextareaRenderable>(null)
  const [text, setText] = useState("")
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(0)
  const [pick, setPick] = useState(0)
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState<string | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    onText?.(text)
  }, [onText, text])

  const root = spec.mentionRoot
  const mention = useMemo(() => (root ? mentionAt(text, cursor) : null), [root, text, cursor])
  const paths = useMemo(() => (mention && root ? suggestPaths(root, mention.query).slice(0, 8) : []), [mention, root])
  const cmds = completions(commands, text)
  let popup: Popup | null = null
  if (cmds.length) popup = { kind: "cmd", items: cmds.slice(0, 12) }
  else if (mention && paths.length) popup = { kind: "path", items: paths, mention }
  if (dismissed === text) popup = null
  const count = popup?.items.length ?? 0
  const at = count ? Math.min(pick, count - 1) : 0

  const set = (v: string, to = v.length) => {
    ta.current?.setText(v)
    if (ta.current) ta.current.cursorOffset = to
    setText(v)
    setCursor(to)
    setPick(0)
  }
  const sync = () => {
    const t = ta.current
    if (!t) return
    setText(t.plainText)
    setCursor(t.cursorOffset)
  }

  const runCommand = async (cmd: Command, arg: string) => {
    try {
      await cmd.run(arg)
    } catch (e) {
      app.toast((e as Error).message, "error")
    }
  }

  const choose = (i: number) => {
    if (!popup) return
    if (popup.kind === "cmd") {
      const c = popup.items[i]
      // A required argument (`<key>`) is typed after the name; a command with none, or an optional one (`[id]`), runs.
      if (c.args?.startsWith("<")) set(`/${c.name} `)
      else {
        set("")
        void runCommand(resolve(c.name) ?? c, "")
      }
    } else {
      const r = insertMention(text, popup.mention, popup.items[i])
      set(r.text, r.cursor)
    }
  }

  const submit = () => {
    if (popup) return choose(at)
    const value = ta.current?.plainText ?? text
    if (!value.trim()) return
    const c = readCommand(value)
    if (c) {
      const cmd = resolve(c.name)
      if (!cmd) return app.toast(`No command /${c.name} here. Type / to see them.`, "error")
      history.add(value)
      set("")
      void runCommand(cmd, c.arg)
      return
    }
    const send = app.current().onSubmit
    if (!send) return app.toast("Type / for this screen's commands.", "info")
    history.add(value)
    set("")
    void Promise.resolve(send(value.trim())).catch((e: unknown) => app.toast((e as Error).message, "error"))
  }

  const row = () => ta.current?.logicalCursor.row ?? 0
  const lastRow = () => (ta.current?.lineCount ?? 1) - 1
  useKeys(
    "prompt",
    "Prompt",
    [
      { key: "tab", label: "Complete", run: () => (popup ? choose(at) : false) },
      {
        key: "up",
        label: "Previous message",
        run: () => {
          if (popup) return void setPick((p) => (p - 1 + count) % count)
          if (row() > 0) return false
          const prev = history.prev(text)
          if (prev === null) return false
          set(prev)
        },
      },
      {
        key: "down",
        label: "Next message",
        run: () => {
          if (popup) return void setPick((p) => (p + 1) % count)
          if (row() < lastRow()) return false
          const next = history.next()
          if (next === null) return false
          set(next)
        },
      },
      { key: "escape", label: "Close the list", run: () => (popup ? void setDismissed(text) : false) },
      { key: "ctrl+c", label: "Clear the prompt", run: () => (text ? set("") : false) },
      // `?` in a message being typed is a character; with the prompt empty it opens the help (specs/tui-shell R2.1).
      { key: "?", label: "Keys (prompt empty)", run: () => ((ta.current?.plainText ?? text) ? "input" : false) },
      { key: "return", label: "Send", run: () => "input" },
      { key: "shift+return", label: "New line", run: () => "input" },
      { key: "ctrl+j", label: "New line", run: () => "input" },
    ],
    { active: keys },
  )

  const lines = Math.min(8, Math.max(1, text.split("\n").length))
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" flexShrink={0}>
      {popup && (
        <box flexDirection="column" flexShrink={0} border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={theme.border} backgroundColor={theme.card}>
          {popup.kind === "cmd"
            ? popup.items.map((c, i) => (
                <text key={c.name} bg={i === at ? theme.selection : undefined} wrapMode="none">
                  <span fg={theme.primary}>{`/${c.name}`}</span>
                  {c.args ? <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{` ${c.args}`}</span> : null}
                  <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`  ${c.title}`}</span>
                </text>
              ))
            : popup.items.map((p, i) => (
                <text key={p} bg={i === at ? theme.selection : undefined} fg={theme.foreground} wrapMode="none">
                  {`@${safe(p)}`}
                </text>
              ))}
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.DIM}>
            Tab or Enter picks · ↑ ↓ move · Esc closes
          </text>
        </box>
      )}
      <box border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={focused ? theme.primary : theme.border} height={lines + 2} flexDirection="row">
        <text fg={theme.primary}>{"› "}</text>
        <textarea
          ref={ta}
          flexGrow={1}
          focused={focused}
          keyBindings={KEYS}
          placeholder={spec.placeholder ?? "Type / for commands"}
          placeholderColor={theme.mutedForeground}
          textColor={theme.foreground}
          focusedTextColor={theme.foreground}
          onSubmit={submit}
          onContentChange={sync}
          onCursorChange={sync}
        />
      </box>
    </box>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import type { EventRow, TaskHistory } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { tokens, tone, usd } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { filesOfStep } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/store"
import { useApp } from "../app/context"
import { toneColor } from "../app/theme"
import { safe } from "./ui"

/*
  The task's sidebar (specs/tui-panels R1.1): the plan, the delegations with their state, the usage per agent with the
  specialist's cost marked as an estimate, and the files the delegations touched. Toggled with Ctrl+B.
*/

export function Sidebar({ h, events }: { h: TaskHistory; events: EventRow[] }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const todos = h.steps.filter((s) => s.kind === "todo")
  const delegations = h.steps.filter((s) => s.kind === "delegation")
  const files = new Set<string>()
  for (const d of delegations) {
    const f = filesOfStep(events, d.id)
    for (const p of [...f.read, ...f.write, ...f.apply]) files.add(p)
  }
  const title = (t: string) => (
    <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD} marginTop={1}>
      {t}
    </text>
  )
  const mark = (state: string) => (state === "done" ? "✓" : state === "running" ? "▸" : state === "failed" || state === "cancelled" ? "✗" : "·")
  return (
    <box width={40} flexShrink={0} flexDirection="column" border={["left"]} borderColor={theme.border} paddingLeft={1}>
      {title("Plan")}
      {todos.length ? (
        todos.map((s) => (
          <text key={s.id} fg={toneColor(theme, tone(s.state))}>
            {`${mark(s.state)} `}
            <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(s.title)}</span>
          </text>
        ))
      ) : (
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>No plan yet.</text>
      )}
      {title(`Specialist (${delegations.length})`)}
      {delegations.map((s) => (
        <text key={s.id} fg={toneColor(theme, tone(s.state))} wrapMode="none">
          {`${mark(s.state)} `}
          <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(s.title.slice(0, 34))}</span>
        </text>
      ))}
      {!delegations.length && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>No delegation yet.</text>}
      {title("Usage")}
      {h.usage.map((u) => (
        <text key={u.agent} fg={theme.foreground} wrapMode="none">
          {`${u.agent.padEnd(13)}`}
          <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`${tokens(u.tokensIn)}↑ ${tokens(u.tokensOut)}↓ `}</span>
          {u.estimate ? `~${usd(u.costUsd)}` : usd(u.costUsd)}
        </text>
      ))}
      <text fg={theme.foreground}>
        {"Total        "}
        <span attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>{usd(h.task.costUsd + h.task.specialistCostUsd)}</span>
      </text>
      {h.usage.some((u) => u.estimate) && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>~ Claude Code's estimate against your plan, not a charge.</text>}
      {title(`Files (${files.size})`)}
      {[...files].slice(0, 12).map((f) => (
        <text key={f} fg={theme.mutedForeground} wrapMode="none">
          {safe(f)}
        </text>
      ))}
      {files.size > 12 && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`… ${files.size - 12} more`}</text>}
    </box>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/components/decisions.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useState } from "react"
import { checkAnswer, type Answer, type Question, type ToolDecision } from "../../../src/shared/chat"
import type { PatchView } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { parseArgs, type GatedCall } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/chat"
import { diffLines } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { useApp, useKeys, type AppState } from "../app/context"
import { InputDialog } from "./dialogs"
import { Frame, List, safe } from "./ui"

/*
  The decisions a task waits on, in dialogs (specs/tui-conversation R3): a question by its kind, the choice after a
  safeguard refusal among them, a gated call to approve, edit or reject, and a patch's diff to approve or reject.
*/

/** A patch's files and diff, lines colored by kind (R3.1). */
export function Diff({ patch, max = 400 }: { patch: PatchView; max?: number }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const lines = diffLines(patch.diff)
  const color = { add: theme.success, del: theme.destructive, hunk: theme.primary, file: theme.warning, ctx: theme.mutedForeground }
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text fg={theme.foreground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
        {`Patch ${patch.state} · ${patch.files.length} file(s)`}
        {patch.conflicts.length ? <span fg={theme.destructive}>{` · conflicts: ${safe(patch.conflicts.join(", "))}`}</span> : null}
      </text>
      {lines.slice(0, max).map((l, i) => (
        <text key={i} fg={color[l.kind]} wrapMode="char">
          {safe(l.text) || " "}
        </text>
      ))}
      {lines.length > max ? <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`… ${lines.length - max} more lines`}</text> : null}
    </box>
  )
}

/** Answer a question with the input its kind calls for; null when the dialog is closed unanswered (R3.3). */
export async function askQuestion(app: AppState, agent: string, q: Question): Promise<Answer | null> {
  if (q.kind === "choice" || q.kind === "yesno") {
    const options: { id: string; value: Answer }[] =
      q.kind === "yesno"
        ? [
            { id: "yes", value: true },
            { id: "no", value: false },
          ]
        : (q.choices ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c, value: c }))
    const id = await app.dialog<string>((done) => <ChoiceQuestion agent={agent} q={q} options={options.map((o) => o.id)} done={done} />)
    return id === null ? null : (options.find((o) => o.id === id)?.value ?? null)
  }
  const typed = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
    <InputDialog
      title={`${agent} asks`}
      body={`${q.prompt}\n\nWhy: ${q.reason}\nDefault: ${String(q.default)}`}
      initial={String(q.default)}
      check={(v) => {
        try {
          checkAnswer(q, q.kind === "number" ? Number(v.trim()) : v)
          return q.kind === "number" && !v.trim() ? "Answer with a number." : null
        } catch (e) {
          return (e as Error).message
        }
      }}
      done={done}
    />
  ))
  if (typed === null) return null
  return q.kind === "number" ? Number(typed.trim()) : typed
}

function ChoiceQuestion({ agent, q, options, done }: { agent: string; q: Question; options: string[]; done(id: string | null): void }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const def = q.kind === "yesno" ? (q.default === true ? "yes" : "no") : String(q.default)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(options.includes(def) ? def : (options[0] ?? null))
  useKeys("dialog:question", "Question", [{ key: "escape", label: "Later", run: () => done(null) }], { modal: true })
  return (
    <Frame title={`${agent} asks`} footer="↑ ↓ choose · Enter answers · Esc answers later with /answer">
      <text fg={theme.foreground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
        {safe(q.prompt)}
      </text>
      <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`Why: ${safe(q.reason)}`}</text>
      <box marginTop={1}>
        <List
          id="question"
          items={options.map((o) => ({ id: o, label: o, detail: o === def ? "default" : undefined }))}
          selected={selected}
          onMove={setSelected}
          onPick={(id) => done(id)}
        />
      </box>
    </Frame>
  )
}

/** Decide a gated call: approve it, run it with edited arguments, or reject it with a reason (R3.2). */
export async function decideCall(app: AppState, call: GatedCall, patch?: PatchView): Promise<ToolDecision | null> {
  const choice = await app.dialog<string>((done) => <CallDialog call={call} patch={patch} done={done} />)
  if (choice === "approve") return { type: "approve" }
  if (choice === "reject") {
    const why = await app.dialog<string>((done) => <InputDialog title="Reject the call" body="Why, for the agent to read (optional)" done={done} />)
    if (why === null) return null
    return why.trim() ? { type: "reject", message: why.trim() } : { type: "reject" }
  }
  if (choice === "edit") {
    const text = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
      <InputDialog
        title={`Edit ${call.name}'s arguments`}
        body="The arguments as JSON, on one line."
        initial={JSON.stringify(call.args)}
        check={(v) => {
          const r = parseArgs(v)
          return "error" in r ? r.error : null
        }}
        done={done}
      />
    ))
    if (text === null) return null
    const r = parseArgs(text)
    return "args" in r ? { type: "edit", args: r.args } : null
  }
  return null
}

function CallDialog({ call, patch, done }: { call: GatedCall; patch?: PatchView; done(v: string | null): void }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>("approve")
  useKeys("dialog:call", "Gated call", [{ key: "escape", label: "Later", run: () => done(null) }], { modal: true })
  return (
    <Frame title={`The agent wants to run ${call.name}`} width={100} footer="↑ ↓ choose · Enter decides · Esc decides later with /decide">
      {patch ? (
        <scrollbox height={16}>
          <Diff patch={patch} />
        </scrollbox>
      ) : (
        <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(JSON.stringify(call.args, null, 2).slice(0, 2000))}</text>
      )}
      <box marginTop={1}>
        <List
          id="call"
          items={[
            { id: "approve", label: "Approve", detail: "run it as it is" },
            { id: "edit", label: "Edit", detail: "run it with other arguments" },
            { id: "reject", label: "Reject", detail: "the agent reads why" },
          ]}
          selected={selected}
          onMove={setSelected}
          onPick={(id) => done(id)}
        />
      </box>
    </Frame>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/components/dialogs.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useState } from "react"
import { search } from "../app/commands"
import { useApp, useKeys } from "../app/context"
import { Frame, List, safe, type Item } from "./ui"

/*
  The dialogs the TUI asks with (specs/tui-shell R3.1): a confirmation, a typed value, a choice with a filter. Each is
  a modal layer of the key map while open, so the screen under it sees no key; Esc closes it with no answer.
*/

export function ConfirmDialog({ title, body, yes = "Yes", done }: { title: string; body: string; yes?: string; done(v: boolean | null): void }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  useKeys(
    "dialog:confirm",
    title,
    [
      { key: "y", label: yes, run: () => done(true) },
      { key: "return", label: yes, run: () => done(true) },
      { key: "n", label: "No", run: () => done(false) },
      { key: "escape", label: "Cancel", run: () => done(null) },
    ],
    { modal: true },
  )
  return (
    <Frame title={title} footer={`Enter or y: ${yes.toLowerCase()} · n or Esc: no`}>
      <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(body)}</text>
    </Frame>
  )
}

/** A value typed: `check` returns why it does not fit, shown under the field, or null to accept it. */
export function InputDialog({
  title,
  body,
  initial = "",
  placeholder,
  check,
  done,
}: {
  title: string
  body?: string
  initial?: string
  placeholder?: string
  check?(v: string): string | null
  done(v: string | null): void
}) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial)
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const submit = (v: string) => {
    const why = check?.(v) ?? null
    if (why) setError(why)
    else done(v)
  }
  useKeys("dialog:input", title, [{ key: "escape", label: "Cancel", run: () => done(null) }], { modal: true })
  return (
    <Frame title={title} footer="Enter: accept · Esc: cancel">
      {body ? <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(body)}</text> : null}
      <box border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={theme.primary} height={3} marginTop={body ? 1 : 0}>
        <input
          value={value}
          focused
          placeholder={placeholder}
          textColor={theme.foreground}
          onInput={(v: string) => {
            setValue(v)
            setError("")
          }}
          onSubmit={(v: unknown) => submit(typeof v === "string" ? v : value)}
        />
      </box>
      {error ? <text fg={theme.destructive}>{safe(error)}</text> : null}
    </Frame>
  )
}

/** A choice among items, narrowed by typing (specs/tui-shell R2.3 for the palette, and every picker). */
export function SelectDialog({
  title,
  items,
  initial,
  body,
  filter = true,
  done,
  height = 12,
}: {
  title: string
  items: Item[]
  initial?: string | null
  body?: string
  filter?: boolean
  done(id: string | null): void
  height?: number
}) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
  const shown = query
    ? search(
        items.map((i) => ({ name: i.id, title: `${i.label} ${i.detail ?? ""}`, run: () => undefined })),
        query,
      ).map((c) => items.find((i) => i.id === c.name)!)
    : items
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(initial ?? items[0]?.id ?? null)
  const sel = shown.some((i) => i.id === selected) ? selected : (shown[0]?.id ?? null)
  useKeys("dialog:select", title, [{ key: "escape", label: "Cancel", run: () => done(null) }], { modal: true })
  return (
    <Frame title={title} footer={`↑ ↓ choose · Enter pick · Esc cancel${filter ? " · type to filter" : ""}`}>
      {body ? <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(body)}</text> : null}
      {filter && (
        <box border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={theme.border} height={3}>
          <input
            value={query}
            focused
            placeholder="Filter…"
            textColor={theme.foreground}
            onInput={(v: string) => {
              setQuery(v)
              // A new filter starts from its best match.
              setSelected(null)
            }}
            onSubmit={() => void (sel && done(sel))}
          />
        </box>
      )}
      <List id="dialog" items={shown} selected={sel} onMove={setSelected} onPick={(id) => done(id)} height={height} empty="Nothing matches." />
      {!filter && <text attributes={TextAttributes.DIM}> </text>}
    </Frame>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/components/ui.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { terminalSafe } from "../lib/safe"
import { useApp, useKeys } from "../app/context"

/*
  The TUI's building blocks: a framed overlay, a keyboard list that keeps its selection by id (specs/tui-shell R1.5),
  and a one-line field. Every text drawn from the API goes through `terminalSafe` (R3.3).
*/

/** Text from the API, made safe to draw. */
export const safe = (s: string) => terminalSafe(s)

/** An overlay centred over the screen, with a title and a border. */
export function Frame({ title, children, width = 72, footer }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; width?: number | `${number}%`; footer?: string }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  return (
    <box position="absolute" top={2} left={0} width="100%" alignItems="center" zIndex={20}>
      <box
        width={width}
        maxWidth="96%"
        border
        borderStyle="rounded"
        borderColor={theme.primary}
        backgroundColor={theme.card}
        title={` ${safe(title)} `}
        titleAlignment="left"
        flexDirection="column"
        paddingLeft={1}
        paddingRight={1}
      >
        {children}
        {footer && (
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.DIM}>
            {footer}
          </text>
        )}
      </box>
    </box>
  )
}

export interface Item {
  id: string
  label: string
  /** a second, dimmer part on the same line */
  detail?: string
  color?: string
}

/**
  A list moved with the arrows and picked with Enter. The selection is an id, so an item pushed above it does not move
  it (R1.5). `active` binds the keys; only one list on a screen takes them at a time.
*/
export function List({
  id,
  items,
  selected,
  onMove,
  onPick,
  active = true,
  height = 10,
  empty = "Nothing here.",
}: {
  id: string
  items: Item[]
  selected: string | null
  onMove(id: string): void
  onPick(id: string): void
  active?: boolean
  height?: number
  empty?: string
}) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const at = Math.max(
    0,
    items.findIndex((i) => i.id === selected),
  )
  const move = (by: number) => {
    if (!items.length) return
    const next = Math.min(items.length - 1, Math.max(0, at + by))
    onMove(items[next].id)
  }
  useKeys(
    `list:${id}`,
    "List",
    [
      { key: "up", label: "Previous", run: () => move(-1) },
      { key: "down", label: "Next", run: () => move(1) },
      { key: "pageup", label: "Page up", run: () => move(-height) },
      { key: "pagedown", label: "Page down", run: () => move(height) },
      { key: "home", label: "First", run: () => move(-items.length) },
      { key: "end", label: "Last", run: () => move(items.length) },
      { key: "return", label: "Open", run: () => items[at] && onPick(items[at].id) },
    ],
    { active },
  )
  if (!items.length)
    return (
      <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.DIM}>
        {empty}
      </text>
    )
  const first = Math.min(Math.max(0, at - Math.floor(height / 2)), Math.max(0, items.length - height))
  const shown = items.slice(first, first + height)
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      {shown.map((item) => {
        const on = item.id === items[at]?.id
        return (
          <box key={item.id} flexDirection="row" backgroundColor={on ? theme.selection : undefined}>
            <text fg={on ? theme.primary : theme.mutedForeground}>{on ? "› " : "  "}</text>
            <text fg={item.color ?? theme.foreground} wrapMode="none">
              {safe(item.label)}
              {item.detail ? <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`  ${safe(item.detail)}`}</span> : null}
            </text>
          </box>
        )
      })}
      {items.length > height && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.DIM}>{`  ${at + 1}/${items.length}`}</text>}
    </box>
  )
}

/** A list with its own selection, for dialogs and screens that need no more. */
export function PickList(props: Omit<Parameters<typeof List>[0], "selected" | "onMove"> & { initial?: string | null }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(props.initial ?? props.items[0]?.id ?? null)
  return <List {...props} selected={selected} onMove={setSelected} />
}

/** A labelled one-line field. */
export function Field({
  label,
  value,
  onInput,
  onSubmit,
  focused,
  placeholder,
  note,
  noteColor,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  onInput(v: string): void
  onSubmit?(v: string): void
  focused: boolean
  placeholder?: string
  note?: string
  noteColor?: string
}) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" marginBottom={0}>
      <text fg={focused ? theme.primary : theme.mutedForeground}>{label}</text>
      <box border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={focused ? theme.primary : theme.border} height={3}>
        <input
          value={value}
          onInput={onInput}
          onSubmit={(v: unknown) => onSubmit?.(typeof v === "string" ? v : value)}
          focused={focused}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          textColor={theme.foreground}
        />
      </box>
      {note ? <text fg={noteColor ?? theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(note)}</text> : null}
    </box>
  )
}

/** A choice among a few values, changed with Left and Right while focused. */
export function Choice<T extends string>({
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  focused,
}: {
  label: string
  value: T
  options: readonly T[]
  onChange(v: T): void
  focused: boolean
}) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const at = options.indexOf(value)
  useKeys(
    `choice:${label}`,
    label,
    [
      { key: "left", label: "Previous value", run: () => onChange(options[(at - 1 + options.length) % options.length]) },
      { key: "right", label: "Next value", run: () => onChange(options[(at + 1) % options.length]) },
    ],
    { active: focused },
  )
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text fg={focused ? theme.primary : theme.mutedForeground}>{label}</text>
      <text>
        {options.map((o) => (
          <span
            key={o}
            fg={o === value ? theme.background : theme.mutedForeground}
            bg={o === value ? (focused ? theme.primary : theme.mutedForeground) : undefined}
          >
            {` ${o} `}
          </span>
        ))}
        {focused ? <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{"   ← →"}</span> : null}
      </text>
    </box>
  )
}
```

```ts
import type { KeyStore } from "../../src/main/credentials"

/*
  Where the 0.1 TUI kept keys before the shared keychain (specs/shared-data-folder R5.2): `Bun.secrets`, one entry per
  slot under one service. Read once at start, moved into the shared store and removed from here.
*/

export const SERVICE = "harness-for-rea"

export function bunSecretsKeyStore(service = SERVICE): KeyStore {
  return {
    available: () => typeof Bun !== "undefined" && typeof Bun.secrets?.get === "function",
    read: async (slot) => (await Bun.secrets.get({ service, name: slot })) ?? null,
    write: async (slot, key) => {
      if (key === null) await Bun.secrets.delete({ service, name: slot })
      else await Bun.secrets.set({ service, name: slot, value: key })
    },
  }
}
```

`tui/src/lib/history.ts`:

```ts
/*
  The prompt's history (specs/tui-conversation R4.2): the messages sent this session, newest last. Up walks back from
  what is being typed, Down walks forward to it again, so a draft is never lost to a look at the history.
*/

export class PromptHistory {
  private readonly sent: string[] = []
  /** where Up and Down are: `sent.length` is the draft */
  private at = 0
  private draft = ""

  constructor(private readonly max = 200) {}

  /** A message sent: kept unless it repeats the last one, and the walk starts again from the draft. */
  add(text: string): void {
    const t = text.trim()
    if (t && this.sent.at(-1) !== t) this.sent.push(t)
    if (this.sent.length > this.max) this.sent.shift()
    this.at = this.sent.length
    this.draft = ""
  }

  /** The older message, or null at the oldest; `current` is kept as the draft when the walk starts. */
  prev(current: string): string | null {
    if (this.at === 0) return null
    if (this.at === this.sent.length) this.draft = current
    this.at--
    return this.sent[this.at]
  }

  /** The newer message, the draft once past the newest, or null when already at the draft. */
  next(): string | null {
    if (this.at >= this.sent.length) return null
    this.at++
    return this.at === this.sent.length ? this.draft : this.sent[this.at]
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.sent.length
  }
}
```

`tui/src/lib/launch.ts`:

```ts
import { posix, win32 } from "node:path"
import type { ProjectRow } from "../../../src/shared/types"

/*
  The folder the TUI is run in as a project's target (specs/tui-launch R1): which projects already have it, whether it
  is too broad to mount without the user typing it, and what the TUI opens first. Pure: the paths, the platform and
  the data folder come in as arguments.
*/

export type Platform = "win32" | "darwin" | "linux"

export interface Where {
  platform: Platform
  home: string
  /** the app's data folder */
  dataDir: string
  env: Record<string, string | undefined>
}

export type Risk = { kind: "ok" } | { kind: "confirm"; why: string } | { kind: "refuse"; why: string }

const pathOf = (p: Platform) => (p === "win32" ? win32 : posix)

/** A path normalised for comparison: resolved, without a trailing separator, lower-cased on Windows. */
function norm(path: string, platform: Platform): string {
  const lib = pathOf(platform)
  let out = lib.resolve(platform === "win32" ? path.replace(/\//g, "\\") : path)
  const root = lib.parse(out).root
  if (out.length > root.length) out = out.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "")
  return platform === "win32" ? out.toLowerCase() : out
}

export function samePath(a: string, b: string, platform: Platform): boolean {
  return norm(a, platform) === norm(b, platform)
}

/** Whether `inner` is `outer` or inside it. */
function within(inner: string, outer: string, platform: Platform): boolean {
  const i = norm(inner, platform)
  const o = norm(outer, platform)
  const sep = platform === "win32" ? "\\" : "/"
  return i === o || i.startsWith(o.endsWith(sep) ? o : o + sep)
}

/**
  Why a folder is too broad to mount into a sandbox without the user typing it (R1.5), or that it is the app's data
  folder, which is refused (R1.6): every task's files, the database and the keys' records live there.
*/
export function riskOf(folder: string, w: Where): Risk {
  const { platform } = w
  const lib = pathOf(platform)
  if (within(folder, w.dataDir, platform)) return { kind: "refuse", why: "This is the app's own data folder, which no sandbox may mount." }
  const f = norm(folder, platform)
  if (f === norm(lib.parse(f).root, platform)) return { kind: "confirm", why: platform === "win32" ? "the root of a drive" : "the root of the file system" }
  if (f === norm(w.home, platform)) return { kind: "confirm", why: "your home folder" }
  if (lib.basename(f).toLowerCase() === "downloads" && norm(lib.dirname(f), platform) === norm(w.home, platform))
    return { kind: "confirm", why: "a Downloads folder" }
  if (within(w.dataDir, folder, platform)) return { kind: "confirm", why: "a folder holding the app's data" }
  return { kind: "ok" }
}

/** The projects whose target is the folder, newest first (R1.2, R1.3). */
export function matchProjects(projects: ProjectRow[], folder: string, platform: Platform): ProjectRow[] {
  return projects.filter((p) => samePath(p.targetPath, folder, platform)).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

export type LaunchPlan =
  | { kind: "setup" }
  | { kind: "open"; projectId: string; then?: "continue" | "resume" }
  | { kind: "pick"; projectIds: string[] }
  | { kind: "create"; confirm: string | null }
  | { kind: "refuse"; why: string }

/** What the TUI opens first for the folder (R1.2–R1.6, R2.1–R2.3). */
export function launchPlan(o: {
  folder: string
  platform: Platform
  projects: ProjectRow[]
  risk: Risk
  setupCompleted: boolean
  continue: boolean
  resume: boolean
}): LaunchPlan {
  if (!o.setupCompleted) return { kind: "setup" }
  const matches = matchProjects(o.projects, o.folder, o.platform)
  if (matches.length === 1) {
    const then = o.continue ? "continue" : o.resume ? "resume" : undefined
    return then ? { kind: "open", projectId: matches[0].id, then } : { kind: "open", projectId: matches[0].id }
  }
  if (matches.length > 1) return { kind: "pick", projectIds: matches.map((p) => p.id) }
  if (o.risk.kind === "refuse") return { kind: "refuse", why: o.risk.why }
  return { kind: "create", confirm: o.risk.kind === "confirm" ? o.risk.why : null }
}
```

`tui/src/lib/markdown.ts`:

```ts
import type { Nodes, PhrasingContent, RootContent } from "mdast"
import { fromMarkdown } from "mdast-util-from-markdown"
import { gfmFromMarkdown } from "mdast-util-gfm"
import { gfm } from "micromark-extension-gfm"

/*
  A message's markdown as the TUI draws it (specs/tui-conversation R1.2): parsed with the same GFM grammar the desktop
  app's react-markdown uses, then flattened into blocks of styled runs a terminal can lay out — paragraphs, headings,
  list items with their marker and depth, quotes, code, tables and rules. HTML is shown as the text it is, a link as
  its text and address, an image as its description: nothing in a message is followed or loaded.
*/

export interface Run {
  text: string
  bold?: boolean
  italic?: boolean
  strike?: boolean
  code?: boolean
  /** the address of a link, shown after its text */
  link?: string
}

export type MdBlock =
  | { kind: "para"; runs: Run[]; indent: number; marker: string; quote: number }
  | { kind: "heading"; depth: number; runs: Run[]; quote: number }
  | { kind: "code"; lang: string | null; text: string; indent: number; quote: number }
  | { kind: "table"; rows: Run[][][]; quote: number }
  | { kind: "rule"; quote: number }

type Style = Omit<Run, "text">

function runs(nodes: PhrasingContent[], style: Style = {}): Run[] {
  const out: Run[] = []
  for (const n of nodes) {
    switch (n.type) {
      case "text":
        out.push({ ...style, text: n.value })
        break
      case "strong":
        out.push(...runs(n.children, { ...style, bold: true }))
        break
      case "emphasis":
        out.push(...runs(n.children, { ...style, italic: true }))
        break
      case "delete":
        out.push(...runs(n.children, { ...style, strike: true }))
        break
      case "inlineCode":
        out.push({ ...style, code: true, text: n.value })
        break
      case "break":
        out.push({ ...style, text: "\n" })
        break
      case "link": {
        const inner = runs(n.children, { ...style, link: n.url })
        out.push(...inner)
        const said = inner.map((r) => r.text).join("")
        if (said !== n.url) out.push({ ...style, text: ` (${n.url})` })
        break
      }
      case "image":
        out.push({ ...style, italic: true, text: `[image${n.alt ? `: ${n.alt}` : ""}]` })
        break
      case "html":
        out.push({ ...style, text: n.value })
        break
      default:
        if ("children" in n) out.push(...runs(n.children as PhrasingContent[], style))
        else if ("value" in n) out.push({ ...style, text: String(n.value) })
    }
  }
  return merge(out)
}

/** Adjacent runs of one style joined, so a terminal draws fewer spans. */
function merge(rs: Run[]): Run[] {
  const out: Run[] = []
  for (const r of rs) {
    const last = out.at(-1)
    if (last && last.bold === r.bold && last.italic === r.italic && last.strike === r.strike && last.code === r.code && last.link === r.link)
      last.text += r.text
    else out.push({ ...r })
  }
  return out
}

function blocks(nodes: RootContent[], ctx: { indent: number; quote: number }, out: MdBlock[]): void {
  for (const n of nodes) {
    switch (n.type) {
      case "paragraph":
        out.push({ kind: "para", runs: runs(n.children), indent: ctx.indent, marker: "", quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      case "heading":
        out.push({ kind: "heading", depth: n.depth, runs: runs(n.children), quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      case "code":
        out.push({ kind: "code", lang: n.lang ?? null, text: n.value, indent: ctx.indent, quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      case "thematicBreak":
        out.push({ kind: "rule", quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      case "blockquote":
        blocks(n.children, { ...ctx, quote: ctx.quote + 1 }, out)
        break
      case "list":
        n.children.forEach((item, i) => {
          const marker = item.checked === true ? "[x] " : item.checked === false ? "[ ] " : n.ordered ? `${(n.start ?? 1) + i}. ` : "• "
          const [first, ...rest] = item.children
          if (first?.type === "paragraph") out.push({ kind: "para", runs: runs(first.children), indent: ctx.indent, marker, quote: ctx.quote })
          else {
            out.push({ kind: "para", runs: [], indent: ctx.indent, marker, quote: ctx.quote })
            if (first) rest.unshift(first)
          }
          blocks(rest, { ...ctx, indent: ctx.indent + 1 }, out)
        })
        break
      case "table":
        out.push({ kind: "table", rows: n.children.map((row) => row.children.map((cell) => runs(cell.children))), quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      case "html":
        out.push({ kind: "para", runs: [{ text: n.value }], indent: ctx.indent, marker: "", quote: ctx.quote })
        break
      default:
        if ("children" in n) blocks((n as { children: RootContent[] }).children, ctx, out)
    }
  }
}

/** A message's markdown as blocks of styled runs. */
export function parseMarkdown(text: string): MdBlock[] {
  const tree = fromMarkdown(text, { extensions: [gfm()], mdastExtensions: [gfmFromMarkdown()] }) as Nodes
  const out: MdBlock[] = []
  if (tree.type === "root") blocks(tree.children, { indent: 0, quote: 0 }, out)
  return out
}

/** The plain text of runs, as a line of a table cell or a test reads it. */
export const plainOf = (rs: Run[]) => rs.map((r) => r.text).join("")
```

`tui/src/lib/mentions.ts`:

```ts
import { readdirSync, type Dirent } from "node:fs"
import { join, relative, sep } from "node:path"

/*
  `@` mentions in the prompt (specs/tui-conversation R4.3): what follows an `@` is completed from the paths of the
  project's target folder, folders first, so a message can name a file the orchestrator then finds under its
  workspace. Folders that hold nothing worth naming are skipped, and the walk is bounded.
*/

const SKIP = new Set(["node_modules", ".git", ".hg", ".svn", "__pycache__", ".venv", "dist", "build", "target", "out"])
const MAX_RESULTS = 50
const UNSAFE_NAME = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/
const MAX_SCANNED = 20_000

/** The `@` mention the cursor is in: where it starts and what is typed after the `@`, or null. */
export function mentionAt(text: string, cursor: number): { start: number; query: string } | null {
  const before = text.slice(0, cursor)
  const m = /(?:^|\s)@([^\s@]*)$/.exec(before)
  if (!m) return null
  return { start: cursor - m[1].length - 1, query: m[1] }
}

export type ReadDir = (dir: string) => Dirent[]

/** The target's paths, relative and with `/`, that contain the query's letters in order, best first, at most 50. */
export function suggestPaths(root: string, query: string, read: ReadDir = (d) => readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })): string[] {
  const q = query.replace(/\\/g, "/").toLowerCase()
  const found: { path: string; score: number }[] = []
  const queue = [root]
  let scanned = 0
  while (queue.length && scanned < MAX_SCANNED) {
    const dir = queue.shift()!
    let entries: Dirent[]
    try {
      entries = read(dir)
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (++scanned > MAX_SCANNED) break
      // A name with controls, bidi marks or line breaks would carry them into the message; it is never offered.
      if (SKIP.has(e.name) || UNSAFE_NAME.test(e.name)) continue
      const full = join(dir, e.name)
      const rel = relative(root, full).split(sep).join("/") + (e.isDirectory() ? "/" : "")
      const score = matchScore(q, rel.toLowerCase())
      if (score >= 0) found.push({ path: rel, score: score + (e.isDirectory() ? 0.5 : 0) })
      if (e.isDirectory()) queue.push(full)
    }
  }
  return found
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path))
    .slice(0, MAX_RESULTS)
    .map((f) => f.path)
}

/** A path matches when the query is its prefix, a substring, or its letters in order; -1 otherwise. */
function matchScore(q: string, path: string): number {
  if (!q) return path.split("/").filter(Boolean).length === 1 ? 2 : -1
  if (path.startsWith(q)) return 10
  const name = path.replace(/\/$/, "").split("/").at(-1) ?? ""
  if (name.startsWith(q)) return 8
  if (path.includes(q)) return 6
  let at = -1
  for (const ch of q) {
    at = path.indexOf(ch, at + 1)
    if (at < 0) return -1
  }
  return 1
}

/** The prompt's text with the mention replaced by the chosen path, and where the cursor goes after it. */
export function insertMention(text: string, mention: { start: number; query: string }, path: string): { text: string; cursor: number } {
  const end = mention.start + 1 + mention.query.length
  const inserted = `@${path}${path.endsWith("/") ? "" : " "}`
  return { text: text.slice(0, mention.start) + inserted + text.slice(end), cursor: mention.start + inserted.length }
}
```

`tui/src/lib/safe.ts`:

```ts
/*
  Text from the target, the agents or a tool, made safe to draw (specs/tui-shell R3.3): every control character but
  the newline and the tab removed, so nothing in it reaches the terminal as an escape sequence — a title, the
  clipboard, a cursor move — and the bidirectional overrides and isolates, so nothing reorders the text around it.
*/

// C0 and C1 controls but the tab and the newline, DEL, and the bidi overrides and isolates.
const CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u0008\u000b-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g

export function terminalSafe(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(CONTROL, "")
}
```

`tui/src/lib/transcript.ts`:

```ts
import type { ContextPackage, Evidence } from "../../../src/shared/context"
import type { StepRow, TaskRow, TaskState } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { canClose, canContinue, canDelete, canStop, type ToolItem } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/chat"
import { tokens, usd } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { canRetry, isLive, type FilesTouched } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/store"

/*
  What the transcript says about each item, as text (specs/tui-conversation R1.3, R1.4, R2.1, R2.2): a tool call on
  one line, a delegation's sections, the working line, and the actions a task's state offers. Pure, so the screen only
  lays these out.
*/

const oneLine = (s: string, max: number) => {
  const flat = s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
  return flat.length > max ? `${flat.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : flat
}

/** The argument that says most about a call: a path, a command, a pattern or a query, else the first string. */
export function argSummary(input: string, max = 80): string {
  let args: unknown
  try {
    args = JSON.parse(input)
  } catch {
    return oneLine(input, max)
  }
  if (!args || typeof args !== "object") return oneLine(String(args ?? ""), max)
  const o = args as Record<string, unknown>
  for (const k of ["file_path", "path", "command", "pattern", "query", "objective", "url", "glob"])
    if (typeof o[k] === "string" && o[k]) return oneLine(o[k] as string, max)
  const first = Object.values(o).find((v) => typeof v === "string" && v)
  return first ? oneLine(first as string, max) : ""
}

export type CallState = "running" | "failed" | "done"

export const callState = (t: Pick<ToolItem, "output" | "failed">): CallState => (t.output === undefined ? "running" : t.failed ? "failed" : "done")

/** A tool call on one line: its name and its telling argument (R1.3). */
export function toolLine(t: ToolItem): string {
  const arg = argSummary(t.input)
  return arg ? `${t.name}(${arg})` : t.name
}

/** A tool call opened: its arguments as indented JSON, then its output, cut to a screenful (R1.3). */
export function toolDetails(t: ToolItem, maxLines = 40): { input: string; output: string } {
  let input = t.input
  try {
    input = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(t.input), null, 2)
  } catch {
    // shown as it came
  }
  const cut = (s: string) => {
    const lines = s.split("\n")
    return lines.length > maxLines ? [...lines.slice(0, maxLines), `… ${lines.length - maxLines} more lines`].join("\n") : s
  }
  return { input: cut(input), output: t.output === undefined ? "" : cut(t.output) }
}

export interface Section {
  title: string
  lines: string[]
}

/** A delegation opened: its context package, report, evidence and files, each a titled list of lines (R1.4). */
export function delegationSections(step: StepRow, files: FilesTouched): Section[] {
  const pkg = step.data.context as ContextPackage | undefined
  const report = typeof step.data.report === "string" ? step.data.report : ""
  const evidence = (step.data.evidence as Evidence[] | undefined) ?? []
  const error = typeof step.data.error === "string" ? step.data.error : ""
  const out: Section[] = []
  if (error) out.push({ title: "Error", lines: [error] })
  if (pkg) {
    const lines = [`Objective: ${pkg.objective}`, `Mode: ${pkg.mode} · ${pkg.files.length} files`]
    for (const [title, list] of [
      ["Questions", pkg.questions],
      ["Constraints", pkg.constraints],
      ["Environment", pkg.environment],
    ] as const)
      if (list?.length) lines.push(`${title}:`, ...list.map((q) => `  • ${q}`))
    if (pkg.excerpts?.length) lines.push("Excerpts:", ...pkg.excerpts.map((e) => `  ${e.path}:${e.startLine}-${e.endLine}${e.note ? ` — ${e.note}` : ""}`))
    if (pkg.brief) lines.push("Brief:", ...pkg.brief.split("\n").map((l) => `  ${l}`))
    out.push({ title: "Context package", lines })
  }
  if (report) out.push({ title: "Report", lines: [report] })
  if (evidence.length)
    out.push({
      title: `Evidence (${evidence.length})`,
      lines: evidence.map((e) => `${e.ref ?? (e.path ? `${e.path}:${e.startLine}-${e.endLine}` : "")} — ${oneLine(e.claim, 200)}`),
    })
  const fileLines = (["copy", "read", "write", "apply"] as const).filter((op) => files[op].length).map((op) => `${op}: ${files[op].join(", ")}`)
  if (fileLines.length) out.push({ title: "Files", lines: fileLines })
  return out
}

/** `1m 05s`, `42s`, `1h 02m`. */
export function elapsed(ms: number): string {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000))
  if (s < 60) return `${s}s`
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
  if (m < 60) return `${m}m ${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}s`
  return `${Math.floor(m / 60)}h ${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}m`
}

/** The working line while a turn runs: what it does, for how long, and what the task spent (R2.1). */
export function workingLine(
  task: Pick<TaskRow, "tokensIn" | "tokensOut" | "costUsd" | "specialistCostUsd">,
  state: TaskState,
  since: number,
  now: number,
): string {
  const what = state === "pending" ? "Starting the sandbox" : state === "waiting" ? "Waiting for you" : "Working"
  const cost = task.costUsd + task.specialistCostUsd
  return `${what} · ${elapsed(now - since)} · ${tokens(task.tokensIn + task.tokensOut)} tokens · ${usd(cost)}`
}

export type TaskAction = "stop" | "continue" | "close" | "cancel" | "retry" | "delete"

/** The actions the task's state offers, in the order the TUI lists them (R2.2). */
export function actionsFor(state: TaskState): TaskAction[] {
  const out: TaskAction[] = []
  if (canStop(state)) out.push("stop")
  if (canContinue(state)) out.push("continue")
  if (canClose(state)) out.push("close")
  if (isLive(state)) out.push("cancel")
  if (canRetry(state)) out.push("retry")
  if (canDelete(state)) out.push("delete")
  return out
}
```

```tsx
import { spawn } from "node:child_process"
import { existsSync, realpathSync, statSync } from "node:fs"
import { homedir } from "node:os"
import { resolve } from "node:path"
import { createCliRenderer } from "@opentui/core"
import { createRoot } from "@opentui/react"
import { API_METHODS, type Api } from "../../src/shared/api"
import type { Push } from "../../src/shared/types"
import { startCore } from "../../src/main/core"
import { SchemaTooNew } from "../../src/main/db"
import { makeDispatcher } from "../../src/main/ipc"
import { keyringStore } from "../../src/main/keys"
import { defaultDataDir } from "../../src/main/lock"
import pkg from "../../package.json"
import { App } from "./app/App"
import type { AppState, Bus } from "./app/context"
import { browse } from "./app/pickers"
import { themeFor } from "./app/theme"
import { bunSecretsKeyStore } from "./keys"
import type { Platform } from "./lib/launch"
import { parseArgs, sandboxDirFor } from "./paths"

/*
  The TUI's entry (specs/tui-launch R1.1, R1.7, R2.5): the arguments answered before anything starts, the folder it
  is run in checked, then the core the desktop app runs — on the same data folder, beside it and other TUIs
  (adr:0024-share-the-data-folder-between-processes) — and the React shell on OpenTUI
  (adr:0023-build-the-tui-on-opentuis-react-layer). Every call goes through the same validating dispatcher as the
  desktop app's IPC.
*/

/** The TUI's own origin for the dispatcher's page check. */
const PAGE = "tui://local/"

const parsed = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2), pkg.version)
if ("print" in parsed) {
  ;(parsed.code ? console.error : console.log)(parsed.print)
  process.exit(parsed.code)
}
const { args } = parsed

// The folder is checked before the core starts: a mistyped path opens nothing (R1.7).
const given = resolve(args.path ?? process.cwd())
if (!existsSync(given)) {
  console.error(`${given} does not exist.`)
  process.exit(1)
}
// The folder a link or junction leads to, so the data folder and broad folders are recognised however they are named.
const folder = realpathSync.native(given)
if (!statSync(folder).isDirectory()) {
  console.error(`${folder} is a file. Run harness-for-rea in its folder, or create a project on the file with /new.`)
  process.exit(2)
}

const sandboxDir = sandboxDirFor({ env: process.env, execPath: process.execPath, moduleDir: import.meta.dir, exists: existsSync })
if (!sandboxDir) {
  console.error("The sandbox sources (specialist/Dockerfile) were not found; set HFR_SANDBOX_DIR to the folder holding them.")
  process.exit(1)
}

const dataDir = process.env.HFR_DATA_DIR ?? defaultDataDir()
const listeners = new Set<(p: Push) => void>()
const bus: Bus = {
  on: (fn) => {
    listeners.add(fn)
    return () => void listeners.delete(fn)
  },
}
let app: AppState | null = null

/** Opens an Anthropic sign-in page in the user's browser; the core checked the address first. */
function openBrowser(url: string): Promise<void> {
  const [cmd, argv] =
    process.platform === "win32" ? ["rundll32", ["url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", url]] : process.platform === "darwin" ? ["open", [url]] : ["xdg-open", [url]]
  return new Promise((done) => {
    const p = spawn(cmd, argv, { stdio: "ignore", detached: true })
    p.on("error", () => done())
    p.unref()
    done()
  })
}

let core: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof startCore>>
try {
  core = await startCore({
    app: "tui",
    version: pkg.version,
    dataDir,
    sandboxDir,
    push: (p) => {
      for (const fn of listeners) fn(p)
    },
    // The shared keychain both apps read; the 0.1 TUI's `Bun.secrets` keys are moved into it (specs/shared-data-folder R5).
    keys: keyringStore(),
    formerKeys: bunSecretsKeyStore(),
    // The terminal's browser stands in for the desktop app's file dialogs (specs/tui-panels R2.3).
    pickFolder: () => (app ? browse(app, "folder", folder) : Promise.resolve(null)),
    pickTarget: (kind) => (app ? browse(app, kind, folder) : Promise.resolve(null)),
    openExternal: openBrowser,
  })
} catch (e) {
  if (!(e instanceof SchemaTooNew)) throw e
  console.error(e.message)
  process.exit(1)
}

const dispatch = makeDispatcher(core.handlers, () => PAGE)
const api = Object.fromEntries(API_METHODS.map((m) => [m, (...a: unknown[]) => dispatch(PAGE, m, a)])) as unknown as Api

const renderer = await createCliRenderer({ exitOnCtrlC: false })
let quitting = false
const quit = () => {
  if (quitting) return
  quitting = true
  renderer.destroy()
  void core.shutdown().finally(() => process.exit(0))
}
process.on("SIGTERM", quit)

createRoot(renderer).render(
  <App
    api={api}
    bus={bus}
    theme={themeFor(args.theme, process.env)}
    where={{ folder, platform: process.platform as Platform, home: homedir(), dataDir, env: process.env }}
    args={{ continue: args.continue, resume: args.resume }}
    quit={quit}
    onReady={(a) => (app = a)}
  />,
)
```

`tui/src/paths.ts`:

```ts
import { dirname, join } from "node:path"

/*
  Where the CLI finds its `sandbox/` (specs/release R1.3, R2.4) — `specialist/` it builds the specialist's image from,
  the integrations' `mcp/` server and Cheat Engine's `cheat-engine/` bridge — beside it however it was installed — named by the npm shim, next to a compiled binary, or in the repository when
  run from source — and what it answers before the core starts.
*/

export interface Where {
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv
  /** the running executable: a compiled binary, or Bun itself */
  execPath: string
  /** this module's directory: `tui/src` from source, a virtual folder inside a compiled binary */
  moduleDir: string
  exists(path: string): boolean
}

/** The folder holding `specialist/`, or null when none of the places has it. */
export function sandboxDirFor(w: Where): string | null {
  const candidates = [w.env.HFR_SANDBOX_DIR, join(dirname(w.execPath), "sandbox"), join(w.moduleDir, "..", "sandbox"), join(w.moduleDir, "..", "..", "sandbox")]
  return candidates.find((c): c is string => !!c && w.exists(join(c, "specialist", "Dockerfile"))) ?? null
}

export const USAGE = `Usage: harness-for-rea [path] [--continue | --resume] [--theme dark|light]
       harness-for-rea --version | --help

The terminal UI of Harness for REA. Opens the folder it is run in, or the path given, as a project's target:
the project on it, a choice among several, or a new one to create. Runs beside the desktop app and other
terminal UIs on the same data folder.

  --continue   open the folder's project's most recent task
  --resume     pick one of the folder's project's tasks to open
  --theme      dark (the default) or light; also HFR_THEME

Environment:
  HFR_DATA_DIR      the data folder (default: the desktop app's)
  HFR_SANDBOX_DIR   the folder holding specialist/, mcp/ and cheat-engine/`

export interface Args {
  /** the target folder as given, or null for the folder it is run in */
  path: string | null
  continue: boolean
  resume: boolean
  theme: "dark" | "light" | null
}

/**
  What the command line asks for (specs/tui-launch R1.1, R2.2, R2.3, R2.5): `print` is answered before anything starts
  and exits with `code`; otherwise the TUI runs with `args`.
*/
export function parseArgs(argv: string[], version: string): { print: string; code: number } | { args: Args } {
  if (argv.includes("--version") || argv.includes("-v")) return { print: `harness-for-rea ${version}`, code: 0 }
  if (argv.includes("--help") || argv.includes("-h")) return { print: USAGE, code: 0 }
  const bad = (why: string) => ({ print: `${why}\n\n${USAGE}`, code: 2 })
  const args: Args = { path: null, continue: false, resume: false, theme: null }
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i]
    if (a === "--continue" || a === "-c") args.continue = true
    else if (a === "--resume" || a === "-r") args.resume = true
    else if (a === "--theme" || a.startsWith("--theme=")) {
      const v = a.includes("=") ? a.slice("--theme=".length) : argv[++i]
      if (v !== "dark" && v !== "light") return bad("--theme takes dark or light.")
      args.theme = v
    } else if (a.startsWith("-")) return bad(`Unknown option ${a}.`)
    else if (args.path === null) args.path = a
    else return bad(`Give one folder, not ${args.path} and ${a}.`)
  }
  if (args.continue && args.resume) return bad("Give --continue or --resume, not both.")
  return { args }
}
```

`tui/src/screens/EventLog.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react"
import type { EventRow } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { clock, tone } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { useApp, useKeys, usePush, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { toneColor } from "../app/theme"
import { Frame, List, safe } from "../components/ui"

/*
  A task's event log (specs/tui-panels R1.2): its events newest last, filtered by agent with Tab, each event's payload
  in a dialog on Enter.
*/

const AGENTS = ["all", "orchestrator", "specialist", "sandbox", "app"] as const

export function EventLogScreen({ taskId }: { taskId: string }) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { api, theme, toast } = app
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<EventRow[]>([])
  const [agent, setAgent] = useState<(typeof AGENTS)[number]>("all")
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getTask(taskId, { limit: 2000 }).then(
      (h) => setEvents(h.events),
      (e: unknown) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
    )
  }, [api, taskId, toast])
  usePush((p) => p.type === "event" && p.event.taskId === taskId && setEvents((list) => (list.some((e) => e.id === p.event.id) ? list : [...list, p.event])))

  const shown = useMemo(() => (agent === "all" ? events : events.filter((e) => e.agent === agent)), [events, agent])
  const open = (id: string) => {
    const e = events.find((x) => `${x.id}` === id)
    if (!e) return
    void app.dialog<null>((done) => <Payload event={e} done={done} />)
  }
  useScreen({ title: "Event log", status: agent, commands: [{ name: "back", title: "Back to the task", run: () => app.back() }] })
  const { setPromptFocused } = app
  useEffect(() => {
    setPromptFocused(false)
    return () => setPromptFocused(true)
  }, [setPromptFocused])
  useKeys(
    "events",
    "Event log",
    [{ key: "tab", label: "Next agent filter", hint: true, run: () => setAgent((a) => AGENTS[(AGENTS.indexOf(a) + 1) % AGENTS.length]) }],
    { active: !app.promptFocused },
  )

  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text
        fg={theme.mutedForeground}
      >{`Filter: ${AGENTS.map((a) => (a === agent ? `[${a}]` : a)).join("  ")}   ${shown.length} of ${events.length} events`}</text>
      <List
        id="events"
        items={shown.map((e) => ({
          id: String(e.id),
          label: `${clock(e.at)}  ${e.agent.padEnd(12)} ${e.kind.padEnd(22)}`,
          detail: e.summary.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 100),
          color: toneColor(theme, tone(e.state)),
        }))}
        selected={selected ?? (shown.at(-1) ? String(shown.at(-1)!.id) : null)}
        onMove={setSelected}
        onPick={open}
        active={!app.promptFocused}
        height={30}
        empty="No event yet."
      />
    </box>
  )
}

function Payload({ event, done }: { event: EventRow; done(v: null): void }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  useKeys(
    "dialog:payload",
    "Event",
    [
      { key: "escape", label: "Close", run: () => done(null) },
      { key: "return", label: "Close", run: () => done(null) },
    ],
    { modal: true },
  )
  return (
    <Frame title={`${event.agent} · ${event.kind}`} width={110} footer="Esc closes">
      <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(event.summary)}</text>
      <scrollbox height={24}>
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(JSON.stringify(event.payload, null, 2).slice(0, 20_000))}</text>
      </scrollbox>
    </Frame>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/screens/Launch.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { useApp, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { openProjects, pickTask } from "../app/pickers"
import { SelectDialog } from "../components/dialogs"
import { safe } from "../components/ui"
import { launchPlan, matchProjects, riskOf } from "../lib/launch"

/*
  What the TUI opens first for the folder it was run in (specs/tui-launch R1, R2): the setup when it is not completed,
  then the folder's project, a choice among several, or the new-project screen prefilled for it, with the typed
  confirmation for a broad folder and the refusal of the data folder.
*/

export function LaunchScreen() {
  const app = useApp()
  const { theme, where } = app
  const [note, setNote] = useState("Opening…")
  const ran = useRef(false)
  useScreen({
    title: safe(where.folder),
    commands: [{ name: "projects", title: "Open any project", run: () => void openProjects(app) }],
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ran.current) return
    ran.current = true
    void (async () => {
      const [settings, projects] = await Promise.all([app.attempt(() => app.api.getSettings()), app.attempt(() => app.api.listProjects())])
      if (!settings || !projects) return setNote("The app could not read its data. /projects lists what it has.")
      const plan = launchPlan({
        folder: where.folder,
        platform: where.platform,
        projects,
        risk: riskOf(where.folder, where),
        setupCompleted: settings.setupCompleted,
        continue: app.args.continue,
        resume: app.args.resume,
      })
      switch (plan.kind) {
        case "setup":
          return app.go({ kind: "setup", then: { kind: "launch" } })
        case "refuse":
          return setNote(`${plan.why} Run harness-for-rea in the folder you want to analyse, or give its path.`)
        case "create":
          return app.go({ kind: "new-project", target: where.folder, confirm: plan.confirm })
        case "open": {
          if (plan.then === "continue") {
            const p = await app.attempt(() => app.api.getProject(plan.projectId))
            const last = p?.tasks[0]
            if (last) return app.go({ kind: "task", id: last.id })
            app.toast("This project has no task to continue yet.", "info")
          } else if (plan.then === "resume") {
            const id = await pickTask(app, plan.projectId)
            if (id) return app.go({ kind: "task", id })
          }
          return app.go({ kind: "project", id: plan.projectId })
        }
        case "pick": {
          const matches = matchProjects(projects, where.folder, where.platform)
          const id = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
            <SelectDialog
              title="Several projects have this folder as their target"
              items={[
                ...matches.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.name, detail: `${p.goal} · ${p.model}` })),
                { id: "+new", label: "+ Create another project on it" },
              ]}
              done={done}
            />
          ))
          if (id === "+new") return app.go({ kind: "new-project", target: where.folder, confirm: null })
          if (id) return app.go({ kind: "project", id })
          return setNote("Pick a project with /projects, or create one with /new.")
        }
      }
    })()
    // Run once: the guard keeps a new `app` (a route change) from planning again.
  }, [app, where])

  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(note)}</text>
    </box>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/screens/NewProject.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import {
  GOALS,
  ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS,
  SPECIALIST_EFFORTS,
  type Goal,
  type OrchestratorEffort,
  type SpecialistEffort,
  type TargetInfo,
} from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { goalCard, nameFrom } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/projects"
import { useApp, useKeys, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { InputDialog, SelectDialog } from "../components/dialogs"
import { Choice, Field, safe } from "../components/ui"
import { riskOf } from "../lib/launch"

/*
  The new-project screen (specs/tui-panels R2.3, specs/tui-launch R1.4–R1.6): a typed target path with its detected
  kind, the goal, the name prefilled from the path, the model and the efforts from Settings. A folder too broad to
  mount asks for its path typed before the project is created; the data folder is refused.
*/

const FIELDS = ["target", "goal", "name", "model", "orchestrator", "specialist"] as const
type FieldName = (typeof FIELDS)[number]

export function NewProjectScreen({ target: initial, confirm }: { target?: string; confirm: string | null }) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { api, theme, where } = app
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(initial ?? "")
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<TargetInfo | null>(null)
  const [detectError, setDetectError] = useState("")
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState<Goal>("understand")
  const [name, setName] = useState(initial ? nameFrom(initial) : "")
  const [named, setNamed] = useState(false)
  const [model, setModel] = useState("")
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("")
  const [orch, setOrch] = useState<OrchestratorEffort>("default")
  const [spec, setSpec] = useState<SpecialistEffort>("medium")
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState<FieldName>(initial ? "goal" : "target")
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  /** where the project's own folder is made; null for the app's data folder, as in the desktop app */
  const [parentFolder, setParentFolder] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    void api.getSettings().then((s) => {
      setModel(s.model)
      setProvider(s.provider)
      setOrch(s.orchestratorEffort)
      setSpec(s.specialistEffort)
    })
  }, [api])
  // The target's kind, read again as the path is typed (R2.3).
  const trimmed = target.trim()
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trimmed) return
    let alive = true
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () =>
        void api.detectTarget(trimmed).then(
          (t) => alive && (setInfo(t), setDetectError("")),
          (e: unknown) => alive && (setInfo(null), setDetectError((e as Error).message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method 'api': (\w*Error: )?/, ""))),
        ),
      200,
    )
    return () => {
      alive = false
      clearTimeout(timer)
    }
  }, [api, trimmed])
  // The name follows the target until the user types one.
  const shownName = named ? name : trimmed ? nameFrom(trimmed) : name
  const shownInfo = trimmed ? info : null

  const browse = async (kind: "file" | "folder") => {
    const p = await app.attempt(() => api.pickTarget(kind))
    if (p) setTarget(p)
  }
  const pickModel = async () => {
    const models = await app.attempt(() => api.listModels())
    if (!models?.length) return
    const id = await app.dialog<string>((done) => <SelectDialog title="Model" items={models.map((m) => ({ id: m, label: m }))} initial={model} done={done} />)
    if (id) setModel(id)
  }

  const create = async () => {
    const path = target.trim()
    if (!path || !shownInfo) return app.toast("Give a target the app can read.", "error")
    if (!shownName.trim()) return app.toast("Give the project a name.", "error")
    const risk = riskOf(path, where)
    if (risk.kind === "refuse") return app.toast(risk.why, "error")
    const why = risk.kind === "confirm" ? risk.why : confirm
    if (why) {
      // Typing the path, not pressing Enter on "yes", is what makes mounting a broad folder deliberate (R1.5).
      const typed = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
        <InputDialog
          title="Mount a broad folder?"
          body={`${path} is ${why}. Everything under it is mounted into the analysis sandboxes, which reach the internet. Type the path to confirm.`}
          check={(v) =>
            v
              .trim()
              .replace(/[\\/]+$/, "")
              .toLowerCase() === path.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "").toLowerCase()
              ? null
              : "That is not the same path."
          }
          done={done}
        />
      ))
      if (typed === null) return
    }
    setBusy(true)
    const p = await app.attempt(
      () =>
        api.createProject({
          name: shownName.trim(),
          goal,
          target: path,
          provider: provider as never,
          model,
          orchestratorEffort: orch,
          specialistEffort: spec,
          parentFolder,
        }),
      `Created "${shownName.trim()}".`,
    )
    setBusy(false)
    if (p) app.go({ kind: "project", id: p.id })
  }

  useScreen({
    title: "New project",
    typing: true,
    commands: [
      { name: "create", title: "Create the project", run: create },
      { name: "browse-folder", title: "Pick the target folder from a browser", run: () => browse("folder") },
      { name: "browse-file", title: "Pick a target file from a browser", run: () => browse("file") },
      { name: "models", title: "Pick the model from the provider's list", run: pickModel },
      {
        name: "project-folder",
        title: "Choose where the project's own folder is made",
        run: async () => {
          const f = await app.attempt(() => api.pickFolder())
          if (f) setParentFolder(f)
        },
      },
      { name: "default-folder", title: "Make the project's folder in the app's data again", run: () => setParentFolder(null) },
    ],
  })
  // The form takes the keys; the prompt stays for commands.
  const { setPromptFocused } = app
  useEffect(() => {
    setPromptFocused(false)
    return () => setPromptFocused(true)
  }, [setPromptFocused])
  const at = FIELDS.indexOf(focus)
  useKeys(
    "new-project",
    "New project",
    [
      { key: "tab", label: "Next field", hint: true, run: () => setFocus(FIELDS[(at + 1) % FIELDS.length]) },
      { key: "shift+tab", label: "Previous field", run: () => setFocus(FIELDS[(at - 1 + FIELDS.length) % FIELDS.length]) },
      { key: "ctrl+s", label: "Create", hint: true, run: () => void (busy || create()) },
      { key: "ctrl+l", label: "Pick the model", run: () => void pickModel() },
      { key: "ctrl+o", label: "Browse for the target", run: () => void browse("folder") },
      { key: "ctrl+t", label: "Commands in the prompt", run: () => app.setPromptFocused(!app.promptFocused) },
    ],
    { active: !app.promptFocused },
  )

  const field = (f: FieldName) => focus === f && !app.promptFocused
  const card = goalCard(goal)
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" gap={1} width="100%" maxWidth={100}>
      <Field
        label="Target — a folder or a file to analyse"
        value={target}
        onInput={setTarget}
        onSubmit={() => setFocus("goal")}
        focused={field("target")}
        placeholder="C:\\samples\\app or /path/to/binary"
        note={
          shownInfo
            ? `${shownInfo.label}${shownInfo.isFile ? ", copied into the project" : ", read in place"} · ${shownInfo.engines.join(", ")}`
            : detectError || "Ctrl+O browses"
        }
        noteColor={shownInfo ? theme.success : detectError ? theme.destructive : undefined}
      />
      <box flexDirection="column">
        <Choice<Goal> label="Goal" value={goal} options={GOALS} onChange={setGoal} focused={field("goal")} />
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(`${card.title}: ${card.description}`)}</text>
      </box>
      <Field
        label="Name"
        value={shownName}
        onInput={(v) => {
          setName(v)
          setNamed(true)
        }}
        onSubmit={() => setFocus("model")}
        focused={field("name")}
      />
      <Field
        label={`Model (${provider || "provider"})`}
        value={model}
        onInput={setModel}
        onSubmit={() => setFocus("orchestrator")}
        focused={field("model")}
        note="Ctrl+L picks from the provider's list"
      />
      <Choice<OrchestratorEffort>
        label="Orchestrator's effort"
        value={orch}
        options={ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS}
        onChange={setOrch}
        focused={field("orchestrator")}
      />
      <Choice<SpecialistEffort> label="Specialist's effort" value={spec} options={SPECIALIST_EFFORTS} onChange={setSpec} focused={field("specialist")} />
      <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`Saved in ${parentFolder ? safe(parentFolder) : "a new folder in the app's data"} · /project-folder changes it`}</text>
      {confirm ? <text fg={theme.warning}>{safe(`This folder is ${confirm}: creating asks for its path typed.`)}</text> : null}
      <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
        {busy ? "Creating…" : "Ctrl+S creates the project · Tab moves between fields · Esc goes back"}
      </text>
    </box>
  )
}
```
