`tui/src/screens/Project.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS, SPECIALIST_EFFORTS, type AnalysisSummary, type ProjectRow, type TaskRow, type UnknownRow } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { tone, usd, when } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { goalCard, heldLabel } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/projects"
import { useApp, useKeys, usePush, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { toneColor } from "../app/theme"
import { pickModel, pickOne } from "../app/pickers"
import { InputDialog } from "../components/dialogs"
import { List, safe } from "../components/ui"

/*
  A project's overview (specs/tui-panels R2.1, R2.2): its target, kind, goal, model and the app holding it, its tasks
  to open, its analyses and the unknowns they left open. A request typed in the prompt starts a task; deleting the
  project asks for its name typed.
*/

interface Data {
  project: ProjectRow
  tasks: TaskRow[]
  analyses: AnalysisSummary[]
  unknowns: UnknownRow[]
}

export function ProjectScreen({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { theme, api } = app
  const [data, setData] = useState<Data | null>(null)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { toast } = app
  const load = useCallback(() => void api.getProject(id).then(setData, (e: unknown) => toast((e as Error).message, "error")), [api, id, toast])
  useEffect(load, [load])
  // A task of the project that moves, or the project itself, changes what the overview shows.
  usePush((p) => {
    if (
      (p.type === "task" && p.task.projectId === id) ||
      p.type === "taskDeleted" ||
      (p.type === "project" && p.project.id === id) ||
      (p.type === "step" && p.step.kind === "delegation")
    )
      load()
    if (p.type === "projectDeleted" && p.id === id) app.go({ kind: "launch" })
  })

  const held = data ? heldLabel(data.project) : null
  const start = async (request: string) => {
    const t = await app.attempt(() => api.startTask({ projectId: id, request }))
    if (t) app.go({ kind: "task", id: t.id })
  }
  const remove = async () => {
    if (!data) return
    const name = data.project.name
    const typed = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
      <InputDialog
        title="Delete the project"
        body={`This removes "${name}" with its tasks, sandboxes and files, for good. Type its name to confirm.`}
        check={(v) => (v.trim() === name ? null : "That is not the project's name.")}
        done={done}
      />
    ))
    if (typed === null) return
    if (await app.attempt(() => api.deleteProject(id), `Deleted "${name}".`)) app.go({ kind: "launch" })
  }

  useScreen({
    title: data ? data.project.name : "Project",
    status: held ?? undefined,
    placeholder: held ? `${held}: its tasks can be read, not started here` : "Say what you want: what to find, explain or build. Enter starts a task",
    onSubmit: held ? undefined : start,
    commands: [
      {
        name: "model",
        title: "Change the model the project's tasks run with, from their next turn",
        args: "[id]",
        run: async (typed) => {
          if (!data) return
          const model = await pickModel(app, data.project.provider, data.project.model, typed)
          if (model && (await app.attempt(() => api.updateProject(id, { model }), `Model: ${model}.`))) load()
        },
      },
      {
        name: "orchestrator-effort",
        title: "Change the orchestrator's effort",
        run: async () => {
          if (!data) return
          const v = await pickOne(app, "Orchestrator's effort", ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS, data.project.orchestratorEffort)
          if (v && (await app.attempt(() => api.updateProject(id, { orchestratorEffort: v })))) load()
        },
      },
      {
        name: "specialist-effort",
        title: "Change the specialist's effort",
        run: async () => {
          if (!data) return
          const v = await pickOne(app, "Specialist's effort", SPECIALIST_EFFORTS, data.project.specialistEffort)
          if (v && (await app.attempt(() => api.updateProject(id, { specialistEffort: v })))) load()
        },
      },
      { name: "delete-project", title: "Delete this project, its tasks and files, after typing its name", run: remove },
      { name: "refresh", title: "Read the project again", run: load },
      ...(data?.tasks.length
        ? [{ name: "open", title: "Open the selected task", key: "return", run: () => void (selected && app.go({ kind: "task", id: selected })) }]
        : []),
    ],
    mentionRoot: data?.project.sourceRoot,
  })
  // Tab moves between the prompt and the list of tasks.
  useKeys("project", "Project", [{ key: "tab", label: "Prompt or tasks", hint: true, run: () => app.setPromptFocused(!app.promptFocused) }])

  if (!data) return <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>Loading…</text>
  const { project, tasks, analyses, unknowns } = data
  const open = unknowns.filter((u) => !u.closedBy)
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" gap={1}>
      <box flexDirection="column">
        <text fg={theme.foreground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
          {safe(project.name)}
          <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`  ${goalCard(project.goal).title} · ${project.targetKind} · ${project.provider} ${project.model}`}</span>
        </text>
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(project.targetPath)}</text>
        {held ? <text fg={theme.warning}>{safe(held)}</text> : null}
      </box>
      <box flexDirection="row" gap={2}>
        <box flexDirection="column" flexGrow={1} flexBasis={0}>
          <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>{`Tasks (${tasks.length})`}</text>
          <List
            id="tasks"
            items={tasks.map((t) => ({
              id: t.id,
              label: t.request.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 70),
              detail: `${t.state} · ${when(t.updatedAt)} · ${usd(t.costUsd + t.specialistCostUsd)}`,
              color: toneColor(theme, tone(t.state)),
            }))}
            selected={selected ?? tasks[0]?.id ?? null}
            onMove={setSelected}
            onPick={(tid) => app.go({ kind: "task", id: tid })}
            active={!app.promptFocused}
            height={12}
            empty="No task yet: type a request below."
          />
        </box>
        <box flexDirection="column" flexGrow={1} flexBasis={0}>
          <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>{`Analyses (${analyses.length})`}</text>
          {analyses.slice(0, 6).map((a) => (
            <text key={a.id} fg={toneColor(theme, tone(a.state))} wrapMode="none">
              {`${a.state.padEnd(11)} `}
              <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(a.objective.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 70))}</span>
              <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{`  ${a.evidence} evidence`}</span>
            </text>
          ))}
          {!analyses.length && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>None yet.</text>}
          <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD} marginTop={1}>{`Open unknowns (${open.length} of ${unknowns.length})`}</text>
          {open.slice(0, 6).map((u) => (
            <text key={u.id} fg={u.severity === "high" ? theme.destructive : u.severity === "medium" ? theme.warning : theme.mutedForeground}>
              {`${u.severity.padEnd(7)} `}
              <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(u.question)}</span>
            </text>
          ))}
          {!open.length && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>None open.</text>}
        </box>
      </box>
    </box>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { PROVIDERS } from "../../../src/shared/providers"
import { ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS, SPECIALIST_EFFORTS, type Settings } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { useApp, useKeys, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { Choice, Field } from "../components/ui"
import { providerCommands } from "./Setup"

/*
  The settings editor (specs/tui-panels R4): the provider, model and key through the setup's commands, the
  orchestrator's and the specialist's effort, and the delegation, approval and question timeouts, each saved as it is
  changed; /setup opens the setup again.
*/

const FIELDS = ["orchestrator", "specialist", "timeout", "approval", "question"] as const
type FieldName = (typeof FIELDS)[number]
const MINUTES = { timeout: "timeoutMinutes", approval: "approvalTimeoutMinutes", question: "questionTimeoutMinutes" } as const

export function SettingsScreen() {
  const app = useApp()
  const { api, theme } = app
  const [s, setS] = useState<Settings | null>(null)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState<FieldName>("orchestrator")
  const refresh = useCallback(() => void api.getSettings().then(setS), [api])
  useEffect(refresh, [refresh])

  const save = async (patch: Partial<Settings>, said: string) => {
    const next = await app.attempt(() => api.saveSettings(patch), said)
    if (next) setS(next)
  }
  const saveMinutes = (f: keyof typeof MINUTES) => {
    const n = Number(draft[f])
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) return app.toast("Give a whole number of minutes.", "error")
    void save({ [MINUTES[f]]: n }, "Saved.")
  }

  useScreen({
    title: "Settings",
    typing: true,
    commands: [
      ...providerCommands(app, s, refresh),
      { name: "setup", title: "Open the first-run setup again", run: () => app.go({ kind: "setup", then: { kind: "settings" } }) },
    ],
  })
  const { setPromptFocused } = app
  useEffect(() => {
    setPromptFocused(false)
    return () => setPromptFocused(true)
  }, [setPromptFocused])
  const at = FIELDS.indexOf(focus)
  useKeys(
    "settings",
    "Settings",
    [
      { key: "tab", label: "Next field", hint: true, run: () => setFocus(FIELDS[(at + 1) % FIELDS.length]) },
      { key: "shift+tab", label: "Previous field", run: () => setFocus(FIELDS[(at - 1 + FIELDS.length) % FIELDS.length]) },
      { key: "ctrl+t", label: "Commands in the prompt", hint: true, run: () => app.setPromptFocused(!app.promptFocused) },
    ],
    { active: !app.promptFocused },
  )

  if (!s) return <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>Loading…</text>
  const on = (f: FieldName) => focus === f && !app.promptFocused
  const minutes = (f: keyof typeof MINUTES, label: string) => (
    <Field
      label={label}
      value={draft[f] ?? String(s[MINUTES[f]])}
      onInput={(v) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [f]: v }))}
      onSubmit={() => saveMinutes(f)}
      focused={on(f)}
      note="Enter saves"
    />
  )
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" gap={1} maxWidth={90}>
      <text fg={theme.foreground}>
        <span attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>{`${PROVIDERS[s.provider].label} · ${s.model}`}</span>
        <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{"   /provider · /model · /key · /base-url in the prompt (Ctrl+T)"}</span>
      </text>
      <Choice<(typeof ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS)[number]>
        label="Orchestrator's effort"
        value={s.orchestratorEffort}
        options={ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORTS}
        onChange={(v) => void save({ orchestratorEffort: v }, `Orchestrator's effort: ${v}.`)}
        focused={on("orchestrator")}
      />
      <Choice<(typeof SPECIALIST_EFFORTS)[number]>
        label="Specialist's effort"
        value={s.specialistEffort}
        options={SPECIALIST_EFFORTS}
        onChange={(v) => void save({ specialistEffort: v }, `Specialist's effort: ${v}.`)}
        focused={on("specialist")}
      />
      {minutes("timeout", "Delegation timeout (minutes)")}
      {minutes("approval", "Approval timeout (minutes)")}
      {minutes("question", "Question timeout (minutes)")}
    </box>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { TextAttributes } from "@opentui/core"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { PROVIDER_IDS, PROVIDERS, type ProviderId } from "../../../src/shared/providers"
import type { KeyStatus, LoginStatus, Readiness, SandboxStatus, Settings } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import type { Command } from "../app/commands"
import { useApp, usePush, useScreen, type AppState, type Route } from "../app/context"
import { SelectDialog } from "../components/dialogs"
import { safe } from "../components/ui"

/*
  The first-run setup in the terminal (specs/tui-panels R3): the sandbox images with their preparation's log, the
  Claude sign-in opened in the browser with its code pasted back, cancelled or signed out, and the orchestrator's
  provider, base URL, key and model — each step's state from the same readiness the desktop app reads, completed with
  /done once every step is ready.

/** Provider, key and model commands, shared with the settings editor (R3.4, R4.1). */
export function providerCommands(app: AppState, settings: Settings | null, refresh: () => void): Command[] {
  const { api } = app
  const provider = settings?.provider ?? "openrouter"
  const pickProvider = async () => {
    const id = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
      <SelectDialog
        title="Provider"
        items={PROVIDER_IDS.map((p) => ({ id: p, label: PROVIDERS[p].label, detail: PROVIDERS[p].baseUrl || "your own endpoint" }))}
        initial={provider}
        done={done}
      />
    ))
    if (!id) return
    const p = PROVIDERS[id as ProviderId]
    // Switching provider swaps in its own endpoint (kept per provider), model and key; one provider's model name means nothing to another.
    await app.attempt(() => api.saveSettings({ provider: p.id, model: p.defaultModel || settings?.model }), `Provider: ${p.label}.`)
    refresh()
  }
  const pickModel = async (arg: string) => {
    let model = arg.trim()
    if (!model) {
      const models = await app.attempt(() => api.listModels())
      if (!models) return app.toast("No model list here: name the model with /model <id>; the setup checks it with a test request.", "info")
      const id = await app.dialog<string>((done) => (
        <SelectDialog title={`Models of ${PROVIDERS[provider].label}`} items={models.map((m) => ({ id: m, label: m }))} initial={settings?.model} done={done} />
      ))
      if (!id) return
      model = id
    }
    await app.attempt(() => api.saveSettings({ model }), `Model: ${model}.`)
    refresh()
  }
  return [
    { name: "provider", title: "Pick the orchestrator's provider", run: pickProvider },
    {
      name: "base-url",
      title: "Set the provider's base URL",
      args: "<url>",
      run: async (url) => {
        // Named with the provider it is for, so a switch made elsewhere in between never files it under another.
        await app.attempt(() => api.saveSettings({ ...(settings ? { provider: settings.provider } : {}), baseUrl: url.trim() }), "Base URL saved.")
        refresh()
      },
    },
    {
      name: "key",
      title: "Save the provider's API key in the OS keychain",
      args: "<key>",
      run: async (key) => {
        await app.attempt(() => api.saveKey(key.trim(), provider), "Key saved in the OS keychain.")
        refresh()
      },
    },
    {
      name: "remove-key",
      title: "Remove the provider's API key",
      run: async () => {
        await app.attempt(() => api.clearKey(provider), "Key removed.")
        refresh()
      },
    },
    { name: "model", title: "Pick the model from the provider's list, or name it", args: "[id]", run: pickModel },
  ]
}

export function SetupScreen({ then }: { then?: Route }) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { api, theme } = app
  const [r, setR] = useState<Readiness | null>(null)
  const [sandbox, setSandbox] = useState<SandboxStatus | null>(null)
  const [login, setLogin] = useState<LoginStatus | null>(null)
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings | null>(null)
  const [key, setKey] = useState<KeyStatus | null>(null)

  const { toast } = app
  const refresh = useCallback(() => {
    void api.readiness().then(setR, (e: unknown) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"))
    void api.sandboxStatus().then(setSandbox, () => undefined)
    void api.loginStatus().then(setLogin, () => undefined)
    void api.getSettings().then((s) => {
      setSettings(s)
      return api.keyStatus(s.provider).then(setKey)
    })
  }, [api, toast])
  useEffect(refresh, [refresh])
  usePush((p) => {
    if (p.type === "sandbox") {
      setSandbox(p.status)
      void api.readiness().then(setR, () => undefined)
    } else if (p.type === "login") {
      setLogin(p.status)
      void api.readiness().then(setR, () => undefined)
    }
  })

  const commands: Command[] = [
    { name: "images", title: "Prepare the sandbox images again", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.buildSandbox()).then((s) => s && setSandbox(s)) },
    {
      name: "login",
      title: "Sign Claude in, opening the page in your browser",
      run: async () => {
        const s = await app.attempt(() => api.startLogin())
        if (s) setLogin(s)
        // The page's address shows up in the sign-in's output a moment later.
        setTimeout(() => void api.openLoginUrl().then((ok) => !ok && app.toast("Open the address shown under the sign-in step.", "info")), 1500)
      },
    },
    { name: "open-login", title: "Open the sign-in page in your browser", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.openLoginUrl()) },
    {
      name: "code",
      title: "Send the code the sign-in page gave you",
      args: "<code>",
      run: (code) => void app.attempt(() => api.sendLoginCode(code.trim())).then((s) => s && setLogin(s)),
    },
    { name: "cancel-login", title: "Cancel the sign-in", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.cancelLogin()).then((s) => s && setLogin(s)) },
    { name: "logout", title: "Sign Claude out", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.logout(), "Signed out.").then((s) => s && setLogin(s)) },
    ...providerCommands(app, settings, refresh),
    { name: "refresh", title: "Check every step again", run: refresh },
    {
      name: "done",
      title: "Finish the setup",
      run: async () => {
        const done = await app.attempt(() => api.completeSetup(), "Setup completed.")
        if (done) app.go(then ?? { kind: "launch" })
      },
    },
  ]
  useScreen({
    title: "Setup",
    status: r?.ready ? "ready" : undefined,
    commands,
    placeholder: "Type / for the setup's commands: /images, /login, /key, /model, /done",
  })

  const mark = (ready: boolean | undefined) => <span fg={ready ? theme.success : theme.warning}>{ready ? "✓ " : "○ "}</span>
  const head = (t: string, ready: boolean | undefined) => (
    <text fg={theme.foreground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
      {mark(ready)}
      {t}
    </text>
  )
  const why = (s: string | undefined) => (s ? <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(s)}</text> : null)
  const provider = settings ? PROVIDERS[settings.provider] : null
  const log = (sandbox?.buildLog ?? "").split("\n").filter(Boolean).slice(-8)
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" gap={1}>
      <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>Ready what every project needs. Each step names the command that readies it.</text>
      <box flexDirection="column">
        {head("1 · Sandbox images", r?.sandbox.ready)}
        {why(r?.sandbox.reason)}
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>
          {sandbox
            ? `Docker ${sandbox.docker ? "running" : `not running${sandbox.dockerError ? `: ${safe(sandbox.dockerError)}` : ""}`} · images ${sandbox.images ? "ready" : sandbox.building ? "being prepared" : "missing"} · Claude Code ${sandbox.claudeVersion}`
            : "…"}
        </text>
        {log.length > 0 && (
          <box flexDirection="column" border={["left"]} borderColor={theme.border} paddingLeft={1}>
            {log.map((l, i) => (
              <text key={i} fg={theme.mutedForeground} wrapMode="none">
                {safe(l)}
              </text>
            ))}
          </box>
        )}
        <text fg={theme.primary}>/images prepares them again</text>
      </box>
      <box flexDirection="column">
        {head("2 · Claude sign-in", r?.claude.ready)}
        {why(r?.claude.reason)}
        {login?.loggedIn ? (
          <text fg={theme.success}>{safe(`Signed in${login.plan ? ` on ${login.plan}` : ""}${login.email ? ` as ${login.email}` : ""}`)}</text>
        ) : null}
        {login?.inProgress ? (
          <text fg={theme.foreground}>
            {"Signing in: "}
            <span fg={theme.primary}>{safe(login.url ?? "waiting for the page's address…")}</span>
            {" · paste the code with /code <code> · /cancel-login"}
          </text>
        ) : null}
        {login?.error ? <text fg={theme.destructive}>{safe(login.error)}</text> : null}
        <text fg={theme.primary}>{login?.loggedIn ? "/logout signs out" : "/login opens the sign-in in your browser"}</text>
      </box>
      <box flexDirection="column">
        {head("3 · Orchestrator's model", r?.model.ready)}
        {why(r?.model.reason)}
        {settings && provider ? (
          <text fg={theme.foreground}>
            {`${provider.label} · ${settings.model || "no model"}`}
            <span
              fg={theme.mutedForeground}
            >{` · ${settings.baseUrl || provider.baseUrl || "no base URL"} · key ${key?.set ? `set ${key.hint}` : "not set"}`}</span>
          </text>
        ) : null}
        {key && !key.encryption ? (
          <text fg={theme.destructive}>The OS keychain is unavailable, so a key cannot be stored. It is never kept in plain text.</text>
        ) : null}
        <text fg={theme.primary}>
          /provider · /base-url {"<url>"} · /key {"<key>"} · /remove-key · /model
        </text>
      </box>
      <text fg={r?.ready ? theme.success : theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
        {r?.ready ? "Every step is ready: /done finishes the setup." : "/done finishes the setup once every step is ready."}
      </text>
    </box>
  )
}
```

`tui/src/screens/Task.tsx`:

```tsx
import { TextAttributes, type ScrollBoxRenderable } from "@opentui/core"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { Push, StepRow, TaskHistory } from "../../../src/shared/types"
import { blocks, canSend, pendingCalls, pendingQuestions, type ChatBlock, type ToolItem } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/chat"
import { tone } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/format"
import { addUsage, filesOfStep, fold } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/store"
import { stepOf, Timeline, type SpecialistEntry } from "../../../src/renderer/src/lib/timeline"
import type { Command } from "../app/commands"
import { useApp, useKeys, usePush, useScreen } from "../app/context"
import { toneColor } from "../app/theme"
import { pickModel } from "../app/pickers"
import { askQuestion, decideCall, Diff } from "../components/decisions"
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/dialogs"
import { Markdown } from "../components/Markdown"
import { Sidebar } from "../components/Sidebar"
import { safe } from "../components/ui"
import { actionsFor, callState, delegationSections, toolDetails, toolLine, workingLine } from "../lib/transcript"

/*
  A task as a conversation (specs/tui-conversation): the transcript folded from the event log by the desktop app's
  own Timeline, newest page first and older pages on reaching the top; tool calls, delegations and the specialist's
  run shown expanded and collapsible (specs/chat-timeline R1.2); the working line; the actions the state allows; and
  the decisions it waits on, in dialogs.
*/

const PAGE = 400
const TURN_STARTS = new Set(["task.started", "message.user", "turn.continued", "task.reopened"])

/**
  The task's loaded history, kept outside React's state so pushes fold into it as they arrive: the desktop app's
  Timeline over the events, the pushes that came while the first page loaded, and the decisions already offered.
*/
class Feed {
  private line: Timeline | null = null
  private queued: Push[] | null = []
  private readonly offered = new Set<string>()

  constructor(private readonly taskId: string) {}

  get timeline(): Timeline | null {
    return this.line
  }

  /** The first page; the pushes that waited for it are folded after. Returns them. */
  load(hist: TaskHistory): Push[] {
    this.line = new Timeline(hist.steps, hist.events, !hist.hasOlder)
    const waiting = this.queued ?? []
    this.queued = null
    return waiting
  }

  /** Whether the event was folded in; a push before the first page waits. */
  event(p: Push): "queued" | "folded" | "skipped" {
    if (this.queued) {
      this.queued.push(p)
      return "queued"
    }
    if (p.type !== "event" || p.event.taskId !== this.taskId || !this.line) return "skipped"
    return this.line.append([p.event]) ? "folded" : "skipped"
  }

  /** The older page joined in front (specs/tui-conversation R1.6). */
  prepend(older: TaskHistory): void {
    if (this.line) this.line = this.line.prepend(older.events, older.steps, !older.hasOlder)
  }

  /** True the first time a decision is offered, so its dialog opens once (R3.2, R3.3). */
  offerOnce(id: string): boolean {
    if (this.offered.has(id)) return false
    this.offered.add(id)
    return true
  }
}

export function TaskScreen({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const app = useApp()
  const { api, bus, theme, toast, back } = app
  const feed = useMemo(() => new Feed(id), [id])
  const [h, setH] = useState<TaskHistory | null>(null)
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0)
  const scroll = useRef<ScrollBoxRenderable>(null)
  const [loadingOlder, setLoadingOlder] = useState(false)
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set())
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now())

  // The newest page, then every push folded in; pushes that arrive while it loads wait for it.
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    const apply = (p: Push) => {
      const r = feed.event(p)
      if (r === "folded" && p.type === "event") {
        setVersion((v) => v + 1)
        setH((cur) => (cur ? { ...cur, usage: addUsage(cur.usage, p.event) } : cur))
      } else if (r === "skipped" && p.type !== "event") setH((cur) => fold(cur, p))
    }
    const off = bus.on(apply)
    void api.getTask(id, { limit: PAGE }).then(
      (hist) => {
        if (!alive) return
        const waiting = feed.load(hist)
        setH({ ...hist, events: [] })
        for (const p of waiting) apply(p)
        setVersion((v) => v + 1)
      },
      (e: unknown) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
    )
    return () => {
      alive = false
      off()
    }
  }, [api, bus, id, feed, toast])
  usePush((p) => p.type === "taskDeleted" && p.id === id && back())

  // Reaching the top of the loaded transcript loads the older page (R1.6).
  const t = feed.timeline
  const loadOlder = useCallback(() => {
    const line = feed.timeline
    if (!line || line.fromStart || loadingOlder) return
    setLoadingOlder(true)
    void api
      .getTask(id, { beforeEvent: line.firstId, limit: PAGE })
      .then((older) => {
        feed.prepend(older)
        setVersion((v) => v + 1)
      })
      .finally(() => setLoadingOlder(false))
  }, [api, id, feed, loadingOlder])
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setNow(Date.now())
      const box = scroll.current
      if (box && box.scrollTop <= 0 && box.scrollHeight > 0) loadOlder()
    }, 1000)
    timer.unref?.()
    return () => clearInterval(timer)
  }, [loadOlder])

  const items = useMemo(() => (version >= 0 && t ? [...t.items] : []), [t, version])
  const entries = useMemo(() => blocks(items), [items])
  const state = h ? (h.turn ?? h.task.state) : "pending"
  const questions = pendingQuestions(items)
  const calls = pendingCalls(items)
  const gated = new Set(calls.map((c) => String(c.args.patchId ?? "")))
  const orphans = h && state !== "running" && state !== "pending" ? h.patches.filter((p) => p.state === "proposed" && !gated.has(p.id)) : []

  const answer = async (qid?: string) => {
    const q = questions.find((x) => !qid || x.id === qid)
    if (!q) return toast("No question waits for an answer.", "info")
    const a = await askQuestion(app, q.agent, q.question)
    if (a !== null) await app.attempt(() => api.answerQuestion(id, q.id, a))
  }
  const decide = async (callId?: string) => {
    const call = calls.find((c) => !callId || c.callId === callId)
    if (!call) return toast("No call waits for a decision.", "info")
    const patch = h?.patches.find((p) => p.id === call.args.patchId)
    const d = await decideCall(app, call, patch)
    if (d) await app.attempt(() => api.decideTool(id, call.callId, d))
  }
  // A decision that comes up opens its dialog once; Esc leaves it for /answer or /decide (R3.2, R3.3).
  const pending = [...questions.map((q) => q.id), ...calls.map((c) => c.callId)].join(",")
  const offer = useRef<(pending: string) => void>(() => undefined)
  useEffect(() => {
    offer.current = (ids) => {
      // The first decision not offered yet: one left with Esc stays for /answer or /decide, the next still opens.
      const first = ids.split(",").find((x) => x && feed.offerOnce(x))
      if (!first) return
      // Once its dialog closes, answered or left, the next pending decision is offered.
      const next = () => offer.current(ids)
      if (questions.some((q) => q.id === first)) void answer(first).then(next)
      else void decide(first).then(next)
    }
  })
  useEffect(() => offer.current(pending), [pending])

  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await app.dialog<boolean>((done) => (
      <ConfirmDialog title="Delete the task" body="Delete this task with its history, files and containers? This cannot be undone." yes="Delete" done={done} />
    ))
    if (ok && (await app.attempt(() => api.deleteTask(id), "Task deleted."))) back()
  }
  const toggleAll = () => setCollapsed((c) => (c.size ? new Set() : new Set(entries.map((e) => e.id))))
  const toggle = (eid: string) =>
    setCollapsed((c) => {
      const n = new Set(c)
      if (n.has(eid)) n.delete(eid)
      else n.add(eid)
      return n
    })
  const ACTION: Record<string, Command> = {
    stop: { name: "stop", title: "Stop the turn", key: "escape", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.stopTurn(id)) },
    continue: { name: "continue", title: "Continue from where it stopped", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.continueTurn(id)) },
    close: { name: "close", title: "Close the conversation, keeping its containers stopped", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.closeTask(id)) },
    cancel: { name: "cancel", title: "Cancel the task, removing its containers and keeping its files", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.cancelTask(id)) },
    retry: {
      name: "start-over",
      title: "Start a new task from the same request",
      run: async () => {
        const t2 = await app.attempt(() => api.retryTask(id))
        if (t2) app.go({ kind: "task", id: t2.id })
      },
    },
    delete: { name: "delete", title: "Delete the task, its history, files and containers", run: remove },
  }
  const live = state === "running" || state === "pending" || state === "waiting"
  const commands: Command[] = [
    ...actionsFor(state).map((a) => ACTION[a]),
    ...(questions.length ? [{ name: "answer", title: "Answer the question the task waits on", run: () => answer() }] : []),
    ...(calls.length ? [{ name: "decide", title: "Approve, edit or reject the call the task waits on", run: () => decide() }] : []),
    ...orphans.flatMap((p) => [
      {
        name: "approve-patch",
        title: "Apply the proposed patch to your files",
        run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.decidePatch(id, p.id, "approve"), "Patch applied."),
      },
      { name: "reject-patch", title: "Reject the proposed patch", run: () => void app.attempt(() => api.decidePatch(id, p.id, "reject"), "Patch rejected.") },
    ]),
    ...(live
      ? []
      : [
          {
            name: "model",
            title: "Change the task's model, from its next turn",
            args: "[id]",
            run: async (typed: string) => {
              if (!h) return
              const project = h.task.projectId ? await app.attempt(() => api.getProject(h.task.projectId!)) : null
              const model = await pickModel(app, project?.project.provider ?? "", h.task.model, typed)
              if (model) await app.attempt(() => api.setTaskModel(id, model), `Model: ${model}, from the next turn.`)
            },
          },
        ]),
    { name: "events", title: "Open the task's event log", run: () => app.go({ kind: "events", taskId: id }) },
    { name: "older", title: "Load the older events", run: loadOlder },
    { name: "expand", title: "Expand or collapse every tool call and delegation", key: "ctrl+o", run: () => toggleAll() },
  ]

  const events = t?.events ?? []
  let since = h?.task.updatedAt ?? now
  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    if (TURN_STARTS.has(events[i].kind)) {
      since = events[i].at
      break
    }
  useScreen({
    title: h ? h.task.request.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 60) : "Task",
    status: state,
    working: h && live ? workingLine(h.task, state, since, now) : undefined,
    placeholder: canSend(state)
      ? live
        ? "A message the agent reads before its next step"
        : "Your reply, or a message that continues the task"
      : "This task takes no message now",
    onSubmit: canSend(state) ? (text) => void app.attempt(() => api.sendMessage(id, text)) : undefined,
    commands,
    mentionRoot: h?.task.sourceRoot,
  })

  // The transcript's keys: Tab moves into it, ↑ ↓ pick an item, Enter folds it; Esc stops a running turn (R2.4).
  const order = entries.map((e) => e.id)
  const at = Math.max(0, order.indexOf(selected ?? ""))
  const pick = (by: number) => {
    const next = order[Math.min(order.length - 1, Math.max(0, at + by))]
    if (!next) return
    setSelected(next)
    scroll.current?.scrollChildIntoView(`blk-${next}`)
    if (at + by < 0) loadOlder()
  }
  useKeys("task", "Task", [
    { key: "escape", label: "Stop the turn", run: () => (live ? void app.attempt(() => api.stopTurn(id)) : false) },
    {
      key: "tab",
      label: "Prompt or transcript",
      hint: true,
      run: () => {
        app.setPromptFocused(!app.promptFocused)
        if (app.promptFocused && !selected) setSelected(order.at(-1) ?? null)
      },
    },
    { key: "ctrl+o", label: "Expand or collapse all", hint: true, run: toggleAll },
    {
      key: "pageup",
      label: "Scroll up",
      run: () => {
        scroll.current?.scrollBy(-10)
        if (scroll.current?.scrollTop === 0) loadOlder()
      },
    },
    { key: "pagedown", label: "Scroll down", run: () => void scroll.current?.scrollBy(10) },
  ])
  useKeys(
    "transcript",
    "Transcript",
    [
      { key: "up", label: "Previous item", run: () => pick(-1) },
      { key: "down", label: "Next item", run: () => pick(1) },
      { key: "return", label: "Fold or unfold the item", run: () => void (selected && toggle(selected)) },
      { key: "end", label: "Newest", run: () => pick(order.length) },
    ],
    { active: !app.promptFocused },
  )

  if (!h || !t) return <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>Loading the task…</text>
  const ctx = { steps: h.steps, events: t.events, run: (sid: string) => t.run(sid) }
  return (
    <box flexDirection="row" flexGrow={1}>
      <scrollbox ref={scroll} flexGrow={1} stickyScroll stickyStart="bottom" scrollY>
        {!t.fromStart && <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{"  ↑ earlier events load as you reach the top (/older)"}</text>}
        {entries.map((e) => (
          <box
            key={e.id}
            id={`blk-${e.id}`}
            flexDirection="column"
            marginBottom={1}
            backgroundColor={!app.promptFocused && e.id === selected ? theme.accent : undefined}
          >
            <Entry entry={e} open={!collapsed.has(e.id)} ctx={ctx} />
          </box>
        ))}
        {orphans.map((p) => (
          <box key={p.id} flexDirection="column" border borderStyle="rounded" borderColor={theme.warning} marginBottom={1}>
            <Diff patch={p} />
            <text fg={theme.warning}>/approve-patch applies it to your files · /reject-patch drops it</text>
          </box>
        ))}
        {h.task.error ? <text fg={theme.destructive}>{safe(h.task.error)}</text> : null}
      </scrollbox>
      {app.sidebar && <Sidebar h={h} events={t.events} />}
    </box>
  )
}

interface Ctx {
  steps: StepRow[]
  events: TaskHistory["events"]
  run(stepId: string): SpecialistEntry[]
}

function Entry({ entry, open, ctx }: { entry: ChatBlock; open: boolean; ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case "user":
      return (
        <box flexDirection="column">
          <text fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
            {"› You"}
            {entry.read ? null : <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{"  not read yet"}</span>}
          </text>
          <box paddingLeft={2}>
            <Markdown text={entry.text} />
          </box>
        </box>
      )
    case "agent":
      return (
        <box flexDirection="column">
          <text fg={theme.success} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
            ● Orchestrator
          </text>
          <box paddingLeft={2}>
            <Markdown text={entry.text} />
          </box>
        </box>
      )
    case "tools":
      return (
        <box flexDirection="column">
          {entry.items.map((i) => (
            <ToolCall key={i.id} item={i} open={open} ctx={ctx} />
          ))}
        </box>
      )
    case "tool":
      return <ToolCall item={entry} open={open} ctx={ctx} />
    case "approval":
      return (
        <box flexDirection="column">
          {entry.calls.map((c) => (
            <text key={c.callId} fg={c.decision ? theme.mutedForeground : theme.warning}>
              {`⏸ ${c.name} `}
              <span fg={theme.mutedForeground}>
                {c.decision ? `${c.decision.type}${c.origin && c.origin !== "user" ? ` (${c.origin})` : ""}` : "waits for your decision: /decide"}
              </span>
            </text>
          ))}
        </box>
      )
    case "question":
      return (
        <box flexDirection="column">
          <text fg={theme.warning}>
            {`? ${entry.agent} asks: `}
            <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(entry.question.prompt)}</span>
          </text>
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} paddingLeft={2}>
            {entry.origin ? `→ ${safe(String(entry.answer))} (${entry.origin === "user" ? "you" : entry.origin})` : "waits for your answer: /answer"}
          </text>
        </box>
      )
    case "notice":
      return (
        <text fg={entry.tone === "bad" ? theme.destructive : entry.tone === "warn" ? theme.warning : theme.mutedForeground}>{`— ${safe(entry.text)} —`}</text>
      )
  }
}

const GLYPH = { running: "⋯", failed: "✗", done: "✓" }

function ToolCall({ item, open, ctx }: { item: ToolItem; open: boolean; ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const step = item.name === "delegate_to_specialist" ? stepOf(item, ctx.steps) : undefined
  if (step) return <Delegation step={step} open={open} ctx={ctx} />
  const s = callState(item)
  const color = { running: theme.primary, failed: theme.destructive, done: theme.success }[s]
  const d = open ? toolDetails(item, 20) : null
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text wrapMode="none">
        <span fg={color}>{`${GLYPH[s]} `}</span>
        <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(toolLine(item))}</span>
      </text>
      {d && (
        <box flexDirection="column" paddingLeft={2}>
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground}>{safe(d.input)}</text>
          {d.output ? <text fg={item.failed ? theme.destructive : theme.foreground}>{safe(d.output)}</text> : null}
        </box>
      )}
    </box>
  )
}

const RUN_GLYPH: Record<SpecialistEntry["kind"], string> = { text: "•", thinking: "∴", tool: "⚙", result: "■", note: "·" }

function Delegation({ step, open, ctx }: { step: StepRow; open: boolean; ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const sections = open ? delegationSections(step, filesOfStep(ctx.events, step.id)) : []
  const run = ctx.run(step.id)
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column" border={["left"]} borderColor={toneColor(theme, tone(step.state))} paddingLeft={1}>
      <text>
        <span fg={theme.primary} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
          {"◆ specialist "}
        </span>
        <span fg={toneColor(theme, tone(step.state))}>{`[${step.state}] `}</span>
        <span fg={theme.foreground}>{safe(step.title)}</span>
      </text>
      {sections.map((s) => (
        <box key={s.title} flexDirection="column" marginTop={1}>
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>
            {s.title}
          </text>
          {s.title === "Report" ? (
            <Markdown text={s.lines.join("\n")} />
          ) : (
            s.lines.map((l, i) => (
              <text key={i} fg={theme.foreground}>
                {safe(l)}
              </text>
            ))
          )}
        </box>
      ))}
      {run.length > 0 && (
        <box flexDirection="column" marginTop={1}>
          <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} attributes={TextAttributes.BOLD}>{`Specialist's run (${run.length})`}</text>
          {run.map((e) => (
            <RunEntry key={e.id} entry={e} open={open} />
          ))}
        </box>
      )}
    </box>
  )
}

function RunEntry({ entry, open }: { entry: SpecialistEntry; open: boolean }) {
  const { theme } = useApp()
  const running = entry.kind === "tool" && entry.output === undefined
  const body = entry.body.split("\n").slice(0, 12).join("\n")
  const output = (entry.output ?? "").split("\n").slice(0, 12).join("\n")
  return (
    <box flexDirection="column">
      <text wrapMode="none">
        <span fg={entry.failed ? theme.destructive : entry.kind === "thinking" ? theme.mutedForeground : theme.primary}>{`${RUN_GLYPH[entry.kind]} `}</span>
        {entry.subagent ? <span fg={theme.warning}>{`[${safe(entry.subagent)}] `}</span> : null}
        <span fg={entry.failed ? theme.destructive : theme.foreground}>{safe(entry.title)}</span>
        {running ? <span fg={theme.primary}>{`  running${entry.elapsedSeconds ? ` · ${entry.elapsedSeconds}s` : ""}`}</span> : null}
      </text>
      {open && entry.kind !== "text" && body && body !== entry.title ? (
        <text fg={theme.mutedForeground} paddingLeft={2} attributes={entry.kind === "thinking" ? TextAttributes.ITALIC : undefined}>
          {safe(body)}
        </text>
      ) : null}
      {open && entry.kind === "text" && entry.body ? (
        <box paddingLeft={2}>
          <Markdown text={entry.body} />
        </box>
      ) : null}
      {open && output ? (
        <text fg={entry.failed ? theme.destructive : theme.foreground} paddingLeft={2}>
          {safe(output)}
        </text>
      ) : null}
    </box>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { RGBA } from "@opentui/core"

/* specs/tui-conversation: a task as a conversation at parity with the desktop timeline. */

let current: Screen | null = null
afterEach(async () => {
  await current?.dispose()
  current = null
})
const ID = task().id
const open = async (script: Parameters<typeof scriptedApi>[0] = {}, bus = pushBus()) => {
  const api = scriptedApi(script)
  const screen = await render({ api: api.api, bus: bus.bus, start: { kind: "task", id: ID } })
  current = screen
  await screen.until(`[${script.getTask ? "" : "awaiting-user"}`)
  return { ...api, push: bus.push, s: screen }
}

/** The color a piece of text is drawn in, from the frame's spans. */
function colorOf(sc: Screen, text: string): string | null {
  for (const line of sc.captureSpans().lines) for (const span of line.spans) if (span.text.includes(text)) return span.fg.toString()
  return null
}

describe("the transcript (specs/tui-conversation R1)", () => {
  test("draws the agent's markdown, its code colored by the shared highlighter (R1.2)", async () => {
    const { s } = await open()
    await s.until("Here is what I found:")
    expect(s.frame()).not.toContain("**what**")
    expect(s.frame()).toContain("int main(void) { return 0; }")
    expect(colorOf(s, "int")).toBe(RGBA.fromHex(SYNTAX.typeName).toString())
    expect(colorOf(s, "return")).toBe(RGBA.fromHex(SYNTAX.keyword).toString())
  })

  test("shows tool calls on one line, expanded from the start, folded and unfolded with Ctrl+O and Enter (R1.3)", async () => {
    const { s } = await open()
    await s.until("✓ read_file(/workspace/src/main.c)")
    expect(s.frame()).toContain('"file_path": "/workspace/src/main.c"')
    await s.press("o", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until(() => !s.frame().includes('"file_path"'))
    expect(s.frame()).toContain("✓ read_file(/workspace/src/main.c)")
    // into the transcript, pick the call, unfold it alone
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.press("up")
    await s.press("return")
    await s.until('"file_path": "/workspace/src/main.c"')
  })

  test("shows a delegation with its package, report, evidence and the specialist's run, a running tool with its time (R1.4)", async () => {

    for (const part of [
      "Context package",

      "Where is the header read?",
      "Report",

      "Evidence (1)",
      "src/main.c:3-9 — the header is read here",
      "Specialist's run (2)",
      "∴ The header comes first.",
      "⚙ Bash make  running · 30s",
    ])

  })

  test("adds what is pushed to the end (R1.1)", async () => {

  })

  })
```

```tsx
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
import { FOLDER, project, render, scriptedApi, task, type Screen } from "./support"

/* specs/tui-launch: what the TUI opens for the folder it is run in. */
```

`tui/test/panels.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
import { DATA, history, project, pushBus, render, scriptedApi, task, type Screen } from "./support"

/* specs/tui-panels and the rest of specs/tui-launch: setup, settings, event log, project overview, new project. */

let current: Screen | null = null
afterEach(async () => {
  await current?.dispose()
  current = null
})
const show = async (o: Parameters<typeof render>[0]) => (current = await render(o))
const notReady = {
  sandbox: { ready: false, reason: "Docker is not running.", building: false },
  claude: { ready: false, reason: "Sign Claude in.", plan: undefined },
  model: { ready: false, reason: "Set your OpenRouter API key.", provider: "openrouter" as const, model: "m" },
  ready: false,
  completed: false,
}

describe("the setup (specs/tui-panels R3)", () => {
  test("shows the three steps with what readies each, and the build log as it runs (R3.1, R3.2)", async () => {
    const bus = pushBus()
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ readiness: () => notReady })
    const s = await show({ api, bus: bus.bus, start: { kind: "setup" } })
    await s.until("1 · Sandbox images")
    for (const part of ["Docker is not running.", "2 · Claude sign-in", "Sign Claude in.", "3 · Orchestrator's model", "Set your OpenRouter API key."])
      expect(s.frame()).toContain(part)
    bus.push({
      type: "sandbox",
      status: { docker: true, dockerError: "", images: false, building: true, buildLog: "Pulling the base\nStep 2/4\n", claudeVersion: "2.1.310" },
    })
    await s.until("Step 2/4")
    await s.type("/images")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("buildSandbox").length === 1)
  })

  test("signs in through the browser, takes the code, cancels and signs out (R3.3)", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({
      loginStatus: () => ({ loggedIn: false, method: "none", inProgress: true, url: "https://claude.ai/oauth/x", text: "", error: "" }),
    })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "setup" } })
    await s.until("https://claude.ai/oauth/x")
    for (const [cmd, method] of [
      ["/open-login", "openLoginUrl"],
      ["/code abcdefgh1234", "sendLoginCode"],
      ["/cancel-login", "cancelLogin"],
      ["/logout", "logout"],
      ["/login", "startLogin"],
    ] as const) {
      await s.type(cmd)
      await s.enter()
      await s.until(() => called(method).length === 1)
    }
    expect(called("sendLoginCode")[0].args).toEqual(["abcdefgh1234"])
  })

  test("picks the provider, sets the base URL and the key, removes it, and picks the model from the list (R3.4)", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi()
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "setup" } })
    await s.until("3 · Orchestrator's model")
    await s.type("/key sk-or-v1-0123456789")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("saveKey").length === 1)
    expect(called("saveKey")[0].args).toEqual(["sk-or-v1-0123456789", "openrouter"])
    await s.type("/remove-key")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("clearKey").length === 1)
    await s.type("/base-url https://api.example.com/v1")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").length === 1)
    await s.type("/model")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("other/model")
    await s.press("down")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").some((c) => JSON.stringify(c.args).includes("other/model")))
    expect(called("listModels")).toHaveLength(1)
    await s.type("/provider")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("DeepSeek")
    await s.press("down")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").some((c) => JSON.stringify(c.args).includes('"provider":"deepseek"')))
  })

  test("finishes with /done and goes on (R3.1)", async () => {
    const ready = {
      ...notReady,
      sandbox: { ready: true, reason: "", building: false },
      claude: { ready: true, reason: "" },
      model: { ...notReady.model, ready: true, reason: "" },
      ready: true,
    }
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ readiness: () => ready, completeSetup: () => ({ ...ready, completed: true }) })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "setup", then: { kind: "settings" } } })
    await s.until("Every step is ready")
    await s.type("/done")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("completeSetup").length === 1)
    await s.until("Delegation timeout (minutes)")
  })

  test("shows a banner when a step stops being ready after the setup, naming it (R3.5)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi({
      readiness: () => ({ ...notReady, claude: { ready: true, reason: "" }, model: { ...notReady.model, ready: true, reason: "" }, completed: true }),
    })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("The sandbox images stopped being ready. Type /setup to fix it.")
  })
})

describe("settings (specs/tui-panels R4)", () => {
  test("changes the efforts and the timeouts, and opens the setup again", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi()
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "settings" } })
    await s.until("Delegation timeout (minutes)")
    await s.press("right")
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").some((c) => JSON.stringify(c.args).includes("orchestratorEffort")))
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.press("right")
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").some((c) => JSON.stringify(c.args).includes("specialistEffort")))
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.press("backspace")
    await s.press("backspace")
    await s.press("backspace")
    await s.type("45")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("saveSettings").some((c) => JSON.stringify(c.args) === '[{"timeoutMinutes":45}]'))
    await s.press("t", { ctrl: true })
    await s.type("/setup")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("1 · Sandbox images")
  })
})

describe("the event log (specs/tui-panels R1.2)", () => {
  test("lists the task's events, filters them by agent, and opens one's payload", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "events", taskId: task().id } })
    await s.until("Filter: [all]")
    expect(s.frame()).toContain("specialist.thinking")
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.until("[orchestrator]")
    expect(s.frame()).not.toContain("specialist.thinking")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("Esc closes")
  })
})

describe("a project's overview (specs/tui-panels R2.1, R2.2)", () => {
  test("gives the prompt back its keys when the user comes back from a task opened from the list", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ startTask: () => task() })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "project", id: project().id } })
    await s.until("Tasks (1)")
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.press("escape")
    await s.until("Tasks (1)")
    await s.type("A new request")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("startTask").length === 1)
    expect(called("startTask")[0].args).toEqual([{ projectId: project().id, request: "A new request" }])
  })

  test("shows its target, tasks, analyses and unknowns, and starts a task from the prompt", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({
      getProject: () => ({
        project: project(),
        tasks: [task()],
        analyses: [{ id: "a1", taskId: task().id, state: "done", objective: "Map the parser", evidence: 3, createdAt: 1 }],
        unknowns: [
          {
            id: "u1",
            projectId: project().id,
            question: "Is the checksum CRC32?",
            severity: "high",
            probes: [],
            settle: "",
            raisedBy: "s1",
            closedBy: null,
            resolution: "",
            createdAt: 1,
          },
        ],
      }),
      startTask: () => task({ id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", request: "Find the key" }),
      getTask: () => history({ task: task({ id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", request: "Find the key" }) }),
    })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "project", id: project().id } })
    await s.until("Analyses (1)")
    for (const part of ["Map the parser", "3 evidence", "Is the checksum CRC32?", "Open unknowns (1 of 1)", "Map the protocol"])
      expect(s.frame()).toContain(part)
    await s.type("Find the key")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("startTask").length === 1)
    expect(called("startTask")[0].args).toEqual([{ projectId: project().id, request: "Find the key" }])
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
  })

  test("changes the model and efforts the project's tasks run with, picked from the provider's list (specs/projects R1.8)", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi()
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "project", id: project().id } })
    await s.until("Tasks (1)")
    await s.type("/model")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("other/model")
    await s.press("down")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("updateProject").length === 1)
    expect(called("updateProject")[0].args).toEqual([project().id, { model: "other/model" }])
    await s.type("/specialist-effort")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("Specialist's effort")
    await s.press("down")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("updateProject").length === 2)
    expect(called("updateProject")[1].args).toEqual([project().id, { specialistEffort: "high" }])
  })

  test("deletes the project only after its name is typed", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi()
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "project", id: project().id } })
    await s.until("Tasks (1)")
    await s.type("/delete-project")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("Type its name to confirm.")
    await s.type("wrong")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("That is not the project's name.")
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) await s.press("backspace")
    await s.type("app")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("deleteProject").length === 1)
  })

  test("shows a project another app holds as taken, starting no task there", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi({ getProject: () => ({ project: project({ heldBy: { app: "desktop", pid: 77 } }), tasks: [], analyses: [], unknowns: [] }) })
    const s = await show({ api, start: { kind: "project", id: project().id } })
    await s.until("In use by the desktop app (process 77)")
  })
})

describe("creating a project (specs/tui-panels R2.3, specs/tui-launch R1.5, R1.6)", () => {
  test("creates it from the prefilled form", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ listProjects: () => [], createProject: () => project({ id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005" }) })
    const s = await show({ api })
    await s.until("Folder, read in place")
    await s.press("s", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until(() => called("createProject").length === 1)
    expect(called("createProject")[0].args[0]).toMatchObject({ name: "app", goal: "understand", provider: "openrouter" })
  })

  test("asks for a home folder's path typed before creating a project on it", async () => {
    const home = process.platform === "win32" ? "C:\\Users\\ana" : "/home/ana"
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ listProjects: () => [], createProject: () => project() })
    const s = await show({ api, folder: home })
    await s.until("your home folder")
    await s.until("Folder, read in place")
    await s.press("s", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until("Mount a broad folder?")
    await s.type("nope")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("That is not the same path.")
    expect(called("createProject")).toHaveLength(0)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) await s.press("backspace")
    await s.type(home)
    await s.enter()
    await s.until(() => called("createProject").length === 1)
  })

  test("refuses the app's own data folder", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ listProjects: () => [] })
    const s = await show({ api, folder: DATA })
    await s.until("This is the app's own data folder")
    expect(called("createProject")).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test("browses for the target with the terminal's picker, standing in for the desktop dialog", async () => {
    const { api, called } = scriptedApi({ listProjects: () => [], pickTarget: () => "C:\\elsewhere\\bin" })
    const s = await show({ api })
    await s.until("Ctrl+O browses")
    await s.press("o", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until(() => called("pickTarget").length === 1)
    await s.until("elsewhere")
  })
})
```

`tui/test/parity.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs"
import { join } from "node:path"
import type { ApiMethod } from "../../src/shared/api"
import { conversation, event, history, project, render, scriptedApi, task, type Screen } from "./support"

/*
  Parity with the desktop app (plans/tui-revamp 1.6): every API method the renderer's views and components call is
  reached by running the TUI — its screens, commands and dialogs driven with keys — not by reading its source.
*/

const reached = new Set<ApiMethod>()
const ID = task().id

/** Runs a flow on a fresh screen with a recording API; every method it reaches counts. */
async function flow(
  script: Parameters<typeof scriptedApi>[0],
  start: Parameters<typeof render>[0]["start"],
  steps: (s: Screen) => Promise<void>,
  folder?: string,
) {
  const api = scriptedApi(script)
  const s = await render({ api: api.api, start, folder })
  try {
    await steps(s)
  } finally {
    for (const c of api.calls) reached.add(c.method)
    await s.dispose()
  }
}
const run = async (s: Screen, line: string) => {
  await s.type(line)
  await s.enter()
}

/**
  The desktop's methods a spec leaves out of the TUI, each with the spec that says so: the MCP integrations' Settings
  section (specs/mcp-integrations, Out of scope); their calls still run in tasks the TUI starts.
*/
const DESKTOP_ONLY = new Set(["integrations", "integrationStatus", "runIntegrationAction"])

/** The API methods the desktop app's views and components call, from their source, but those a spec leaves out of the TUI. */
function rendererMethods(): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>()
  const walk = (dir: string) => {
    for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const p = join(dir, name)
      if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p)
      else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(name)) for (const m of readFileSync(p, "utf8").matchAll(/\bapi\.([a-zA-Z]+)\(/g)) if (!DESKTOP_ONLY.has(m[1])) out.add(m[1])
    }
  }
  walk(join(import.meta.dir, "..", "..", "src", "renderer", "src"))
  return out
}

describe("parity with the desktop app (plans/tui-revamp 1.6)", () => {
  test("opens the folder's project and its tasks, and every project's recent tasks", async () => {
    await flow({ startTask: () => task() }, undefined, async (s) => {
      await s.until("Analyses (0)")
      await run(s, "Find the key")
      await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
      await run(s, "/tasks")
      await s.until("Recent tasks")
    })
  })

  test("drives a task through each of its states' actions", async () => {
    const states = {
      "awaiting-user": ["/model other/model", "/close"],
      running: ["/stop", "/cancel"],
      stopped: ["/continue"],
      failed: ["/start-over"],
      done: ["/delete"],
    } as const
    for (const [state, commands] of Object.entries(states))
      await flow({ getTask: () => history({ task: task({ state: state as never }) }), retryTask: () => task() }, { kind: "task", id: ID }, async (s) => {
        await s.until(`[${state}]`)
        for (const c of commands) await run(s, c)
        if (state === "done") {
          await s.until("Delete this task")
          await s.press("y")
        }
        await run(s, "a message")
        await s.settle(10)
      })
  })

  test("answers a question, decides a gated call and a patch", async () => {
    const c = conversation()
    c.events.push(
      event("question.asked", { questionId: "q1", question: { prompt: "Which?", reason: "r", kind: "yesno", default: true } }),
      event("approval.requested", { calls: [{ callId: "g1", name: "execute", args: {} }] }),
    )
    const patch = {
      id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099",
      taskId: ID,
      stepId: "s1",
      state: "proposed",
      files: [],
      diff: "+x\n",
      conflicts: [],
      createdAt: 1,
    }
    await flow({ getTask: () => history({ ...c, task: task({ state: "awaiting-user" }), patches: [patch as never] }) }, { kind: "task", id: ID }, async (s) => {
      await s.until("Which?")
      await s.enter()
      await s.until("The agent wants to run execute")
      await s.enter()
      await s.settle(10)
      await run(s, "/approve-patch")
      await s.settle(10)
    })
  })

  test("runs every step of the setup", async () => {
    await flow(
      { loginStatus: () => ({ loggedIn: false, method: "none", inProgress: true, url: "https://claude.ai/x", text: "", error: "" }) },
      { kind: "setup" },
      async (s) => {
        await s.until("3 · Orchestrator's model")
        for (const c of [
          "/images",
          "/login",
          "/open-login",
          "/code abcdefgh1",
          "/cancel-login",
          "/logout",
          "/key sk-or-v1-000000000",
          "/remove-key",
          "/base-url https://x.dev/v1",
          "/done",
        ])
          await run(s, c)
        await run(s, "/model")
        await s.until("other/model")
        await s.enter()
        await s.settle(10)
      },
    )
  })

  test("creates a project with its target and folder picked, and deletes one", async () => {
    await flow(
      { listProjects: () => [], createProject: () => project(), pickTarget: () => "C:/target", pickFolder: () => "C:/projects" },
      undefined,
      async (s) => {
        await s.until("Folder, read in place")
        await s.press("o", { ctrl: true })
        await s.until("C:/target")
        await s.until("Folder, read in place")
        await s.press("t", { ctrl: true })
        await run(s, "/project-folder")
        await run(s, "/models")
        await s.until("other/model")
        await s.press("escape")
        await run(s, "/create")
        await s.settle(10)
      },
    )
    await flow({}, { kind: "project", id: project().id }, async (s) => {
      await s.until("Tasks (1)")
      await run(s, "/model other/model")
      await run(s, "/delete-project")
      await s.until("Type its name to confirm.")
      await s.type("app")
      await s.enter()
      await s.settle(10)
    })
  })

  test("reaches every API method the desktop app's views call", () => {
    const missing = [...rendererMethods()].filter((m) => !reached.has(m as ApiMethod)).sort()
    expect(rendererMethods().size).toBeGreaterThan(30)
    expect(missing).toEqual([])
  })
})
```

`tui/test/shell.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
import { render, scriptedApi, task, type Screen } from "./support"

/* specs/tui-shell: the frame, the keys, the commands, the dialogs. */

let s: Screen | null = null
afterEach(async () => {
  await s?.dispose()
  s = null
})

describe("the shell (specs/tui-shell)", () => {
  test("lays out the status line with the screen's title and state, the prompt and the key hints (R1.1, R1.2)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    const f = s.frame()
    expect(f).toContain("Harness for REA")
    expect(f).toContain("Map the protocol")
    expect(f).toContain("[awaiting-user]")
    expect(f).toContain("? keys")
    expect(f).toContain("Tab prompt or transcript")
  })

  test("? lists every key reachable on the screen, by layer, and every command (R2.1)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.type("?")
    await s.until("Esc or ? closes")
    const f = s.frame()
    for (const key of ["Ctrl+P", "Ctrl+B", "Ctrl+O", "Tab", "PgUp", "PgDn", "Esc", "Ctrl+C"]) expect(f).toContain(key)
    for (const group of ["Task", "Prompt", "Everywhere"]) expect(f).toContain(group)
    for (const cmd of ["/close", "/delete", "/events", "/expand", "/projects", "/settings", "/quit"]) expect(f).toContain(cmd)
    await s.press("escape")
    await s.until(() => !s!.frame().includes("Esc or ? closes"))
  })

  test("a typed ? is part of a message, not the help", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.type("why?")
    expect(s.frame()).toContain("why?")
    expect(s.frame()).not.toContain("Esc or ? closes")
  })

  test("/ lists the screen's commands with the global ones, narrowed as typed and completed with Tab (R2.2)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.type("/")
    await s.until("/settings")
    for (const cmd of ["/close", "/delete", "/events", "/expand"]) expect(s.frame()).toContain(cmd)
    await s.type("eve")
    await s.until(() => !s!.frame().includes("/close"))
    expect(s.frame()).toContain("Open the task's event log")
    await s.press("tab")
    await s.until("Filter: [all]")
  })

  test("Ctrl+P opens the palette over the same commands, searchable, and runs the one picked (R2.3)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.press("p", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until("Commands")
    for (const cmd of ["/close", "/delete", "/events", "/projects", "/settings", "/quit"]) expect(s.frame()).toContain(cmd)
    await s.type("settings")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("Delegation timeout (minutes)")
  })

  test("Ctrl+C clears the prompt, then asks for a second press before it quits (R2.5)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    await s.type("draft")
    await s.press("c", { ctrl: true })
    expect(s.frame()).not.toContain("draft")
    await s.press("c", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until("Press Ctrl+C again to quit.")
    expect(s.quits).toHaveLength(0)
    await s.press("c", { ctrl: true })
    expect(s.quits).toHaveLength(1)
  })

  test.each([
    ["an empty prompt", ""],
    ["a prompt holding text", "draft"],
  ])("quits with Ctrl+C twice while a dialog is open over %s (R2.5)", async (_, draft) => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi()
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("[awaiting-user]")
    if (draft) await s.type(draft)
    await s.press("p", { ctrl: true })
    await s.until("Commands")
    await s.press("c", { ctrl: true })
    await s.press("c", { ctrl: true })
    expect(s.quits).toHaveLength(1)
  })

  test("says a failed action in a toast (R3.2) and strips control characters from what it draws (R3.3)", async () => {
    const { api } = scriptedApi({
      getTask: () => ({ ...history(), task: task({ request: "Map \u001b]0;pwned\u0007 it" }) }),
      closeTask: () => {
        throw new Error("The task is busy.")
      },
    })
    s = await render({ api, start: { kind: "task", id: task().id } })
    await s.until("Map ]0;pwned it")
    expect(s.frame()).not.toContain("\u001b")
    await s.type("/close")
    await s.enter()
    await s.until("The task is busy.")
  })
})
```

```tsx
import { expect, test } from "bun:test"
import { useState } from "react"
import { useKeyboard } from "@opentui/react"
import { testRender } from "@opentui/react/test-utils"

/*
  The smoke screen test (plans/tui-revamp 1.5): OpenTUI's test renderer starts under Bun, draws a React tree and
  delivers a key to it, so the job fails when the renderer or its native library does not load.
*/

;(globalThis as { IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT?: boolean }).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = false

function Counter() {
  const [n, setN] = useState(0)
  useKeyboard((k) => k.name === "up" && setN((x) => x + 1))
  return <text>{`count ${n}`}</text>
}

test("OpenTUI's test renderer starts, draws a React tree and delivers a key", async () => {
  const t = await testRender(<Counter />, { width: 40, height: 5 })
  await t.renderOnce()
  expect(t.captureCharFrame()).toContain("count 0")
  t.mockInput.pressArrow("up")
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !t.captureCharFrame().includes("count 1"); i++) {
    await Bun.sleep(10)
    await t.renderOnce()
  }
  expect(t.captureCharFrame()).toContain("count 1")
  await t.dispose()
})
```

```tsx
import { testRender } from "@opentui/react/test-utils"
import type { Api, ApiMethod } from "../../src/shared/api"
import type { EventRow, ProjectRow, Push, Readiness, Settings, StepRow, TaskHistory, TaskRow } from "../../src/shared/types"
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS } from "../../src/shared/defaults"

import type { Bus, Route } from "../src/app/context"
import { DARK } from "../src/app/theme"

/*
  Screen tests' support (specs/tui-shell R4.1): the TUI's App on OpenTUI's test renderer, against a scripted API that
  records every method called and a push bus the test drives — no core, no Docker.
*/

;(globalThis as { IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT?: boolean }).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = false

export const FOLDER = process.platform === "win32" ? "C:\\samples\\app" : "/samples/app"
export const DATA = process.platform === "win32" ? "C:\\Users\\ana\\AppData\\Roaming\\Harness for REA" : "/home/ana/.config/Harness for REA"
export const UUID = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`

export const project = (o: Partial<ProjectRow> = {}): ProjectRow => ({
  id: UUID(1),
  name: "app",
  goal: "understand",
  targetPath: FOLDER,
  targetKind: "folder",
  sourceRoot: FOLDER,
  folder: "/p",
  ownsFolder: true,
  provider: "openrouter",
  model: "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017",
  orchestratorEffort: "default",
  specialistEffort: "medium",
  createdAt: 1,
  updatedAt: 1,
  ...o,
})

export const task = (o: Partial<TaskRow> = {}): TaskRow => ({
  id: UUID(10),
  projectId: UUID(1),
  request: "Map the protocol",
  sourceRoot: FOLDER,
  model: "m",
  state: "awaiting-user",
  result: "",
  error: "",
  createdAt: 1,
  updatedAt: 1,
  tokensIn: 1200,
  tokensOut: 300,
  costUsd: 0.02,
  specialistCostUsd: 0.05,
  ...o,
})

let eid = 0
export const event = (kind: string, payload: Record<string, unknown> = {}, o: Partial<EventRow> = {}): EventRow => ({

  taskId: UUID(10),
  stepId: null,
  agent: "orchestrator",

  summary: kind,

export const step = (o: Partial<StepRow> = {}): StepRow => ({

  taskId: UUID(10),
  ord: 1,
  kind: "delegation",
  title: "Map the parser",
  agent: "specialist",
  state: "done",
  data: {},
  createdAt: 1,

export const READY: Readiness = {
  sandbox: { ready: true, reason: "", building: false },

/** A conversation with a delegation: messages in markdown, a tool call, the specialist's run, a plan and usage. */
export function conversation(): { steps: StepRow[]; events: EventRow[] } {
  const delegation = step({
    data: {
      callId: "c1",
      context: {
        brief: "An ELF parser.",
        objective: "Map the parser",
        mode: "read",
        files: ["src/main.c"],
        questions: ["Where is the header read?"],
        constraints: [],
        environment: [],
        excerpts: [],
      },
      report: "The header is read in **parse_header**.",
      evidence: [{ path: "src/main.c", startLine: 3, endLine: 9, claim: "the header is read here" }],
    },
  })
  return {
    steps: [
      delegation,
      step({ id: "t1", kind: "todo", title: "Read the parser", state: "done" }),
      step({ id: "t2", kind: "todo", title: "Write the client", state: "running" }),
    ],
    events: [
      event("message.user", { output: "Map the protocol" }, { agent: "app" }),
      event("message.agent", { output: "Here is **what** I found:\n\n```c\nint main(void) { return 0; }\n```" }),
      event("tool.call", { tool: "read_file", callId: "r1", input: JSON.stringify({ file_path: "/workspace/src/main.c" }) }),
      event("tool.result", { tool: "read_file", callId: "r1", output: "int main(void) { return 0; }" }),
      event("tool.call", { tool: "delegate_to_specialist", callId: "c1", input: JSON.stringify({ objective: "Map the parser" }) }),
      event("specialist.thinking", { output: "The header comes first." }, { agent: "specialist", stepId: "s1", summary: "The header comes first." }),
      event("specialist.tool.call", { tool: "Bash", callId: "b1", input: '{"command":"make"}' }, { agent: "specialist", stepId: "s1", summary: "Bash make" }),
      event("specialist.tool.progress", { tool: "Bash", callId: "b1", elapsedSeconds: 30 }, { agent: "specialist", stepId: "s1" }),
      event("tool.result", { tool: "delegate_to_specialist", callId: "c1", output: "{}" }),
    ],
  }
}

  hasMore: false,
  hasOlder: false,
  ...o,

/** A scripted API: each method answers from `script`, or with a harmless default; every call is recorded. */
export function scriptedApi(script: Partial<Record<ApiMethod, (...args: never[]) => unknown>> = {}) {
  const calls: { method: ApiMethod; args: unknown[] }[] = []
  const settings: Settings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, setupCompleted: true }
  const defaults: Partial<Record<ApiMethod, (...args: never[]) => unknown>> = {
    getSettings: () => settings,
    readiness: () => READY,
    listProjects: () => [project()],
    getProject: () => ({ project: project(), tasks: [task()], analyses: [], unknowns: [] }),
    getTask: () => history(),
    listTasks: () => [task()],
    sandboxStatus: () => ({ docker: true, dockerError: "", images: true, building: false, buildLog: "", claudeVersion: "2.1.310" }),
    loginStatus: () => ({ loggedIn: true, method: "claude.ai", inProgress: false, url: null, text: "", error: "" }),
    keyStatus: () => ({ set: true, hint: "…abcd", encryption: true }),
    listModels: () => ["m", "other/model"],
    detectTarget: (path: never) => ({ path, kind: "folder", isFile: false, size: 0, label: "Folder", engines: ["Ghidra"] }),
    saveSettings: (patch: never) => ({ ...settings, ...(patch as object) }),
  }
  const api = new Proxy({} as Api, {
    get:
      (_t, method: string) =>
      async (...args: unknown[]) => {
        calls.push({ method: method as ApiMethod, args })
        const fn = script[method as ApiMethod] ?? defaults[method as ApiMethod]
        return fn ? (fn as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown)(...args) : null
      },
  })
  return { api, calls, called: (m: ApiMethod) => calls.filter((c) => c.method === m) }
}

export function pushBus() {
  const fns = new Set<(p: Push) => void>()
  const bus: Bus = { on: (fn) => (fns.add(fn), () => void fns.delete(fn)) }
  return { bus, push: (p: Push) => fns.forEach((f) => f(p)) }
}

export type Screen = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof render>>

/** The App rendered at 120×40, with helpers to wait for a frame and type. */
export async function render(o: {
  api: Api
  bus?: Bus
  start?: Route
  folder?: string
  args?: { continue: boolean; resume: boolean }
  width?: number
  height?: number
}) {
  const quits: number[] = []
  const t = await testRender(
    <App
      api={o.api}
      bus={o.bus ?? pushBus().bus}
      theme={DARK}
      where={{
        folder: o.folder ?? FOLDER,
        platform: process.platform as "win32",
        home: process.platform === "win32" ? "C:\\Users\\ana" : "/home/ana",
        dataDir: DATA,
        env: {},
      }}
      args={o.args ?? { continue: false, resume: false }}
      quit={() => quits.push(1)}
      start={o.start}
    />,
    { width: o.width ?? 120, height: o.height ?? 40, exitOnCtrlC: false },
  )
  const frame = () => t.captureCharFrame()
  /** Waits until the frame shows `text` (or the predicate holds), drawing frames as it goes. */
  const until = async (want: string | (() => boolean), ms = 3000) => {
    const ok = () => (typeof want === "string" ? frame().includes(want) : want())
    const end = Date.now() + ms
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      await t.renderOnce()
      if (ok()) return
      await Bun.sleep(15)
    }
    throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${typeof want === "string" ? JSON.stringify(want) : "a condition"}.\n${frame()}`)
  }
  const settle = async (n = 5) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      await Bun.sleep(15)
      await t.renderOnce()
    }
  }
  const type = async (text: string) => {
    await t.mockInput.typeText(text)
    await settle()
  }
  const NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
    escape: "ESCAPE",
    tab: "TAB",
    return: "RETURN",
    up: "ARROW_UP",
    down: "ARROW_DOWN",
    left: "ARROW_LEFT",
    right: "ARROW_RIGHT",
    backspace: "BACKSPACE",
    home: "HOME",
    end: "END",
  }
  const press = async (key: string, mods?: { ctrl?: boolean; shift?: boolean; meta?: boolean }) => {
    t.mockInput.pressKey((NAMES[key] ?? key) as never, mods)
    await settle()
  }
  const enter = async () => {
    t.mockInput.pressEnter()
    await settle()
  }
  return { ...t, frame, until, settle, type, press, enter, quits }
}
```
